575	#    s     = SiLU(g_pre) ;  prod = s * u
576	#    out   = prod @ Wdown^T
577	#  Backward (dout):
578	#    (dprod, dWdown) = linear_bwd(dout, prod, Wdown)
579	#    ds = dprod * u ;  du = dprod * s
580	#    dg_pre = ds * SiLU'(g_pre)
581	#    (dx_g, dWgate) = linear_bwd(dg_pre, x, Wgate)
582	#    (dx_u, dWup)   = linear_bwd(du,     x, Wup)
583	#    dx = dx_g + dx_u
584	# ===========================================================================
585	def swiglu_forward(x, Wgate, Wup, Wdown):
586	    g_pre = linear_forward(x, Wgate)        # [B,L,d_ff]
587	    u = linear_forward(x, Wup)              # [B,L,d_ff]
588	    s = silu(g_pre)                         # [B,L,d_ff]
589	    prod = s * u                            # [B,L,d_ff]
590	    out = linear_forward(prod, Wdown)       # [B,L,d]
591	    cache = dict(x=x, g_pre=g_pre, u=u, s=s, prod=prod)
592	    return out, cache
593	
594	
595	def swiglu_backward(dout, cache, Wgate, Wup, Wdown):
596	    x, g_pre, u, s, prod = (cache["x"], cache["g_pre"], cache["u"],
597	                            cache["s"], cache["prod"])
598	    g = {}
599	    dprod, g["down_proj.weight"], _ = linear_backward(dout, prod, Wdown, False)
600	    ds = dprod * u
601	    du = dprod * s
602	    dg_pre = ds * silu_grad(g_pre)
603	    dx_g, g["gate_proj.weight"], _ = linear_backward(dg_pre, x, Wgate, False)
604	    dx_u, g["up_proj.weight"], _ = linear_backward(du, x, Wup, False)
605	    dx = dx_g + dx_u
606	    return dx, g
607	
608	
609	# ===========================================================================
610	#  ONE Mamba3Block forward + MANUAL backward — the Llama-style pre-norm layer:
611	#    h1 = x  + mixer( RMSNorm_mix(x)  )      # residual=False mixer
612	#    h2 = h1 + mlp  ( RMSNorm_mlp(h1) )      # SwiGLU MLP
613	#  Param keys here are RELATIVE to the block (e.g. "mixer.in_proj.weight",
614	#  "mixer_norm.weight", "mlp.gate_proj.weight", "mlp_norm.weight").
615	# ===========================================================================
616	def block_forward(block, P_: Dict[str, torch.Tensor], x):
617	    eps = block.mixer_norm.eps
618	    # --- mixer sub-block (pre-norm + residual) ---
619	    xn_mix, mixn_cache = rmsnorm_forward(x, P_["mixer_norm.weight"], eps)
620	    Pm = {k[len("mixer."):]: v for k, v in P_.items() if k.startswith("mixer.")}
621	    mix_out, mix_cache = layer_forward(block.mixer, Pm, xn_mix)
622	    h1 = x + mix_out
623	    # --- SwiGLU MLP sub-block (pre-norm + residual) ---
624	    eps2 = block.mlp_norm.eps
625	    h1n, mlpn_cache = rmsnorm_forward(h1, P_["mlp_norm.weight"], eps2)
626	    mlp_out, mlp_cache = swiglu_forward(
627	        h1n, P_["mlp.gate_proj.weight"], P_["mlp.up_proj.weight"],
628	        P_["mlp.down_proj.weight"])
629	    h2 = h1 + mlp_out
630	    cache = dict(mixn_cache=mixn_cache, mix_cache=mix_cache,
631	                 mlpn_cache=mlpn_cache, mlp_cache=mlp_cache)
632	    return h2, cache
633	
634	
635	def block_backward(block, P_: Dict[str, torch.Tensor], cache, dh2):
636	    g = {}
637	    # h2 = h1 + mlp(mlp_norm(h1))
638	    dmlp_out = dh2
639	    dh1 = dh2.clone()                                    # residual path
640	    dh1n, mlp_g = swiglu_backward(
641	        dmlp_out, cache["mlp_cache"], P_["mlp.gate_proj.weight"],
642	        P_["mlp.up_proj.weight"], P_["mlp.down_proj.weight"])
643	    for k, v in mlp_g.items():
644	        g[f"mlp.{k}"] = v
645	    dh1_mlpnorm, g["mlp_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dh1n, cache["mlpn_cache"])
646	    dh1 = dh1 + dh1_mlpnorm                              # h1 fans to residual + mlp_norm
647	
648	    # h1 = x + mixer(mixer_norm(x))
649	    dmix_out = dh1
650	    dx = dh1.clone()                                     # residual path
651	    Pm = {k[len("mixer."):]: v for k, v in P_.items() if k.startswith("mixer.")}
652	    dxn_mix, mix_g = layer_backward(block.mixer, Pm, cache["mix_cache"], dmix_out)
653	    for k, v in mix_g.items():
654	        g[f"mixer.{k}"] = v
655	    dx_mixnorm, g["mixer_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dxn_mix, cache["mixn_cache"])
656	    dx = dx + dx_mixnorm                                 # x fans to residual + mixer_norm
657	    return dx, g
658	
659	
660	# ===========================================================================
661	#  FULL MODEL forward + manual backward (reads the live Mamba3Model params).
662	# ===========================================================================
663	def model_forward(model: Mamba3Model, tokens, targets):
664	    dev = model.tok.weight.device
665	    S = tokens.shape[1]
666	    pos_ids = torch.arange(S, device=dev)
667	    named = dict(model.named_parameters())
668	    h = model.tok.weight[tokens] + model.pos.weight[pos_ids].unsqueeze(0)  # [B,S,d]
669	    layer_caches = []
670	    for li, block in enumerate(model.layers):
671	        P_ = {k[len(f"layers.{li}."):]: v for k, v in named.items()
672	              if k.startswith(f"layers.{li}.")}
673	        h, lc = block_forward(block, P_, h)
674	        layer_caches.append((P_, lc))
675	    h_last = h[:, -1, :]
676	    hn, norm_cache = rmsnorm_forward(h_last, named["norm.weight"], model.norm.eps)
677	    logits = hn @ named["out.weight"].t() + named["out.bias"]
678	    loss = cross_entropy_forward(logits, targets)
679	    cache = dict(tokens=tokens, targets=targets, layer_caches=layer_caches,
680	                 norm_cache=norm_cache, logits=logits, hn=hn, h_shape=h.shape,
681	                 d=model.tok.weight.shape[1])
682	    return loss, cache
683	
684	
685	def model_backward(model: Mamba3Model, cache):
686	    named = dict(model.named_parameters())
687	    grads: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
688	    tokens, targets = cache["tokens"], cache["targets"]
689	    d = cache["d"]
690	
691	    dlogits = cross_entropy_backward(cache["logits"], targets)   # [B,p]
692	    grads["out.weight"] = dlogits.t() @ cache["hn"]
693	    grads["out.bias"] = dlogits.sum(dim=0)
694	    dhn = dlogits @ named["out.weight"]
695	    dh_last, grads["norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dhn, cache["norm_cache"])
696	
697	    B, S, _ = cache["h_shape"]
698	    dh = torch.zeros(B, S, d, device=dhn.device, dtype=dhn.dtype)
699	    dh[:, -1, :] = dh_last
700	    for li in reversed(range(len(model.layers))):
701	        P_, lc = cache["layer_caches"][li]
702	        dh, lg = block_backward(model.layers[li], P_, lc, dh)
703	        for k, v in lg.items():
704	            grads[f"layers.{li}.{k}"] = v
705	
706	    # embeddings: h0 = tok[tokens] + pos[pos_ids]
707	    dtok = torch.zeros_like(named["tok.weight"])
708	    dtok.index_add_(0, tokens.reshape(-1), dh.reshape(-1, d))
709	    grads["tok.weight"] = dtok
710	    grads["pos.weight"] = dh.sum(dim=0)                          # [S,d]
711	    return grads
712	
713	
714	def manual_input_grad(model: Mamba3Model, tokens, targets):
715	    """Manual dL/d(embedding-input). Returns dh0 [B,S,d] (the grad w.r.t.
716	    tok+pos sum), to compare against autograd on the embedded input."""
717	    loss, cache = model_forward(model, tokens, targets)
718	    named = dict(model.named_parameters())
719	    d = cache["d"]
720	    dlogits = cross_entropy_backward(cache["logits"], targets)
721	    dhn = dlogits @ named["out.weight"]
722	    dh_last, _ = rmsnorm_backward(dhn, cache["norm_cache"])
723	    B, S, _ = cache["h_shape"]
724	    dh = torch.zeros(B, S, d, device=dhn.device, dtype=dhn.dtype)
725	    dh[:, -1, :] = dh_last
726	    for li in reversed(range(len(model.layers))):
727	        P_, lc = cache["layer_caches"][li]
728	        dh, _ = block_backward(model.layers[li], P_, lc, dh)
729	    return dh
730	
731	
732	# ===========================================================================
733	#  ORACLE — the original foundation properties (A)-(E).
734	# ===========================================================================
735	def run_oracle() -> bool:
736	    print("=" * 78)
737	    print("Mamba-3 (SISO) fp64 ORACLE  —  forward + manual-backward ground truth")
738	    print("=" * 78)

740	    cfg = TOY
741	    toks, tgts = _make_batch(cfg)
742	
743	    model64 = _build(cfg, torch.float64, seed=0)

745	        p.requires_grad_(True)
746	    loss64, logits64 = _loss(model64, toks, tgts)
747	    assert torch.isfinite(loss64).all(), "fp64 loss not finite"
748	    assert logits64.dtype == torch.float64
749	    assert torch.isfinite(logits64).all(), "fp64 logits not finite"
750	    model64.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
751	    loss64.backward()
752	
753	    n_params = 0
754	    n_grad_params = 0
755	    bad = []
756	    zero_leaves = []
757	    for name, p in model64.named_parameters():
758	        n_params += 1
759	        if p.grad is None:
760	            bad.append(f"{name}: grad is None")
761	            continue
762	        if not torch.isfinite(p.grad).all():
763	            bad.append(f"{name}: grad has NaN/Inf")
764	            continue
765	        n_grad_params += 1
766	        if p.grad.abs().max().item() == 0.0:
767	            zero_leaves.append(name)
768	
769	    print(f"\n[C] fp64 forward loss            = {loss64.item():.16e}  (finite={bool(torch.isfinite(loss64))})")
770	    print(f"[B] parameters total             = {n_params}")
771	    print(f"[B] parameters w/ finite grad    = {n_grad_params}")
772	    if bad:
773	        print("[B] FAIL — params with bad grads:")
774	        for b in bad:
775	            print("      " + b)
776	    if zero_leaves:
777	        print(f"[B] NOTE — params with ALL-ZERO grad ({len(zero_leaves)}): {zero_leaves}")
778	
779	    grads_ok = (not bad)
780	    if zero_leaves:
781	        grads_ok = False
782	
783	    model64.eval()
784	    with torch.no_grad():
785	        l_a = model64(toks)
786	        l_b = model64(toks)
787	    deterministic = torch.equal(l_a, l_b)
788	    print(f"\n[A] forward deterministic (bit-eq across 2 runs) = {deterministic}")
789

794	    max_abs = (logits32.double() - logits64.detach()).abs().max().item()
795	    rel = max_abs / (logits64.detach().abs().max().item() + 1e-12)
796	    f32_match = torch.allclose(logits32.double(), logits64.detach(), atol=ATOL_F32, rtol=RTOL_F32)
797	    print(f"\n[D] fp32 vs fp64 forward: max|abs diff| = {max_abs:.3e}  (rel = {rel:.3e})")
798	    print(f"[D] fp32 loss = {loss32.item():.8e}   fp64 loss = {loss64.item():.8e}")
799	    print(f"[D] within tol (atol={ATOL_F32}, rtol={RTOL_F32}) = {f32_match}")
800

803	
804	    toy_pc = param_count(TOY)

806	          f"mixer+SwiGLU) = {toy_pc:,}")
807	    mix_t, mlp_t, oth_t = param_count_breakdown(TOY)
808	    print(f"    TOY breakdown: mixer={mix_t:,}  swiglu-mlp={mlp_t:,}  embed/head/norm={oth_t:,}")
809

811	    mix_b, mlp_b, oth_b = param_count_breakdown(BIG)
812	    print(f"\n[E] 1.5B-scale param count (d={BIG['d']}, state={BIG['state_dim']}, nl={BIG['nl']}, "
813	          f"MLP inner={2*BIG['d']}, mixer+SwiGLU)")
814	    print(f"    raw (small grokking vocab ntok={BIG['ntok']}) = {big_pc:,}  ({big_pc/1e9:.4f}B)")
815	    print(f"    breakdown: 24 mixers={mix_b:,} ({mix_b/1e9:.4f}B)  "
816	          f"24 swiglu={mlp_b:,} ({mlp_b/1e9:.4f}B)  embed/head/norm={oth_b:,}")
817	    layers_only = mix_b + mlp_b
818	    print(f"    layer stack (mixers + SwiGLU, vocab-independent) = {layers_only:,} "
819	          f"({layers_only/1e9:.4f}B)")
820	
821	    # Headline ~1.5B: the paper's config with the Llama-3.1 vocab (128256) and
822	    # TIED embeddings (out.weight tied to tok.weight, the Mamba LM convention).
823	    big_llama = param_count(BIG_LLAMA_VOCAB)
824	    V = BIG_LLAMA_VOCAB["ntok"]

828	    # head matrix and the V-length bias.
829	    tied = big_llama - (V * d) - V

833	
834	    ok = (
835	        bool(torch.isfinite(loss64))
836	        and grads_ok

845	def _fd_spotcheck(cfg, toks, tgts, eps=1e-6) -> bool:
846	    model = _build(cfg, torch.float64, seed=0)
847	    for p in model.parameters():
848	        p.requires_grad_(True)
849	    loss, _ = _loss(model, toks, tgts)
850	    model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
851	    loss.backward()
852	    g_auto = model.out.bias.grad[0].item()
853	    with torch.no_grad():
854	        orig = model.out.bias[0].item()
855	        model.out.bias[0] = orig + eps
856	        lp, _ = _loss(model, toks, tgts)
857	        model.out.bias[0] = orig - eps
858	        lm, _ = _loss(model, toks, tgts)
859	        model.out.bias[0] = orig
860	    g_fd = (lp.item() - lm.item()) / (2 * eps)
861	    err = abs(g_auto - g_fd) / (abs(g_fd) + 1e-12)
862	    print(f"     autograd={g_auto:.10e}  fd={g_fd:.10e}  rel_err={err:.3e}")
863	    return err < 1e-5
864	
865	
866	# ===========================================================================
867	#  (F) MANUAL BACKWARD vs AUTOGRAD — the headline gate (<=1e-10 rel, fp64).
868	# ===========================================================================
869	def _rel_err(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
870	    """max |a-b| / (max|b| + tiny). Both fp64."""
871	    num = (a - b).abs().max().item()
872	    den = b.abs().max().item()
873	    return num / (den + 1e-300)
874	
875	
876	def manual_vs_autograd(cfg, seed_model=0, seed_data=1234, label="") -> Tuple[bool, float]:
877	    torch.manual_seed(seed_model)
878	    model = Mamba3Model(**cfg).double()
879	    toks, tgts = _make_batch(cfg, seed=seed_data)
880	
881	    # --- autograd reference (loss grad w.r.t. every param + the embedded input)
882	    for p in model.parameters():
883	        p.requires_grad_(True)
884	    dev = model.tok.weight.device
885	    S = toks.shape[1]
886	    pos_ids = torch.arange(S, device=dev)
887	    h0 = model.tok.weight[toks] + model.pos.weight[pos_ids].unsqueeze(0)
888	    h0.retain_grad()
889	    h = h0
890	    for layer in model.layers:
891	        h = layer(h)
892	    logits = model.out(model.norm(h[:, -1, :]))
893	    loss_auto = torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits, tgts)
894	    model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
895	    loss_auto.backward()
896	    auto = {name: p.grad.detach().clone() for name, p in model.named_parameters()}
897	    auto_input = h0.grad.detach().clone()
898	
899	    # --- manual fwd+bwd
900	    with torch.no_grad():
901	        loss_man, cache = model_forward(model, toks, tgts)
902	        man = model_backward(model, cache)
903	        man_input = manual_input_grad(model, toks, tgts)
904	
905	    # loss agreement
906	    loss_rel = abs(loss_man.item() - loss_auto.item()) / (abs(loss_auto.item()) + 1e-300)
907	
908	    # per-parameter table
909	    print(f"\n--- manual vs autograd  [{label}]  cfg={cfg}")
910	    print(f"    loss(manual)={loss_man.item():.16e}  loss(autograd)={loss_auto.item():.16e}")
911	    print(f"    loss rel-err = {loss_rel:.3e}")
912	    print(f"    {'parameter':32s} {'shape':18s} {'max-rel-err':>12s}")
913	    worst = loss_rel
914	    names = list(auto.keys())
915	    for name in names:
916	        a = auto[name]
917	        m = man.get(name)
918	        assert m is not None, f"manual backward missing grad for {name}"
919	        assert m.shape == a.shape, f"{name}: shape {tuple(m.shape)} != {tuple(a.shape)}"
920	        re = _rel_err(m, a)
921	        worst = max(worst, re)
922	        flag = "" if re <= MANUAL_RTOL else "   <-- OVER TOL"
923	        print(f"    {name:32s} {str(tuple(a.shape)):18s} {re:12.3e}{flag}")
924	    # the input grad
925	    re_in = _rel_err(man_input, auto_input)
926	    worst = max(worst, re_in)
927	    flag = "" if re_in <= MANUAL_RTOL else "   <-- OVER TOL"
928	    print(f"    {'[input] dL/d(embed)':32s} {str(tuple(auto_input.shape)):18s} {re_in:12.3e}{flag}")
929	    print(f"    WORST rel-err (incl. loss + input) = {worst:.3e}   (tol {MANUAL_RTOL:.0e})")
930	    return (worst <= MANUAL_RTOL), worst
931	
932	
933	def run_manual_gate() -> bool:
934	    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
935	    print("(F) MANUAL backward vs torch.autograd  —  fp64, <=1e-10 rel (target ~1e-12)")
936	    print("=" * 78)
937	    ok_a, w_a = manual_vs_autograd(GATE_A, seed_model=0, seed_data=1234, label="seed0 / shapeA")
938	    ok_b, w_b = manual_vs_autograd(GATE_B, seed_model=7, seed_data=99, label="seed7 / shapeB")
939	    # also run the manual gate at the TOY config (the real foundation shape)
940	    ok_t, w_t = manual_vs_autograd(TOY, seed_model=0, seed_data=1234, label="TOY config")
941	    ok = ok_a and ok_b and ok_t
942	    print(f"\n[F] manual-vs-autograd gate: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} "
943	          f"(worst rel-err = {max(w_a, w_b, w_t):.3e})")
944	    return ok
945

947	def main() -> bool:
948	    found_ok = run_oracle()
949	    manual_ok = run_manual_gate()

947	def main() -> bool:

25	             return out(norm(h[:, -1, :]))                     # :462  LAST token
26	  Loss: F.cross_entropy(logits, targets)  (mean over batch; :745)

28	  SelectiveSSMLayer(d=128, state_dim=16, expand_factor=2):     # :407-449
29	    d_inner = d*2 = 256 ; dt_rank = max(d//16,1) = 8 ; state_dim = 16
30	    in_proj  = nn.Linear(128, 2*256=512, bias=False)          # :412
31	    conv1d   = nn.Conv1d(256,256,k=3,pad=1,groups=256,bias=True)  # :413-414  (NON-causal depthwise)
32	    x_proj   = nn.Linear(256, dt_rank+2*state_dim = 8+32 = 40, bias=False)  # :415
33	    dt_proj  = nn.Linear(8, 256, bias=True)                   # :416
34	    A_log    = Parameter(log(arange(1,17)).expand(256,16))    # :417-418   A = -exp(A_log)
35	    D        = Parameter(ones(256))                           # :419
36	    out_proj = nn.Linear(256, 128, bias=False)               # :420
37	    norm     = nn.LayerNorm(128)                              # :421 (per-layer, POST)
38	    forward (:442-449):
39	      residual = x
40	      xz = in_proj(x); x_main, z = xz.chunk(2, -1)            # each [B,L,256]
41	      x_main = SiLU(conv1d(x_main.transpose(1,2)).transpose(1,2))   # depthwise, NON-causal
42	      x_dbc = x_proj(x_main)                                  # [B,L,40]
43	      dt, B, C = x_dbc.split([8, 16, 16], -1)
44	      y = _selective_scan(x_main, dt_proj(dt), B, C)          # dt_proj INCLUDES its bias
45	      y = out_proj((y + x_main * D) * SiLU(z))
46	      return norm(y + residual)
47	
48	  _selective_scan(x, dt, B, C)  (:422-441 — the PYTHON FALLBACK, the ground truth
49	  the race runs since mamba_scan_kernel.cu is absent and CPU forces is_cuda=False):
50	      A = -exp(A_log)                  # [256,16]
51	      dt = softplus(dt)                # softplus applied INSIDE the scan
52	      h = 0  [B, 256, 16]
53	      for t in 0..L-1:
54	        dt_t = dt[:,t,:].unsqueeze(-1)                        # [B,256,1]
55	        h = exp(dt_t * A) * h + (dt_t * B[:,t,:].unsqueeze(1)) * x[:,t,:].unsqueeze(-1)
56	        y_t = (h * C[:,t,:].unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1)             # [B,256]
57	      return stack(y_t)                                       # [B,L,256]

59	NUMERICS (each verified against autograd here, and the values the CUDA must use):
60	  * SiLU(x) = x * sigmoid(x); SiLU'(x) = sigmoid(x) * (1 + x*(1-sigmoid(x))).
61	  * softplus(x) = log(1+exp(x)); softplus'(x) = sigmoid(x).
62	  * Conv1d is NON-CAUSAL depthwise k=3 pad=1: y[t] = b + W0*x[t-1] + W1*x[t]
63	    + W2*x[t+1] (zero-pad outside [0,L)). The future-peek (W2*x[t+1]) is the #1
64	    index-bug site — the kernel mirror exists to catch it.
65	  * A = -exp(A_log): the (-exp) Jacobian folds into dA_log = dA * A  (since
66	    dA/dA_log = -exp(A_log) = A).
67	  * LayerNorm eps = 1e-5 (torch default). Backward dx uses the two
68	    mean-correction terms.
69	  * CrossEntropy MEAN over B: dlogits = (softmax - onehot) / B. Head width p=97
70	    (distinct from the 99-token embedding / 99-row tok table).
71	
72	GRADIENT-TOPOLOGY (multi-path sums — each easy to half-implement):
73	  * x_main fans out to THREE consumers: x_proj (:445), the scan's x (:447),
74	    and the D-skip (:448 `x_main * D`). dx_main = sum of all three paths.
75	  * the layer input x fans out to TWO: in_proj (:443) and the end residual
76	    (:449 `norm(y + residual)`). dx = in_proj-path + residual-path.
77	  * softplus is INSIDE _selective_scan; dt_proj (with bias) is OUTSIDE. The
78	    scan's ddt is w.r.t. POST-softplus dt; multiply by sigmoid(pre-softplus) to
79	    reach dt_proj's output, then backprop dt_proj's weight/bias.

113	def sigmoid(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
114	    return torch.sigmoid(x)

117	def silu(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
118	    return x * torch.sigmoid(x)

121	def silu_grad(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
122	    # d/dx [x*sig(x)] = sig(x) + x*sig(x)*(1-sig(x)) = sig(x)*(1 + x*(1-sig(x))).
123	    s = torch.sigmoid(x)
124	    return s * (1.0 + x * (1.0 - s))

132	    # d/dx log(1+exp(x)) = sigmoid(x).

137	# LayerNorm fwd/bwd (eps=1e-5), over the last dim (size d). Affine (gamma,beta).
138	# (Same formulation as decoder_oracle.layernorm_*.)
139	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
140	def layernorm_forward(x, gamma, beta, eps=LN_EPS):
141	    mu = x.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
142	    xc = x - mu
143	    var = (xc * xc).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
144	    inv_std = 1.0 / torch.sqrt(var + eps)
145	    xhat = xc * inv_std
146	    y = xhat * gamma + beta
147	    return y, (xhat, inv_std, gamma)
148

150	def layernorm_backward(dy, cache):
151	    xhat, inv_std, gamma = cache
152	    d = xhat.shape[-1]
153	    reduce_axes = tuple(range(dy.dim() - 1))
154	    dbeta = dy.sum(dim=reduce_axes)
155	    dgamma = (dy * xhat).sum(dim=reduce_axes)
156	    dxhat = dy * gamma
157	    sum_dxhat = dxhat.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
158	    sum_dxhat_xhat = (dxhat * xhat).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
159	    dx = inv_std * (dxhat - (sum_dxhat + xhat * sum_dxhat_xhat) / d)
160	    return dx, dgamma, dbeta

201	    Returns dict with: names, offsets (elements into the flat buffer), sizes,
202	    shapes, total (== 259425), n_tensors (== 28). The offsets follow

218	                shapes=[s for _, s in spec], total=off, n_tensors=len(spec))

265	# ===========================================================================
266	#  SELECTIVE SCAN — forward + MANUAL backward (the hardest piece).
267	#  Operates per (batch, channel j in [0,d_inner)) with a state vector h[STATE].
268	#
269	#  FORWARD recurrence (eager :437-440, with dt already = softplus(dt_pre)):
270	#    A[j,s] = -exp(A_log[j,s])
271	#    h_{t}[s] = exp(dt[t,j] * A[j,s]) * h_{t-1}[s] + dt[t,j] * B[t,s] * x[t,j]
272	#    y[t,j]   = sum_s C[t,s] * h_{t}[s]                       (h_{-1} = 0)
273	#
274	#  Let  a_t[s] = exp(dt[t,j]*A[j,s])  (the per-step decay),
275	#       g_t[s] = dt[t,j]*B[t,s]*x[t,j]  (the per-step input).
276	#  Then h_t = a_t * h_{t-1} + g_t  and  y_t = <C_t, h_t>.
277	#
278	#  BACKWARD DERIVATION (reverse-time; inputs: dy[t,j] = dL/dy[t,j]).
279	#  Carry an adjoint  gh[s] = dL/dh_t[s]  flowing back through time. Process t
280	#  from L-1 down to 0. At step t we already hold gh = dL/dh_t accumulated from
281	#  all FUTURE timesteps' dependence on h_t THROUGH the recurrence
282	#  h_{t+1}=a_{t+1} h_t + g_{t+1} (i.e. the part carried in from t+1). Add this
283	#  step's direct contribution from y_t = <C_t, h_t>:
284	#       gh[s] += C[t,s] * dy[t,j]                              (y_t depends on h_t)
285	#  Now gh[s] = full dL/dh_t[s]. Emit the leaf grads at t:
286	#       dC[t,s]  = h_t[s] * dy[t,j]                            (from y_t=<C,h_t>)
287	#       dB[t,s]  = dt[t,j] * x[t,j] * gh[s]                    (g_t = dt*B*x)
288	#       dx[t,j] += sum_s B[t,s] * dt[t,j] * gh[s]              (g_t depends on x)
289	#       ddt[t,j]+= sum_s ( A[j,s]*a_t[s]*h_{t-1}[s] + B[t,s]*x[t,j] ) * gh[s]
290	#                  (a_t = exp(dt*A) -> da_t/ddt = A*a_t; g_t -> dg/ddt = B*x)
291	#       dA[j,s] += dt[t,j]*a_t[s]*h_{t-1}[s] * gh[s]           (da_t/dA = dt*a_t)
292	#  Propagate the adjoint to the previous state via h_t = a_t h_{t-1} + g_t:
293	#       gh[s] <- a_t[s] * gh[s]                                (= dL/dh_{t-1}[s])
294	#  After t=0, gh = dL/dh_{-1} = 0 contribution (h_{-1}=0, discarded). Finally
295	#       dA_log[j,s] = dA[j,s] * A[j,s]   (A = -exp(A_log) -> dA/dA_log = A).
296	#
297	#  This MATCHES csrc/scan/mamba_scan_adapter.cuh::scan_backward_kernel (cross-
298	#  checked): there grad_C=h_t*gy, grad_h+=cv*gy, grad_B=dt*x*grad_h,
299	#  grad_x+=B*dt*grad_h, grad_dt+=(A*A_bar*h_{t-1}+B*x)*grad_h,
300	#  grad_A_acc+=dt*A*A_bar*h_{t-1}*grad_h, grad_h=A_bar*grad_h, then
301	#  grad_A_log = grad_A_acc (it stores dA already folded with A in the +=,
302	#  because A_bar uses A and the A-derivative term carries the extra A). NOTE the
303	#  adapter folds (-exp) by carrying A inside the accumulation; here we fold it
304	#  explicitly as dA_log = dA*A at the end — algebraically identical.
305	# ===========================================================================
306	def selective_scan_forward(x, dt_pre, B, C, A_log):
307	    """x,dt_pre: [Bt,L,d_inner]; B,C: [Bt,L,state]; A_log: [d_inner,state].
308	    dt_pre is dt_proj(dt) BEFORE softplus (softplus is applied here, as eager
309	    does inside _selective_scan). Returns (y, cache)."""
310	    Bt, L, di = x.shape
311	    A = -torch.exp(A_log)                       # [di, state]
312	    dt = softplus(dt_pre)                        # [Bt,L,di]
313	    h = torch.zeros(Bt, di, STATE, dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
314	    ys = []
315	    h_hist = []   # h_hist[t] = h AFTER step t (i.e. h_t)   [Bt,di,state]
316	    for t in range(L):
317	        dt_t = dt[:, t, :].unsqueeze(-1)         # [Bt,di,1]
318	        a_t = torch.exp(dt_t * A.unsqueeze(0))   # [Bt,di,state]
319	        g_t = (dt_t * B[:, t, :].unsqueeze(1)) * x[:, t, :].unsqueeze(-1)
320	        h = a_t * h + g_t
321	        h_hist.append(h.clone())
322	        ys.append((h * C[:, t, :].unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1))   # [Bt,di]
323	    y = torch.stack(ys, dim=1)                   # [Bt,L,di]
324	    cache = dict(x=x, dt_pre=dt_pre, dt=dt, B=B, C=C, A_log=A_log, A=A,
325	                 h_hist=h_hist)
326	    return y, cache
327	
328	
329	def selective_scan_backward(dy, cache):
330	    """dy: [Bt,L,d_inner] = dL/dy. Returns (dx, ddt_pre, dB, dC, dA_log).
331	    ddt_pre is the grad w.r.t. the PRE-softplus dt (dt_proj output) — softplus's
332	    Jacobian (sigmoid) is folded in here so callers backprop dt_proj directly."""
333	    x, dt_pre, dt = cache["x"], cache["dt_pre"], cache["dt"]
334	    B, C, A = cache["B"], cache["C"], cache["A"]
335	    h_hist = cache["h_hist"]
336	    Bt, L, di = x.shape
337	    dx = torch.zeros_like(x)
338	    ddt = torch.zeros_like(dt)                   # grad w.r.t. POST-softplus dt
339	    dB = torch.zeros_like(B)
340	    dC = torch.zeros_like(C)
341	    dA = torch.zeros_like(A)                     # grad w.r.t. A (=-exp(A_log))
342	    gh = torch.zeros(Bt, di, STATE, dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)  # dL/dh_t carry
343	    for t in reversed(range(L)):
344	        dt_t = dt[:, t, :].unsqueeze(-1)         # [Bt,di,1]
345	        a_t = torch.exp(dt_t * A.unsqueeze(0))   # [Bt,di,state]
346	        h_t = h_hist[t]                          # [Bt,di,state]
347	        h_tm1 = h_hist[t - 1] if t > 0 else torch.zeros_like(h_t)
348	        dy_t = dy[:, t, :].unsqueeze(-1)         # [Bt,di,1]
349	        # y_t = <C_t, h_t> contributes to dC and to dL/dh_t:
350	        dC[:, t, :] = (h_t * dy_t).sum(1)        # sum over di? NO — per (b,state)
351	        # ^ careful: y[t,j] = sum_s C[t,s]*h_t[j,s]; C is shared across j (per b).
352	        #   dC[b,t,s] = sum_j h_t[b,j,s]*dy[b,t,j]. So sum over di (dim=1). OK.
353	        gh = gh + C[:, t, :].unsqueeze(1) * dy_t  # [Bt,di,state]  full dL/dh_t
354	        # leaf grads at t:
355	        Bt_t = B[:, t, :].unsqueeze(1)           # [Bt,1,state]
356	        x_t = x[:, t, :].unsqueeze(-1)           # [Bt,di,1]
357	        # dB[b,t,s] = sum_j dt[b,t,j]*x[b,t,j]*gh[b,j,s]
358	        dB[:, t, :] = (dt_t * x_t * gh).sum(1)
359	        # dx[b,t,j] = sum_s B[b,t,s]*dt[b,t,j]*gh[b,j,s]
360	        dx[:, t, :] = (Bt_t * dt_t * gh).sum(-1)
361	        # ddt[b,t,j] = sum_s ( A[j,s]*a_t*h_{t-1} + B[t,s]*x[t,j] ) * gh
362	        ddt[:, t, :] = ((A.unsqueeze(0) * a_t * h_tm1 + Bt_t * x_t) * gh).sum(-1)
363	        # dA[j,s] += sum_b dt*a_t*h_{t-1}*gh   (A shared across batch)
364	        dA = dA + (dt_t * a_t * h_tm1 * gh).sum(0)
365	        # propagate adjoint to h_{t-1}: h_t = a_t h_{t-1} + g_t
366	        gh = a_t * gh
367	    # A = -exp(A_log) -> dA_log = dA * dA/dA_log = dA * (-exp(A_log)) = dA * A.
368	    dA_log = dA * A
369	    # softplus: dt = softplus(dt_pre) -> ddt_pre = ddt * sigmoid(dt_pre).
370	    ddt_pre = ddt * softplus_grad(dt_pre)
371	    return dx, ddt_pre, dB, dC, dA_log
372

374	# ===========================================================================
375	#  Depthwise NON-CAUSAL conv1d (k=3, pad=1) fwd/bwd, per channel over time.
376	#    fwd: y[b,t,c] = conv_b[c] + sum_{k=0..2} W[c,0,k] * x[b, t+k-1, c]
377	#         (x out of [0,L) is zero — pad=1; k=0->t-1, k=1->t, k=2->t+1).
378	#    bwd: dW[c,0,k] = sum_{b,t} dy[b,t,c]*x[b,t+k-1,c]
379	#         db[c]     = sum_{b,t} dy[b,t,c]
380	#         dx[b,tt,c]= sum_{k: tt=t+k-1 in-range} W[c,0,k]*dy[b,t,c]
381	#                   = sum_{k} W[c,0,k]*dy[b, tt-k+1, c]  (dy index in [0,L))
382	# ===========================================================================
383	def conv1d_forward(x, W, b):
384	    """x: [Bt,L,d_inner]; W: [d_inner,1,3]; b: [d_inner]. Returns y [Bt,L,di]."""
385	    Bt, L, di = x.shape
386	    y = torch.zeros_like(x)
387	    for k in range(CONV_K):
388	        shift = k - 1   # tap k reads x[t+shift]
389	        Wk = W[:, 0, k]                          # [di]
390	        # x shifted so that y[t] += Wk * x[t+shift]; zero-pad ends.
391	        xs = torch.zeros_like(x)
392	        if shift == 0:
393	            xs = x
394	        elif shift < 0:           # read x[t-1]: valid for t>=1
395	            xs[:, -shift:, :] = x[:, :L + shift, :]
396	        else:                     # shift>0, read x[t+1]: valid for t<=L-2
397	            xs[:, :L - shift, :] = x[:, shift:, :]
398	        y = y + xs * Wk.view(1, 1, di)
399	    y = y + b.view(1, 1, di)
400	    return y
401	
402	
403	def conv1d_backward(dy, x, W):
404	    """dy,x: [Bt,L,di]; W: [di,1,3]. Returns (dx, dW, db)."""
405	    Bt, L, di = x.shape
406	    dx = torch.zeros_like(x)
407	    dW = torch.zeros_like(W)
408	    db = dy.sum(dim=(0, 1))                      # [di]
409	    for k in range(CONV_K):
410	        shift = k - 1
411	        Wk = W[:, 0, k].view(1, 1, di)           # [1,1,di]
412	        # dW[c,0,k] = sum_{b,t} dy[b,t,c]*x[b,t+shift,c]
413	        xs = torch.zeros_like(x)
414	        if shift == 0:
415	            xs = x
416	        elif shift < 0:
417	            xs[:, -shift:, :] = x[:, :L + shift, :]
418	        else:
419	            xs[:, :L - shift, :] = x[:, shift:, :]
420	        dW[:, 0, k] = (dy * xs).sum(dim=(0, 1))
421	        # dx contribution: x[t+shift] receives Wk*dy[t]; i.e. dx[tt] += Wk*dy[tt-shift]
422	        dyk = torch.zeros_like(dy)
423	        if shift == 0:
424	            dyk = dy
425	        elif shift < 0:           # tt = t-1 -> t = tt+1 ; dx[tt]+=Wk*dy[tt+1]
426	            dyk[:, :L + shift, :] = dy[:, -shift:, :]
427	        else:                     # tt = t+1 -> t = tt-1 ; dx[tt]+=Wk*dy[tt-1]
428	            dyk[:, shift:, :] = dy[:, :L - shift, :]
429	        dx = dx + dyk * Wk
430	    return dx, dW, db
431	
432	
433	# ===========================================================================
434	#  Linear fwd/bwd helpers: y = x @ W^T (+ b). W [out,in]. x [...,in].
435	# ===========================================================================
436	def linear_forward(x, W, b=None):
437	    y = x @ W.t()
438	    if b is not None:
439	        y = y + b
440	    return y
441	
442	
443	def linear_backward(dy, x, W, has_bias):
444	    """dy [...,out], x [...,in], W [out,in]. Returns (dx, dW, db|None).
445	    Reduces dW/db over all leading axes."""
446	    in_dim = W.shape[1]
447	    out_dim = W.shape[0]
448	    x2 = x.reshape(-1, in_dim)
449	    dy2 = dy.reshape(-1, out_dim)
450	    dW = dy2.t() @ x2                            # [out,in]

450	    dW = dy2.t() @ x2                            # [out,in]
451	    db = dy2.sum(0) if has_bias else None
452	    dx = (dy @ W).reshape(x.shape)
453	    return dx, dW, db
454	
455	
456	# ===========================================================================
457	#  ONE SelectiveSSMLayer forward (caches everything the manual backward needs).
458	# ===========================================================================
459	def ssm_layer_forward(L: Dict[str, torch.Tensor], x):
460	    """x: [Bt,Lseq,d_model]. Returns (out, cache). Mirrors eager :442-449."""
461	    residual = x
462	    xz = linear_forward(x, L["in_w"])            # [Bt,L,2*d_inner]
463	    x_main_raw, z = xz.split(D_INNER, dim=-1)    # each [Bt,L,d_inner]
464	    # depthwise NON-causal conv1d then SiLU
465	    conv = conv1d_forward(x_main_raw, L["conv_w"], L["conv_b"])  # [Bt,L,d_inner]
466	    x_main = silu(conv)
467	    # x_proj -> dt, B, C
468	    x_dbc = linear_forward(x_main, L["x_proj_w"])               # [Bt,L,40]
469	    dt_raw, Bmat, Cmat = x_dbc.split([DT_RANK, STATE, STATE], dim=-1)
470	    dt_pre = linear_forward(dt_raw, L["dt_proj_w"], L["dt_proj_b"])  # [Bt,L,d_inner]
471	    y_scan, scan_cache = selective_scan_forward(x_main, dt_pre, Bmat, Cmat,
472	                                                L["A_log"])
473	    # skip + gate: y = (y_scan + x_main * D) * silu(z)
474	    sz = silu(z)
475	    y_skip = y_scan + x_main * L["D"].view(1, 1, D_INNER)
476	    y_gated = y_skip * sz
477	    y_out = linear_forward(y_gated, L["out_w"])  # [Bt,L,d_model]
478	    r = y_out + residual
479	    out, ln_cache = layernorm_forward(r, L["n_w"], L["n_b"])
480	    cache = dict(x=x, xz=xz, x_main_raw=x_main_raw, z=z, conv=conv,
481	                 x_main=x_main, x_dbc=x_dbc, dt_raw=dt_raw, Bmat=Bmat,
482	                 Cmat=Cmat, dt_pre=dt_pre, y_scan=y_scan, scan_cache=scan_cache,
483	                 sz=sz, y_skip=y_skip, y_gated=y_gated, y_out=y_out, r=r,
484	                 ln_cache=ln_cache)
485	    return out, cache
486	
487	
488	def ssm_layer_backward(L: Dict[str, torch.Tensor], cache, dout):
489	    """dout: [Bt,Lseq,d_model] = dL/dout. Returns (dx, grads_dict) where
490	    grads_dict has the 11 per-layer parameter grads."""
491	    g = {}
492	    # out = LayerNorm(r) -> dr, dnorm_w, dnorm_b
493	    dr, dn_w, dn_b = layernorm_backward(dout, cache["ln_cache"])
494	    g["norm.weight"] = dn_w
495	    g["norm.bias"] = dn_b
496	    # r = y_out + residual(=x) -> dy_out = dr ; dx_residual = dr
497	    dy_out = dr
498	    dx_residual = dr.clone()
499	    # y_out = y_gated @ out_w^T -> dW_out, dy_gated
500	    dy_gated, dW_out, _ = linear_backward(dy_out, cache["y_gated"], L["out_w"], False)
501	    g["out_proj.weight"] = dW_out
502	    # y_gated = y_skip * sz -> dy_skip = dy_gated*sz ; dsz = dy_gated*y_skip
503	    sz = cache["sz"]
504	    dy_skip = dy_gated * sz
505	    dsz = dy_gated * cache["y_skip"]
506	    # sz = silu(z) -> dz = dsz * silu'(z)
507	    dz = dsz * silu_grad(cache["z"])
508	    # y_skip = y_scan + x_main * D -> dy_scan = dy_skip ; dD path + dx_main path
509	    dy_scan = dy_skip
510	    Dpar = L["D"].view(1, 1, D_INNER)
511	    dx_main = dy_skip * Dpar                      # path: D-skip
512	    g["D"] = (dy_skip * cache["x_main"]).sum(dim=(0, 1))   # [d_inner]
513	    # selective scan backward -> dx_main(scan path), ddt_pre, dB, dC, dA_log
514	    dx_scan, ddt_pre, dBmat, dCmat, dA_log = selective_scan_backward(
515	        dy_scan, cache["scan_cache"])
516	    g["A_log"] = dA_log
517	    dx_main = dx_main + dx_scan                   # path: scan x
518	    # dt_pre = dt_proj(dt_raw) -> dW_dt, db_dt, ddt_raw
519	    ddt_raw, dW_dt, db_dt = linear_backward(ddt_pre, cache["dt_raw"],
520	                                            L["dt_proj_w"], True)
521	    g["dt_proj.weight"] = dW_dt
522	    g["dt_proj.bias"] = db_dt
523	    # x_dbc = concat[dt_raw, Bmat, Cmat] -> dx_dbc
524	    dx_dbc = torch.cat([ddt_raw, dBmat, dCmat], dim=-1)        # [Bt,L,40]
525	    # x_dbc = x_proj(x_main) -> dW_xproj, dx_main path 3
526	    dx_main3, dW_xproj, _ = linear_backward(dx_dbc, cache["x_main"],
527	                                            L["x_proj_w"], False)
528	    g["x_proj.weight"] = dW_xproj
529	    dx_main = dx_main + dx_main3                  # path: x_proj
530	    # x_main = silu(conv) -> dconv = dx_main * silu'(conv)
531	    dconv = dx_main * silu_grad(cache["conv"])
532	    # conv1d backward -> dx_main_raw, dW_conv, db_conv
533	    dx_main_raw, dW_conv, db_conv = conv1d_backward(dconv, cache["x_main_raw"],
534	                                                    L["conv_w"])
535	    g["conv1d.weight"] = dW_conv
536	    g["conv1d.bias"] = db_conv
537	    # xz = [x_main_raw | z] -> dxz ; xz = in_proj(x) -> dW_in, dx_inproj
538	    dxz = torch.cat([dx_main_raw, dz], dim=-1)                # [Bt,L,2*d_inner]
539	    dx_inproj, dW_in, _ = linear_backward(dxz, cache["x"], L["in_w"], False)
540	    g["in_proj.weight"] = dW_in
541	    # x fans out to in_proj AND residual:
542	    dx = dx_inproj + dx_residual
543	    return dx, g
544	
545	
546	# ===========================================================================
547	#  FULL MODEL forward + manual backward.
548	# ===========================================================================
549	def mamba_forward(W: MambaWeights, tokens: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor):
550	    """tokens: [B, SEQ] int64 in [0,VOCAB). targets: [B] int64 in [0,P_HEAD).
551	    Returns (loss_scalar, cache). loss = mean-over-batch CE on the LAST-position
552	    logits (head width P_HEAD)."""
553	    Bt, S = tokens.shape
554	    device = W.tok.device
555	    pos_ids = torch.arange(S, device=device)
556	    h = W.tok[tokens] + W.pos[pos_ids].unsqueeze(0)           # [B,S,d]
557	    layer_caches = []
558	    for li in range(N_LAYERS):
559	        h, lc = ssm_layer_forward(W.layers[li], h)
560	        layer_caches.append(lc)
561	    h_last = h[:, -1, :]                                       # [B,d]
562	    hn, norm_cache = layernorm_forward(h_last, W.norm_w, W.norm_b)
563	    logits = hn @ W.out_w.t() + W.out_b                        # [B,P_HEAD]
564	    m = logits.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
565	    logz = m.squeeze(-1) + torch.log(torch.exp(logits - m).sum(dim=-1))
566	    nll = logz - logits.gather(1, targets.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)
567	    loss = nll.mean()
568	    cache = dict(Bt=Bt, S=S, tokens=tokens, targets=targets,
569	                 layer_caches=layer_caches, h_last=h_last, hn=hn,
570	                 norm_cache=norm_cache, logits=logits)
571	    return loss, cache
572	
573	
574	def mamba_backward(W: MambaWeights, cache) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
575	    Bt, S = cache["Bt"], cache["S"]
576	    targets = cache["targets"]
577	    tokens = cache["tokens"]
578	    grads: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
579	    # CE backward: dlogits = (softmax - onehot)/B
580	    logits = cache["logits"]
581	    m = logits.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
582	    e = torch.exp(logits - m)
583	    sm = e / e.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
584	    onehot = torch.zeros_like(sm)
585	    onehot.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0)
586	    dlogits = (sm - onehot) / Bt                              # [B,P_HEAD]
587	    # head: logits = hn @ out_w^T + out_b
588	    hn = cache["hn"]
589	    grads["out.weight"] = dlogits.t() @ hn                    # [P_HEAD,d]
590	    grads["out.bias"] = dlogits.sum(dim=0)
591	    dhn = dlogits @ W.out_w                                   # [B,d]
592	    # final norm backward
593	    dh_last, dnorm_w, dnorm_b = layernorm_backward(dhn, cache["norm_cache"])
594	    grads["norm.weight"] = dnorm_w
595	    grads["norm.bias"] = dnorm_b
596	    # upstream into last layer output: only LAST position has grad.
597	    dh = torch.zeros(Bt, S, D_MODEL, device=hn.device, dtype=hn.dtype)
598	    dh[:, -1, :] = dh_last
599	    # per-layer backward (reverse)
600	    for li in reversed(range(N_LAYERS)):
601	        dh, lg = ssm_layer_backward(W.layers[li], cache["layer_caches"][li], dh)
602	        for k, v in lg.items():
603	            grads[f"layers.{li}.{k}"] = v
604	    # embedding backward: h0 = tok[tokens] + pos[pos_ids]
605	    dtok = torch.zeros_like(W.tok)
606	    dtok.index_add_(0, tokens.reshape(-1), dh.reshape(-1, D_MODEL))
607	    grads["tok.weight"] = dtok
608	    grads["pos.weight"] = dh.sum(dim=0)                       # [S,d]
609	    return grads
610	
611	
612	def oracle_loss_and_grads(named_params: Dict[str, torch.Tensor],
613	                          tokens: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor):
614	    """Run the manual fwd+bwd over a dict of named parameter tensors.
615	    Returns (loss_float, grads_named) — the 28 Mamba tensors."""
616	    W = MambaWeights.from_named(named_params)
617	    loss, cache = mamba_forward(W, tokens, targets)
618	    grads = mamba_backward(W, cache)
619	    return loss.item(), grads

6	these multi-step checks as the load-bearing complement — but they were NEVER

10	    step 1 ‖g‖₂≈0.72 < grad_clip=1.0 so the kernel's P2.5 clip is INERT and a
11	    dropped clip would still pass. The clip FIRES later (the documented onset is
12	    ~step 50 for the decoder), so only a multi-step run that crosses the clip
13	    threshold exercises it. test_grokadamw_multistep_parity drives ~60 fused
14	    steps and an fp64 GrokAdamW reference SIDE-BY-SIDE on the kernel's own
15	    TC-reduced grad, asserts params match the gate's tol at {1, 50, 60}, asserts
16	    the clip condition ‖g‖>max_norm ACTUALLY occurred by step 50 (so the test
17	    cannot vacuously pass on a coincidentally-small norm), and re-runs the whole
18	    60-step fused trajectory twice more bit-identical (A/A/A).

21	    trajectory anchor param_init == params so r = Σ d²·<g, p0−p> = 0 ⇒ d stays
22	    frozen at d0=1e-6 (the cold start). The DEFINING prodigy mechanism (the
23	    adaptive d grown from the cumulative parameter trajectory) only fires at

30	    the fp64 reference state IDENTICALLY at step 2 (so p0−p = delta is nonzero +

165	# ── fp64 GrokAdamW reference state (flat, in named_parameters() order). ─────────
166	class _GrokAdamWRef:
167	    """Pure-fp64 multi-step GrokAdamW driver (the side-by-side reference that
168	    REPLACES the removed eager opt.step()).
169	
170	    Holds the fp64 [m | v | ema] state flat in named-parameters() order and drives
171	    the canonical ref_grokadamw_step PER TENSOR each step (each tensor with its
172	    PUBLISHED layer-wise β1_i = β1·(1−γ)^layer_index, so bc1 = 1−β1_i^t is per-tensor
173	    too — matching the kernel's P3). The GLOBAL grad-norm clip is applied to the flat
174	    reduced grad BEFORE the per-tensor tail (matching the kernel's P2.5 and the eager
175	    clip_grad_norms_device_side: clip_coef = grad_clip/(‖g‖₂+1e-6) when ‖g‖₂>max_norm).
176	
177	    The gradient-EMA is seeded with the FIRST step's (unclipped) grad — exactly the
178	    kernel + eager seed (grokadamw.py:303 seeds state["ema"] = grads_by_id[id(p)] from
179	    the raw grad BEFORE the in-kernel clip; at step 1 the clip is inert for the decoder
180	    so seed==clipped anyway). α is α_init the whole way (no train/val signal is fed in
181	    this run, so _signal_active stays False — see _opt_scalars_from / _alpha_for_group).
182	    """
183	
184	    def __init__(self, named, c):
185	        self.sizes = [int(p.numel()) for _, p in named]
186	        self.shapes = [tuple(p.shape) for _, p in named]
187	        self.dev = named[0][1].device
188	        total = sum(self.sizes)
189	        # fp64 per-tensor state, flat (named order).
190	        self.m = [torch.zeros(s, dtype=torch.float64, device=self.dev) for s in self.sizes]
191	        self.v = [torch.zeros(s, dtype=torch.float64, device=self.dev) for s in self.sizes]
192	        self.ema = None    # seeded with the first grad (kernel/eager-faithful)
193	        # PUBLISHED hyperparameters (the SAME values _grokadamw_factory passes; eps is
194	        # the GrokAdamW constructor default 1e-8, which is also what _opt_scalars_from
195	        # forwards to the kernel from the optimizer's group).
196	        self.beta1 = float(c["beta1"])
197	        self.beta2 = float(c["beta2"])
198	        self.gamma = float(c.get("grokadamw_gamma", 0.1))
199	        self.alpha = float(c.get("grokadamw_alpha", 0.98))   # α_init (no signal ⇒ stays here)
200	        self.lamb = float(c.get("grokadamw_lamb", 2.0))
201	        self.lr = float(c["lr"])
202	        self.wd = float(c["weight_decay"])
203	        self.eps = 1e-8
204	        self.max_norm = float(c.get("grokadamw_grad_clip", 1.0))
205	        # PUBLISHED layer-wise β1 = β1·(1−γ)^i across the FLAT param enumeration (the
206	        # SAME global-order formula as grokadamw.py:_layer_beta1_by_id and
207	        # _opt_scalars_from's per-tensor β1). gamma=0 ⇒ a single global β1.
208	        self.beta1s = [self.beta1 * ((1.0 - self.gamma) ** i)
209	                       for i in range(len(self.sizes))]
210	
211	    def _clip(self, flat_grad):
212	        """GLOBAL grad-norm clip on the flat reduced grad (kernel P2.5 / eager
213	        clip_grad_norms_device_side). Returns the (possibly clipped) flat grad and
214	        the pre-clip global L2 norm (the clip discriminant the test records)."""
215	        g64 = flat_grad.detach().to(torch.float64)
216	        gnorm = g64.norm().item()
217	        if self.max_norm > 0.0 and gnorm > self.max_norm:
218	            g64 = g64 * (self.max_norm / (gnorm + 1e-6))
219	        return g64, gnorm
220	
221	    def step(self, flat_grad, t):
222	        """One fp64 GrokAdamW step on the flat reduced grad. Returns the pre-clip
223	        global grad norm (the clip discriminant)."""
224	        g_raw = flat_grad.detach().to(torch.float64)        # UNCLIPPED (the ema seed)
225	        g_clip, gnorm = self._clip(flat_grad)               # CLIPPED (filter + amp + tail)
226	        # Per-tensor split of BOTH the clipped and the raw flat grad (named order).
227	        gslices, graw_slices = [], []
228	        off = 0
229	        for n in self.sizes:
230	            gslices.append(g_clip[off:off + n])
231	            graw_slices.append(g_raw[off:off + n])
232	            off += n
233	        if self.ema is None:
234	            # COLD-START: seed the gradient-EMA with the FIRST step's UNCLIPPED grad —
235	            # BYTE-FAITHFUL to the kernel + eager (opt_components.cuh:451 `if (step==1)
236	            # st.ema[idx] = grad[idx]`; grokadamw.py:303 clones state["ema"] from the
237	            # RAW grad BEFORE the in-place clip). The EMA FILTER + amplification below
238	            # then run on the CLIPPED grad (gc), so seeding the unclipped grad is what
239	            # keeps the m/ema state matching the kernel when the clip FIRES (when it is
240	            # inert, raw==clipped and this is identical). ref_grokadamw_step computes
241	            # ema_new = alpha*ema_prev + (1-alpha)*g with g==gc, so passing the clipped
242	            # gs as g and the unclipped seed as ema_prev reproduces the kernel exactly.
243	            self.ema = [gr.clone() for gr in graw_slices]
244	        for i, gs in enumerate(gslices):
245	            # The canonical per-tensor fp64 GrokAdamW step with THIS tensor's β1_i
246	            # (and hence bc1_i = 1−β1_i^t computed inside ref_grokadamw_step).
247	            p_new, m_new, v_new, ema_new = ref_grokadamw_step(
248	                self._params[i], gs, self.m[i], self.v[i], self.ema[i],
249	                alpha=self.alpha, lamb=self.lamb, lr=self.lr,
250	                beta1=self.beta1s[i], beta2=self.beta2, eps=self.eps,
251	                wd=self.wd, t=t)
252	            self._params[i].data.copy_(p_new.reshape(self.shapes[i]))
253	            self.m[i] = m_new
254	            self.v[i] = v_new
255	            self.ema[i] = ema_new
256	        return gnorm
257	
258	    def bind_params(self, named):
259	        """Bind the live (fp64) param tensors this driver updates in place."""
260	        self._params = [p for _, p in named]
261	
262	    def flat_state(self, total):
263	        """Flat [m | v | ema] (fp64) for the (1b) state parity comparison."""
264	        m = torch.cat([x.reshape(-1) for x in self.m])
265	        v = torch.cat([x.reshape(-1) for x in self.v])
266	        ema = torch.cat([x.reshape(-1) for x in self.ema])
267	        return m, v, ema

270	def _mk_prodigy(g, params, c, d0, d_coef):
271	    """Build the REAL Prodigy carrying the production hyperparameters, with
272	    d0/d_coef OVERRIDABLE. Used here ONLY as the live SCALAR SOURCE the kernel reads
273	    through _opt_scalars_from (d0/d_coef/beta3) — its .step() is NOT called; the
274	    reference d-trajectory is the fp64 driver below.
275	
276	    MIRRORS tests.hw.test_l3tc_tail_gate._prodigy_factory (~:128-135) — the SAME
277	    lr=prodigy_lr (1.0), weight_decay, betas=(beta1,beta2) — but _prodigy_factory
278	    hard-codes the production d0=1e-6/d_coef=1.0 (at which d is INERT for the
279	    decoder), so it cannot exercise the d-update branch. The override is the whole
280	    reason this local builder exists; the d_coef=0 case is the d-frozen control."""
281	    return g.Prodigy(params, lr=c.get("prodigy_lr", 1.0),
282	                     weight_decay=c["weight_decay"],
283	                     betas=(c["beta1"], c["beta2"]),
284	                     d0=d0, d_coef=d_coef)

287	class _ProdigyRef:
288	    """Pure-fp64 multi-step Prodigy d-trajectory driver (the reference that REPLACES
289	    the removed eager opt.step()).
290	
291	    Drives the canonical ref_prodigy_partials + β3-EMA + d_coef + ref_prodigy_update_d
292	    + ref_prodigy_apply_step in the EXACT byte-faithful order of the kernel cell
293	    (fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh:1009-1052):
294	      d_prev = persisted d_lr (step 1: d0 cold-start)
295	      r_step,s_step = Σ d_prev²·<g,p0−p>, Σ d_prev²·|g|   (GLOBAL, at CURRENT params)
296	      r_ema  <- beta3·r_ema + r_step      (decay UNSCALED persisted r_ema, then add)
297	      s_ema  <- beta3·s_ema + s_step
298	      d_new   = max(d_prev, d_coef·r_ema/|s_ema|)         (d_coef scales ONLY candidate)
299	      apply AdamW with step size d_new; persist (r_ema UNSCALED, s_ema, d_new)
300	
301	    No grad-norm clip (Prodigy has no grad_clip; the eager prodigy_fused_step does not
302	    clip). The controlled anchor is injected into self.p_init identically to the kernel
303	    slot via reset_anchor()."""
304	
305	    def __init__(self, named, c, d0, d_coef):
306	        self.sizes = [int(p.numel()) for _, p in named]
307	        self.shapes = [tuple(p.shape) for _, p in named]
308	        self.dev = named[0][1].device
309	        self.m = [torch.zeros(s, dtype=torch.float64, device=self.dev) for s in self.sizes]
310	        self.v = [torch.zeros(s, dtype=torch.float64, device=self.dev) for s in self.sizes]
311	        self.s_track = [torch.zeros(s, dtype=torch.float64, device=self.dev) for s in self.sizes]
312	        # Trajectory anchor p0: seeded = the CURRENT params at the first step (eager-
313	        # faithful cold start, prodigy.py:127), so r = Σ d²·<g,p0−p> = 0 at step 1.
314	        self.p_init = None
315	        self.beta1 = float(c["beta1"])
316	        self.beta2 = float(c["beta2"])
317	        self.beta3 = math.sqrt(self.beta2)     # prodigy.py:178
318	        self.lr = float(c.get("prodigy_lr", 1.0))   # Prodigy step is d, not lr; kept for parity
319	        self.wd = float(c["weight_decay"])
320	        self.eps = 1e-8
321	        self.d0 = float(d0)
322	        self.d_coef = float(d_coef)
323	        # Persisted estimator scalars (mirror prodigy_persist[0/1/2] = r_ema/s_ema/d_lr).
324	        self.r_ema = 0.0
325	        self.s_ema = 0.0
326	        self.d_lr = float(d0)
327	
328	    def bind_params(self, named):
329	        self._params = [p for _, p in named]
330	
331	    def _seed_anchor_if_needed(self):
332	        if self.p_init is None:
333	            self.p_init = [p.detach().to(torch.float64).reshape(-1).clone()
334	                           for p in self._params]
335	
336	    def reset_anchor(self, delta):
337	        """Overwrite p0 = p_e + delta (the controlled anchor) and reset the persisted
338	        estimator to cold-start (d=d0, r_ema=s_ema=0). MIRRORS the kernel injection
339	        (_inject_anchor_kernel below). p_e == the CURRENT params at the inject step.
340	        delta is a FLAT fp64 tensor (whole-vector, named order)."""
341	        self.p_init = []
342	        off = 0
343	        for i, p in enumerate(self._params):
344	            n = self.sizes[i]
345	            base = p.detach().to(torch.float64).reshape(-1)
346	            self.p_init.append((base + delta[off:off + n].to(torch.float64)).clone())
347	            off += n
348	        self.d_lr = self.d0
349	        self.r_ema = 0.0
350	        self.s_ema = 0.0
351	
352	    def step(self, flat_grad, t):
353	        """One fp64 Prodigy step on the flat reduced grad. Returns d_new (the
354	        persisted d after this step)."""
355	        self._seed_anchor_if_needed()
356	        g64 = flat_grad.detach().to(torch.float64)
357	        gslices = []
358	        off = 0
359	        for n in self.sizes:
360	            gslices.append(g64[off:off + n])
361	            off += n
362	        d_prev = self.d_lr
363	        # (a) GLOBAL r,s partials at the CURRENT params vs p0, with d_prev (sum over
364	        #     ALL tensors — ref_prodigy_partials already returns per-tensor sums).
365	        r_step = torch.zeros((), dtype=torch.float64, device=self.dev)
366	        s_step = torch.zeros((), dtype=torch.float64, device=self.dev)
367	        for i, gs in enumerate(gslices):
368	            p_flat = self._params[i].detach().to(torch.float64).reshape(-1)
369	            r_i, s_i = ref_prodigy_partials(p_flat, self.p_init[i], gs, d_prev=d_prev)
370	            r_step = r_step + r_i
371	            s_step = s_step + s_i
372	        # (b) decay persisted (UNSCALED) r_ema/s_ema by beta3, then add this step's Σ.
373	        r_ema = self.beta3 * self.r_ema + float(r_step.item())
374	        s_ema = self.beta3 * self.s_ema + float(s_step.item())
375	        # (c) d = max(d_prev, d_coef·r_ema/|s_ema|). d_coef scales ONLY the candidate
376	        #     (ref_prodigy_update_d does max(d_prev, r/|s|) verbatim, so fold d_coef
377	        #     into the numerator copy — persisted r_ema stays UNSCALED, eager parity).
378	        d_new = ref_prodigy_update_d(d_prev, self.d_coef * r_ema, s_ema)
379	        self.r_ema = r_ema        # persist UNSCALED
380	        self.s_ema = s_ema
381	        self.d_lr = d_new
382	        # (d) apply AdamW with step size d_new (per tensor; same d across the cell).
383	        for i, gs in enumerate(gslices):
384	            p_flat = self._params[i].detach().to(torch.float64).reshape(-1)
385	            p_new, m_new, v_new, s_new = ref_prodigy_apply_step(
386	                p_flat, gs, self.m[i], self.v[i], self.s_track[i],
387	                d=d_new, beta1=self.beta1, beta2=self.beta2, eps=self.eps,
388	                wd=self.wd, t=t)
389	            self._params[i].data.copy_(p_new.reshape(self.shapes[i]))
390	            self.m[i] = m_new
391	            self.v[i] = v_new
392	            self.s_track[i] = s_new
393	        return d_new
394	
395	    def flat_state(self):
396	        m = torch.cat([x.reshape(-1) for x in self.m])
397	        v = torch.cat([x.reshape(-1) for x in self.v])
398	        s = torch.cat([x.reshape(-1) for x in self.s_track])
399	        return m, v, s

518	    # (including the clip's P2.5 reduction once it fires) trips this.
519	    def _run_trajectory():
520	        g_a, c_a, m_a, data_a, dev_a = _build_cell(model)
521	        tx_a, ty_a = data_a[0], data_a[1]
522	        opt_a = _grokadamw_factory(g_a, m_a.parameters(), c_a)
523	        cc = {}
524	        for st in range(1, GA_N_STEPS + 1):
525	            fused_train_step(canon, opt, m_a, opt_a, tx_a, ty_a, state_cache=cc,
526	                             step=st, return_grad=True, gemm_impl="wgmma")
527	        P = torch.empty(total, device=dev_a)
528	        o = 0
529	        for _, p in m_a.named_parameters():
530	            if p.requires_grad:
531	                k = p.numel()
532	                P[o:o + k].copy_(p.data.reshape(-1))
533	                o += k
534	        S = cc[canon]["state"][:3 * total].clone()   # [m|v|ema] at the end
535	        return P, S
536	    P1, S1 = _run_trajectory()
537	    P2, S2 = _run_trajectory()
538	    P3, S3 = _run_trajectory()
539	    assert torch.equal(P1, P2) and torch.equal(P2, P3), (
540	        f"grokadamw A/A/A FAILED: post-{GA_N_STEPS}-step params not bit-identical "
541	        f"across 3 runs (max|Δ| 1v2={ (P1-P2).abs().max().item():.3e}, "
542	        f"2v3={(P2-P3).abs().max().item():.3e}) — a nondeterministic race in the "
543	        f"60-step fused trajectory (clip reduction / grad reduce).")
544	    assert torch.equal(S1, S2) and torch.equal(S2, S3), (
545	        "grokadamw A/A/A FAILED: post-trajectory [m|v|ema] state not bit-identical "
546	        "across 3 runs.")
547	
548	
549	# ───────────────────────────── prodigy ─────────────────────────────
550	@pytest.mark.hw
551	@pytest.mark.skipif(not _gpu_ready(), reason="needs built extension on GPU")
552	def test_prodigy_multistep_parity():
553	    """~50 steps of the L3-TC fused decoder×prodigy cell vs a PURE fp64 Prodigy
554	    reference on identical init/data, both fed the kernel's own TC-reduced grad,
555	    with the d-adaptation FORCED to fire via a controlled anchor (the stable
556	    technique from tuning/_prodigy_owner_block_unit.py — at production
557	    d0=1e-6/d_coef=1.0 d is inert for the decoder, and natural trajectory forcing
558	    is NaN-unstable).
559	
560	    Asserts: (a) the kernel's PERSISTED d-estimate (state[4*total+3]) tracks the
561	    fp64 d each step to TOL; (b) d actually GREW off d0=1e-6 (the adaptation fired —
562	    not frozen); (c) params match the gate's tol at the final step; (d) a d-FROZEN
563	    control (d_coef=0 ⇒ d pinned at d0) DIVERGES from the adaptive run by step 50
564	    (proving the d-adaptation is load-bearing).
565	    """
566	    from grokking_optimizers.dispatch import (has_l3_real, gemm_impl_for_cell,
567	                                              canonicalize_model, fused_train_step)
568	    model, opt = "decoder", "prodigy"
569	    canon = canonicalize_model(model)
570	    assert has_l3_real(canon, opt), f"{model}×{opt} is not L3-REAL (register it first)"
571	    assert gemm_impl_for_cell(canon, opt, "bf16") == "wgmma", "bf16 engine != wgmma"
572	
573	    # The kernel's PERSISTED d lives at state[4*total+3] (the LAST scalar of the
574	    # prodigy state layout [m | v | s_track | loss | param_init(total) | r_ema |
575	    # s_ema | d_lr] = 4*total+4; see grokking_optimizers/dispatch.py ~:1828-1836).
576	    def _kernel_d(state):
577	        return float(state[4 * total + 3].item())
578	
579	    # ── (a)+(c) parity reference (d adapts) + (d) d-frozen control, identical init.
580	    g, c, m_k, data, dev = _build_cell(model)
581	    tx, ty = data[0], data[1]
582	    named_k = [(n, p) for n, p in m_k.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad]
583	    total = sum(p.numel() for _, p in named_k)
584	
585	    g2, c2, m_ref, data2, dev2 = _build_cell(model)
586	    named_ref = [(n, p) for n, p in m_ref.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad]
587	    assert torch.equal(_flat(named_k), _flat(named_ref)), "init mismatch (seed)"
588	    # The Prodigy object is the live SCALAR SOURCE the KERNEL reads through
589	    # _opt_scalars_from inside fused_train_step (d0/d_coef/beta3 + lr/betas/eps/wd).
590	    # Its .step() is NOT called; the reference is the fp64 d-trajectory driver below.
591	    opt_scalars = _mk_prodigy(g, m_k.parameters(), c, d0=PR_D0, d_coef=PR_D_COEF)
592	    ref = _ProdigyRef(named_ref, c2, d0=PR_D0, d_coef=PR_D_COEF)
593	    ref.bind_params(named_ref)
594	
595	    # d-FROZEN control: d_coef=0 ⇒ candidate d_coef·r/|s| = 0 ⇒ d = max(d_prev,0) =
596	    # d0 forever. SAME init, SAME fed grads, independent fp64 driver. If it DIVERGES
597	    # from the d-adapting reference, the d-adaptation is load-bearing (gate has teeth).
598	    g3, c3, m_ctl, data3, dev3 = _build_cell(model)
599	    named_ctl = [(n, p) for n, p in m_ctl.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad]
600	    ctl = _ProdigyRef(named_ctl, c3, d0=PR_D0, d_coef=0.0)
601	    ctl.bind_params(named_ctl)
602	
603	    # A controlled anchor delta (reproducible, device-pinned) injected IDENTICALLY
604	    # into the kernel state slot AND the fp64 references at step-2 entry, so p0−p =
605	    # delta is nonzero + EXACT on every side → the candidate clears d_prev and d MOVES
606	    # off d0 deterministically (the stable owner-block-unit technique).
607	    #
608	    # The SIGN of delta is load-bearing for d-MOVEMENT, not just its magnitude. The
609	    # Prodigy d-candidate is d_coef·r_ema/|s_ema| with r_ema ∝ <g, p0−p> = <g, delta>;
610	    # since d = max(d_prev, candidate), d only MOVES off d0 when that inner product is
611	    # POSITIVE. A sign-RANDOM delta gives <g, delta> ≈ 0 with a coin-flip sign — and
612	    # for the decoder's (and vit's) actual step-1 reduced grad it comes out NEGATIVE
613	    # (measured <g, delta>≈−3.6e-3 decoder / −3.2e-3 vit at seed 12345), so the
614	    # candidate is negative and d stays frozen at d0 → the vacuity guard (assert (b))
615	    # fires even though the kernel d-update is correct. (This was the latent bug in
616	    # the sign-random construction shared with tuning/_prodigy_owner_block_unit.py.)
617	    # Fix: build a reproducible MAGNITUDE and ALIGN its sign with the step-1 reduced
618	    # grad at injection time so <g, delta> = Σ|g|·|delta_mag| > 0 STRONGLY (≈+1.0),
619	    # which moves d deterministically off d0 while keeping the anchor EXACT + identical
620	    # on the kernel and both fp64 sides. delta is filled in-place at the inject step.
621	    gen = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(12345)
622	    delta_mag = torch.rand(total, generator=gen, device=dev) * PR_DELTA_SCALE  # |δ|∈[0,scale)
623	    delta = torch.zeros(total, device=dev)   # filled = delta_mag·sign(g) at inject step
624	
625	    def _inject_anchor_kernel(state):
626	        """Overwrite the kernel's param_init slice (state[3*total+1:4*total+1]) with
627	        flat(p_e)+delta and reset the persisted [r_ema|s_ema|d_lr] to cold-start.
628	        flat(p_e) == the cache `flat` (current params at step-2 entry)."""
629	        flat = cache[canon]["flat"]
630	        state[3 * total + 1:4 * total + 1].copy_(flat + delta)
631	        state[4 * total + 1] = 0.0      # r_ema
632	        state[4 * total + 2] = 0.0      # s_ema
633	        state[4 * total + 3] = PR_D0    # d_lr (persisted d_prev)
634	
635	    cache = {}
636	    worst_param = worst_m = worst_v = worst_s = worst_d = 0.0
637	    d_grew_step = None
638	    ctl_div_at_deadline = 0.0
639	    final_param_rel = None
640	
641	    for step in range(1, PR_N_STEPS + 1):
642	        # (1) ONE real TC megakernel step (real fwd+bwd+prodigy tail), wgmma. The
643	        #     kernel reads d0/d_coef/beta3 via _opt_scalars_from(opt_scalars).
644	        loss, grad = fused_train_step(canon, opt, m_k, opt_scalars, tx, ty,
645	                                      state_cache=cache, step=step,
646	                                      return_grad=True, gemm_impl="wgmma")
647	        assert loss == loss and not torch.isnan(grad).any(), (
648	            f"prodigy multi-step DIVERGED at step {step}: loss={loss} "
649	            f"grad_has_nan={bool(torch.isnan(grad).any())}")
650	
651	        # (2) fp64 reference (d adapts) fed the SAME reduced grad → the canonical
652	        #     d-trajectory (partials → β3-EMA → d_coef·max → AdamW-with-d). Returns d.
653	        eager_d = ref.step(grad, step)
654	
655	        # (3) d-frozen control (d_coef=0) fed the SAME reduced grad.
656	        ctl.step(grad, step)
657	
658	        # ── controlled-anchor injection at step-2 entry: AFTER step 1 has applied one
659	        # update on EVERY side (kernel + both fp64 refs), so p_e == the post-step-1
660	        # params on each side (matching the removed reference's order: kernel.step →
661	        # ref.step → ctl.step → inject). Fill delta = |delta_mag|·sign(g) using THIS
662	        # (step-1) reduced grad so the step≥2 d-update sees <g, delta> = Σ|g|·|delta_mag|
663	        # > 0 and d MOVES off d0 (a sign-random delta gives a coin-flip inner product
664	        # that is NEGATIVE here → d frozen at d0 → vacuous gate). Then overwrite p0 =
665	        # p_e + delta IDENTICALLY on the kernel state slot + both fp64 references (the
666	        # grad is byte-identical across all three), and reset the persisted (d=d0,
667	        # r_ema=s_ema=0). The kernel's `flat` holds the post-step-1 params here (the
668	        # megakernel updated it in place), so its p0 == post-step-1 + delta, matching
669	        # each fp64 reset_anchor (which reads its now-post-step-1 params). The step-2
670	        # reduction on every side then sees p0−p = delta and d moves off d0.
671	        if step == PR_ANCHOR_INJECT_STEP - 1:
672	            delta.copy_(delta_mag * grad.sign())
673	            _inject_anchor_kernel(cache[canon]["state"])
674	            ref.reset_anchor(delta)
675	            ctl.reset_anchor(delta)
676	
677	        # (4) compare kernel params/state/d vs the d-adapting reference.
678	        p_k = _flat(named_k)
679	        p_ref = _flat(named_ref)
680	        param_rel = _rel(p_k, p_ref)
681	        worst_param = max(worst_param, param_rel)
682	        final_param_rel = param_rel
683	
684	        kstate = cache[canon]["state"]
685	        k_m = kstate[0:total]
686	        k_v = kstate[total:2 * total]
687	        k_s = kstate[2 * total:3 * total]
688	        k_d = _kernel_d(kstate)
689	        r_m, r_v, r_s = ref.flat_state()
690	        worst_m = max(worst_m, _rel(k_m.double(), r_m))
691	        worst_v = max(worst_v, _rel(k_v.double(), r_v))
692	        worst_s = max(worst_s, _rel(k_s.double(), r_s))
693	        worst_d = max(worst_d, abs(k_d - eager_d) / (abs(eager_d) + 1e-30))
694	        if d_grew_step is None and eager_d > PR_D0 * 1.0001:
695	            d_grew_step = step
696	
697	        # (5) control divergence: d-frozen vs the d-adapting reference.
698	        ctl_div = _rel(_flat(named_ctl), p_ref)
699	        if step <= PR_CTRL_DEADLINE:
700	            ctl_div_at_deadline = max(ctl_div_at_deadline, ctl_div)
701	
702	    # ── ASSERT (a): the kernel's persisted d tracks the fp64 d the whole way (and
703	    # m/v/s state too) to fp32-reorder tol.
704	    finite = all(w == w for w in (worst_param, worst_m, worst_v, worst_s, worst_d))
705	    assert finite, "prodigy multi-step: a NaN entered the worst-reduction (run diverged)"
706	    assert worst_d < TOL, (
707	        f"prodigy multi-step: kernel persisted d does NOT track the fp64 d: "
708	        f"worst d_rel={worst_d:.3e} >= tol {TOL:.0e} — the in-kernel d-estimate "
709	        f"(beta3-EMA + d_coef + persist) diverged from the canonical fp64 d.")
710	    assert worst_m < TOL and worst_v < TOL and worst_s < TOL, (
711	        f"prodigy multi-step STATE parity FAIL: m={worst_m:.3e} v={worst_v:.3e} "
712	        f"s={worst_s:.3e} (tol {TOL:.0e}) — kernel [m|v|s_track] != fp64 Prodigy")
713	
714	    # ── ASSERT (b): d ACTUALLY grew off d0 (the adaptation fired — not frozen). If
715	    # the controlled anchor failed to move d, this run never exercised the d-update
716	    # branch and the whole gate would be vacuous.
717	    assert d_grew_step is not None, (
718	        f"prodigy multi-step: the fp64 d NEVER grew off d0={PR_D0:.0e} in "
719	        f"{PR_N_STEPS} steps — the controlled anchor (d_coef={PR_D_COEF}, "
720	        f"delta_scale={PR_DELTA_SCALE:.0e}) did not trip the candidate over d_prev, "
721	        f"so the d-adaptation never fired and the gate is vacuous.")
722	
723	    # ── ASSERT (c): params within tol at the FINAL step (the adaptive d has been
724	    # live since step 2, so this is parity UNDER an active d-adaptation).
725	    assert final_param_rel is not None and final_param_rel < TOL, (
726	        f"prodigy param parity FAIL at the final step ({PR_N_STEPS}): "
727	        f"rel={final_param_rel:.3e} >= tol {TOL:.0e} (d adapting since step 2)")
728	
729	    # ── ASSERT (d): the d-FROZEN control DIVERGES from the adaptive run by step 50,
730	    # proving the d-adaptation is load-bearing (the test has teeth — a kernel that
731	    # FROZE d would match this control, not the d-adapting reference asserted above).
732	    assert ctl_div_at_deadline > CTRL_MIN_DIVERGENCE, (
733	        f"prodigy multi-step: the d-FROZEN control (d_coef=0) did NOT diverge from "
734	        f"the d-adapting reference by step {PR_CTRL_DEADLINE} "
735	        f"(max ctl divergence={ctl_div_at_deadline:.3e} <= {CTRL_MIN_DIVERGENCE:.0e}) "
736	        f"— the d-adaptation is then not demonstrably load-bearing and the kernel's "
737	        f"d-tracking (a) could be a frozen-d coincidence.")

# Phase-0c digest: area `t_gate`

Files read IN FULL:
- `/workspace/SuperGrok1.5/tests/hw/test_l3tc_tail_gate.py` (1512 lines)
- `/workspace/SuperGrok1.5/tests/hw/sg2_kernel_mirror.py` (1001 lines)

## test_l3tc_tail_gate.py — the per-cell L3-TC conversion gate (owner baseline)

PURPOSE (docstring :1-33): per-cell gates for a newly-converted L3-TC cell are
(1) megakernel-vs-fp64 single-step (the in-kernel optimizer TAIL must match a
reference apply of the SAME canonical update on the SAME TC-reduced grad), and
(2) A/A/A determinism (production L3-TC step bit-identical across 3 runs from
same init: fixed tile ownership + ascending-k/t reduce). RE-ANCHOR task #10
(:9-13): eager per-op CUDA kernels DELETED; the reference is now the PURE-fp64
canonical transcription `ref_<opt>_step` in test_reference_parity.py applied PER
TENSOR on the kernel's captured grad + zero-init state. bf16 STAYS the compute
precision; fp64 is the yardstick. Tol: 1e-4 (fp32 reorder); SAM 2nd-backward
surfaces sharpness 3e-2 / sam_dir 2.5e-2 (bf16-TC-vs-fp64 floor).

### `_build_cell(model, seed)` (:551-570)
Builds the live race model + one real batch + the L3-REAL flat layout.
`c=dict(g.DEFAULT_CONFIG)` updated with model_type/use_amp=False/use_fused=True/
compile_model=False/matmul_precision="bf16"/seed/frac_train=0.5/val_ratio=0.10/
p=97. dev=cuda. data via `g.make_data_for_task(c,seed)`. DETERMINISM (load-bearing
for gate 2, :553-559): build_model draws from the global RNG (not c["seed"]), so
it `torch.manual_seed(seed)` + `torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)` IMMEDIATELY
before `g.build_model(c,dev)` so every rebuild returns byte-identical init params.
GATE_SEED env default 42 (:551).

### `_CELLS` (:292-539) — the converted cell registry (per cell: model, opt, factory[, tols])
Factories (:82-281) build the LIVE optimizer with EXACT production hyperparameters
(supply the kernel's scalars via `_opt_scalars_from` inside fused_train_step) —
the reference is the fp64 transcription, NOT the live opt.step().
Factories present: `_adamw_factory`, `_lion_factory`, `_grokfast_factory`,
`_grokadamw_factory` (grad_clip+gamma+kappa+lamb), `_muon_factory` (auto-splits
params by ndim: 2D→NS, else→AdamW), `_looksam_factory` (rho 0.05/k 5/alpha 0.7;
k=5 so step-1 IS a SAM step since `_global_step%k==0` at step 0),
`_prodigy_factory` (lr 1.0, d0 1e-6, d_coef 1.0), `_supergrok11_factory`,
`_supergrok15_factory`, `_neuralgrok_factory`.

Registered cells (each `dict(model=…, opt=…, factory=…)`):
adamw/{decoder,vit,mamba}; lion/{decoder,vit,mamba}; grokfast/{decoder,vit,mamba};
neuralgrok/{decoder,vit,mamba}; grokadamw/{decoder,vit,mamba};
prodigy/{decoder,vit,mamba}; muon/{vit,decoder,mamba} (param_tol=2e-3 for the NS
2D path; (1b) state stays 1e-4); looksam/{decoder,vit,mamba} (sam_dir_tol=2.5e-2);
supergrok11/{decoder,vit,mamba}, supergrok15/{decoder,vit,mamba}
(sharpness_tol=3e-2, mu_tol=3e-3); supergrok2/{decoder,vit,mamba} (factory=None).
adamw is the REGRESSION GUARD for the OptId-generic launcher refactor (opt_id=0
path with unconditional ema/psi-net binding; :284-291).

### Why SG2 factory is None (:519-538, :536-538)
`"supergrok2/decoder": dict(model="decoder", opt="supergrok2", factory=None)` (and
vit/mamba). SG2 is converted via the DEDICATED `ops.sg2_fused_step` entry — the
FULL CSA/HCA/PEER/GRU meta-net AS the optimizer phase (P3-SG2): in-kernel SEGMENTED
SORT (STAGE -1, index-tie-break strategy A) → S0..S5, reading st.sharpness from the
SAM 2nd backward (P2.4, shared with SG11/15). The SG2 gate has its OWN dedicated
entry `tests/hw/_sg2_l3tc_gate.run_sg2_gate`, so `run_cell_gate` SHORT-CIRCUITS to
it (:1075-1077) BEFORE any factory call — hence the cell needs no live-optimizer
factory (the SG2 gate validates against the PURE-fp64 `oracle_step` from
sg2_kernel_mirror, not a live opt.step()). `factory=None` is correct/by-design.

### `run_cell_gate(cell_key, verbose)` (:1062-1418) — gates (1)+(2)
- SG2 short-circuit (:1075-1077): `if opt=="supergrok2": from _sg2_l3tc_gate import
  run_sg2_gate; return run_sg2_gate(model, verbose=verbose)`.
- Preconditions (:1082-1084): `has_l3_real(canon,opt)` MUST be True; `gemm_impl_for_cell
  (canon,opt,"bf16")=="wgmma"` — else the gate is meaningless (production gates).
- (1) one production L3-TC step via `fused_train_step(canon,opt,m,opt_obj,tx,ty,
  state_cache=cache, step=1, return_grad=True, gemm_impl="wgmma")`, zero-init state.
- SG11/15 short-circuit to `_run_sg_cell_gate` (:1117-1121).
- fp64 reference per-tensor (:1226-1333): neuralgrok per-VECTOR via
  `_neuralgrok_canonical_mv`; else per-tensor ref_adamw/lion/grokfast/grokadamw/
  looksam/prodigy/muon_step. GLOBAL grad-norm clip `clip_coef` (:1150-1155): inert
  (coef=1) when ‖g‖₂≤grad_clip; fires e.g. GATE_SEED=7. grokadamw per-tensor
  β1=β1·(1-γ)^layeridx; ema seed = UNCLIPPED grad (:1276-1298). grokfast cold-starts
  ema=grad at step 1 (:1266-1275). looksam blends kernel's OWN sam_dir k_sam.
  prodigy d=d0=1e-6 at step 1 (param_init==params⇒r=0).
- THE fp64+A/A/A gate: (1a) params `rel_err<param_tol` (:1338-1347); (1b) STATE
  m/v/ema `<1e-4` (:1360-1392) — THE DECISIVE check (step-1 param update collapses
  to ≈sign(g_amp) so (1a) is blind to β1/amp/state-init; state catches it). looksam
  sam_dir validated SEPARATELY vs PURE-fp64 2nd backward at sam_dir_tol, folded into
  state_ok (:1371-1380). (2) A/A/A (:1394-1416): `_one()` rebuilds + runs step 3×;
  `det_ok = L1==L2==L3 and torch.equal(G…) and torch.equal(P…)`. `ok = tail_ok and
  det_ok`.

### `_run_sg_cell_gate` (:682-879) — SG11/15 dedicated gate, FOUR surfaces
Kernel state slices `[m|v|mu|loss|sharpness|phi_pack]` (:703-707). (A) sharpness vs
PURE-fp64 2nd backward `(g_sam−g)²` (:726-746) — asserts sam_on!=0, oracle sharpness
>1e-8, kernel sharpness>1e-8 (no-hollow-pass). (B) mu vs rescale·phi(g,sharpness)
using kernel's OWN sharpness + opt_obj.meta_net weights (:748-766). (1a)+(1b) apply
tail vs ref_sg11_step/ref_sg15_step with kernel's grad+mu+per-tensor gate (:768-810);
SG11 gate=sigmoid(gate_temp·cos(grad,m_start)), m_start is START-OF-STEP momentum (0
at cold step 1). (2) A/A/A also snapshots mu+sharpness slices (:848-869).

### `run_sg11_warmup_gate` (:882-1059) — the WARMUP gate (cos(grad,momentum) divergence)
The cold single-step gate is BLIND when mu≈0 ∧ momentum=0 at step 1 (cos(grad,mu)==
cos(grad,momentum)==gate(0.5) coincide). After ≥1 warmup step BOTH mu≠0 AND
exp_avg≠0 so the BUGGY cos(grad,mu) gate and the CANONICAL cos(grad,momentum) gate
genuinely differ. Builds opt with LARGE rescale=2.0 (:916-920) so smart_grad term
(1−gate)·alpha·mu is well above 1e-4 (a wrong gate would hide under tol otherwise).
Runs warmup_steps real steps on a shared cache (:931-934), captures start-of-step
m/v/p (:936-943), runs gated step (:948-950). Recovers the kernel's ACTUAL per-tensor
gate from k_m via least-squares: `sg_k=(k_m−β1·m0)/(1−β1)`, `(1−gate)·alpha=<sg_k−g,
mu>/<mu,mu>`, `gate_kernel=1−that/alpha` (:962-995). Verdict `gate_ok=(err_vs_momentum
<1e-2) and (err_vs_mu>1e-1)` (:1013) — FIXED kernel ≈1e-4..1e-3 to momentum, OLD
kernel ≈0.74..0.92 (3-orders separation). Asserts `mom_norm>1e-6` and
`gate_div>1e-4` (the warmup MUST exercise the divergence else demonstration is
