159	        p = f"layers.{li}."
160	        spec += [
161	            (p + "attn.in_proj_weight", (3 * D_MODEL, D_MODEL)),
162	            (p + "attn.in_proj_bias", (3 * D_MODEL,)),
163	            (p + "attn.out_proj.weight", (D_MODEL, D_MODEL)),
164	            (p + "attn.out_proj.bias", (D_MODEL,)),
165	            (p + "n1.weight", (D_MODEL,)),
166	            (p + "n1.bias", (D_MODEL,)),
167	            (p + "n2.weight", (D_MODEL,)),
168	            (p + "n2.bias", (D_MODEL,)),
169	            (p + "ff.0.weight", (D_FF, D_MODEL)),
170	            (p + "ff.0.bias", (D_FF,)),
171	            (p + "ff.2.weight", (D_MODEL, D_FF)),
172	            (p + "ff.2.bias", (D_MODEL,)),
173	        ]
174	    spec += [
175	        ("norm.weight", (D_MODEL,)),
176	        ("norm.bias", (D_MODEL,)),
177	        ("out.weight", (VOCAB, D_MODEL)),
178	        ("out.bias", (VOCAB,)),
179	    ]
180	    return spec
181	
182	
183	def decoder_param_layout() -> Dict[str, object]:
184	    """Flat-buffer layout: offsets/sizes per tensor (the megakernel ABI view).
185	
186	    Returns dict with: names, offsets (elements into the flat buffer), sizes,
187	    total (== 422755), n_tensors (== 30). The offsets follow named_parameters()
188	    order so the flat blob == torch.cat([p.reshape(-1) for _, p in
189	    model.named_parameters()]).
190	    """
191	    spec = decoder_param_spec()
192	    names, offsets, sizes = [], [], []
193	    off = 0
194	    for name, shape in spec:
195	        n = 1
196	        for s in shape:
197	            n *= s
198	        names.append(name)
199	        offsets.append(off)
200	        sizes.append(n)
201	        off += n
202	    return dict(names=names, offsets=offsets, sizes=sizes, shapes=[s for _, s in spec],
203	                total=off, n_tensors=len(spec))
204	
205	
206	@dataclass
207	class DecoderWeights:
208	    """All 30 decoder weights as named tensors. Built either from a flat buffer
209	    (the megakernel view) or from a torch nn module's named_parameters()."""
210	    tok: torch.Tensor
211	    pos: torch.Tensor
212	    layers: List[Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]
213	    norm_w: torch.Tensor
214	    norm_b: torch.Tensor
215	    out_w: torch.Tensor
216	    out_b: torch.Tensor
217	
218	    @staticmethod
219	    def from_named(named: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> "DecoderWeights":
220	        layers = []
221	        for li in range(N_LAYERS):
222	            p = f"layers.{li}."
223	            layers.append(dict(
224	                in_w=named[p + "attn.in_proj_weight"],
225	                in_b=named[p + "attn.in_proj_bias"],
226	                out_w=named[p + "attn.out_proj.weight"],
227	                out_b=named[p + "attn.out_proj.bias"],
228	                n1_w=named[p + "n1.weight"], n1_b=named[p + "n1.bias"],
229	                n2_w=named[p + "n2.weight"], n2_b=named[p + "n2.bias"],
230	                ff0_w=named[p + "ff.0.weight"], ff0_b=named[p + "ff.0.bias"],
231	                ff2_w=named[p + "ff.2.weight"], ff2_b=named[p + "ff.2.bias"],
232	            ))
233	        return DecoderWeights(
234	            tok=named["tok.weight"], pos=named["pos.weight"], layers=layers,
235	            norm_w=named["norm.weight"], norm_b=named["norm.bias"],
236	            out_w=named["out.weight"], out_b=named["out.bias"])
237	
238	    @staticmethod
239	    def from_flat(flat: torch.Tensor) -> "DecoderWeights":
240	        lay = decoder_param_layout()
241	        named = {}
242	        for name, off, sz, shape in zip(lay["names"], lay["offsets"],
243	                                        lay["sizes"], lay["shapes"]):
244	            named[name] = flat[off:off + sz].reshape(shape)
245	        return DecoderWeights.from_named(named)
246	
247	
248	def _causal_mask(seq: int, device, dtype) -> torch.Tensor:
249	    """Additive mask [seq, seq]: 0 where j<=i, -inf where j>i (triu diag=1)."""
250	    m = torch.triu(torch.ones(seq, seq, dtype=torch.bool, device=device), 1)
251	    add = torch.zeros(seq, seq, device=device, dtype=dtype)
252	    add = add.masked_fill(m, float("-inf"))
253	    return add
254	
255	
256	# ===========================================================================
257	#  FORWARD (manual, primitive ops) — caches everything the manual backward needs.
258	# ===========================================================================
259	def decoder_forward(W: DecoderWeights, tokens: torch.Tensor,
260	                    targets: torch.Tensor):
261	    """tokens: [B, SEQ] int64 in [0, VOCAB). targets: [B] int64.
262	
263	    Returns (loss_scalar, cache). loss = mean-over-batch cross-entropy on the
264	    LAST-position logits. cache holds every fwd intermediate for the backward.
265	    """
266	    B, S = tokens.shape
267	    device, dtype = W.tok.device, W.tok.dtype
268	    add_mask = _causal_mask(S, device, dtype)  # [S,S]
269	
270	    # Embedding + positional. pos_ids = arange(S).
271	    pos_ids = torch.arange(S, device=device)
272	    h = W.tok[tokens] + W.pos[pos_ids].unsqueeze(0)   # [B,S,d]
273	
274	    layer_caches = []
275	    for li in range(N_LAYERS):
276	        L = W.layers[li]
277	        x_in = h  # residual base for the attention sublayer
278	        # ----- self-attention (MultiheadAttention semantics) -----
279	        qkv = x_in @ L["in_w"].t() + L["in_b"]        # [B,S,3d]
280	        q, k, v = qkv.split(D_MODEL, dim=-1)
281	        # split heads: [B,S,d] -> [B,h,S,dh]
282	        def sh(t):
283	            return t.reshape(B, S, N_HEADS, D_HEAD).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
284	        qh, kh, vh = sh(q), sh(k), sh(v)
285	        scores = (qh @ kh.transpose(-2, -1)) * ATTN_SCALE   # [B,h,S,S]
286	        scores = scores + add_mask                          # causal
287	        attn = softmax_lastdim(scores)                      # [B,h,S,S]
288	        ctxh = attn @ vh                                     # [B,h,S,dh]
289	        ctx = ctxh.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, S, D_MODEL)  # merge heads
290	        a = ctx @ L["out_w"].t() + L["out_b"]               # [B,S,d]
291	        # ----- residual + n1 (POST-LN): x = n1(x_in + a) -----
292	        r1 = x_in + a
293	        x1, ln1_cache = layernorm_forward(r1, L["n1_w"], L["n1_b"])
294	        # ----- FFN: ff2(gelu(ff0(x1))) -----
295	        ff0 = x1 @ L["ff0_w"].t() + L["ff0_b"]              # [B,S,4d]
296	        g = gelu(ff0)                                        # [B,S,4d]
297	        ff2 = g @ L["ff2_w"].t() + L["ff2_b"]              # [B,S,d]
298	        # ----- residual + n2 (POST-LN): h = n2(x1 + ff2) -----
299	        r2 = x1 + ff2
300	        h2, ln2_cache = layernorm_forward(r2, L["n2_w"], L["n2_b"])
301	        layer_caches.append(dict(
302	            x_in=x_in, qkv=qkv, qh=qh, kh=kh, vh=vh, attn=attn, ctxh=ctxh,
303	            ctx=ctx, r1=r1, x1=x1, ln1_cache=ln1_cache, ff0=ff0, g=g, r2=r2,
304	            ln2_cache=ln2_cache))
305	        h = h2
306	
307	    # Final norm + head on the LAST position only.
308	    h_last = h[:, -1, :]                                   # [B,d]
309	    hn, norm_cache = layernorm_forward(h_last, W.norm_w, W.norm_b)
310	    logits = hn @ W.out_w.t() + W.out_b                    # [B,VOCAB]
311	    # Cross-entropy, mean over batch (numerically-stable log-softmax).
312	    m = logits.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
313	    logz = m.squeeze(-1) + torch.log(torch.exp(logits - m).sum(dim=-1))
314	    nll = logz - logits.gather(1, targets.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)
315	    loss = nll.mean()
316	    cache = dict(B=B, S=S, tokens=tokens, targets=targets,
317	                 layer_caches=layer_caches, h_last=h_last, hn=hn,
318	                 norm_cache=norm_cache, logits=logits, add_mask=add_mask)
319	    return loss, cache
320	
321	
322	# ===========================================================================
323	#  BACKWARD (manual, NO autograd) — returns grads for every named parameter.
324	# ===========================================================================
325	def decoder_backward(W: DecoderWeights, cache) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
326	    B, S = cache["B"], cache["S"]
327	    targets = cache["targets"]
328	    tokens = cache["tokens"]
329	    grads: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
330	
331	    # ----- CE backward: dlogits = (softmax - onehot) / B -----
332	    logits = cache["logits"]
333	    sm = softmax_lastdim(logits)                           # [B,VOCAB]
334	    onehot = torch.zeros_like(sm)
335	    onehot.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0)
336	    dlogits = (sm - onehot) / B                            # [B,VOCAB]
337	
338	    # ----- head (out): logits = hn @ out_w^T + out_b -----
339	    hn = cache["hn"]                                       # [B,d]
340	    grads["out.weight"] = dlogits.t() @ hn                 # [VOCAB,d]
341	    grads["out.bias"] = dlogits.sum(dim=0)                 # [VOCAB]
342	    dhn = dlogits @ W.out_w                                # [B,d]
343	
344	    # ----- final norm backward -----
345	    dh_last, dnorm_w, dnorm_b = layernorm_backward(dhn, cache["norm_cache"])
346	    grads["norm.weight"] = dnorm_w
347	    grads["norm.bias"] = dnorm_b
348	
349	    # Upstream into the last layer's output: only the LAST position has grad.
350	    dh = torch.zeros(B, S, D_MODEL, device=hn.device, dtype=hn.dtype)
351	    dh[:, -1, :] = dh_last
352	
353	    # ----- per-layer backward (reverse) -----
354	    for li in reversed(range(N_LAYERS)):
355	        L = W.layers[li]
356	        lc = cache["layer_caches"][li]
357	        gp = f"layers.{li}."
358	        # h2 = n2(r2);  dh is grad wrt h2.
359	        dr2, dn2_w, dn2_b = layernorm_backward(dh, lc["ln2_cache"])
360	        grads[gp + "n2.weight"] = dn2_w
361	        grads[gp + "n2.bias"] = dn2_b
362	        # r2 = x1 + ff2  -> grad flows to x1 (residual) AND ff2.
363	        dff2 = dr2
364	        dx1 = dr2.clone()
365	        # ff2 = g @ ff2_w^T + ff2_b
366	        g = lc["g"]                                        # [B,S,4d]
367	        grads[gp + "ff.2.weight"] = (dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t()
368	                                     @ g.reshape(-1, D_FF))   # [d,4d]
369	        grads[gp + "ff.2.bias"] = dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(dim=0)
370	        dg = dff2 @ W.layers[li]["ff2_w"]                  # [B,S,4d]
371	        # gelu backward
372	        dff0 = dg * gelu_grad(lc["ff0"])                   # [B,S,4d]
373	        # ff0 = x1 @ ff0_w^T + ff0_b
374	        x1 = lc["x1"]
375	        grads[gp + "ff.0.weight"] = (dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).t()
376	                                     @ x1.reshape(-1, D_MODEL))  # [4d,d]
377	        grads[gp + "ff.0.bias"] = dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).sum(dim=0)
378	        dx1 = dx1 + dff0 @ W.layers[li]["ff0_w"]           # add FFN path to x1
379	        # x1 = n1(r1) -> backward
380	        dr1, dn1_w, dn1_b = layernorm_backward(dx1, lc["ln1_cache"])
381	        grads[gp + "n1.weight"] = dn1_w
382	        grads[gp + "n1.bias"] = dn1_b
383	        # r1 = x_in + a -> grad to x_in (residual) AND a (attention out).
384	        da = dr1
385	        dx_in = dr1.clone()
386	        # a = ctx @ out_w^T + out_b
387	        ctx = lc["ctx"]                                    # [B,S,d]
388	        grads[gp + "attn.out_proj.weight"] = (da.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t()
389	                                              @ ctx.reshape(-1, D_MODEL))
390	        grads[gp + "attn.out_proj.bias"] = da.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(dim=0)
391	        dctx = da @ W.layers[li]["out_w"]                  # [B,S,d]
392	        # merge-heads backward: ctx[B,S,d] <- ctxh[B,h,S,dh]
393	        dctxh = dctx.reshape(B, S, N_HEADS, D_HEAD).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)  # [B,h,S,dh]
394	        # ctxh = attn @ vh
395	        attn = lc["attn"]; vh = lc["vh"]; qh = lc["qh"]; kh = lc["kh"]
396	        dattn = dctxh @ vh.transpose(-2, -1)               # [B,h,S,S]
397	        dvh = attn.transpose(-2, -1) @ dctxh               # [B,h,S,dh]
398	        # softmax backward (over key axis) — masked positions had attn==0 so
399	        # their dscore contribution is zero (y*(...)==0), matching the -inf fwd.
400	        dscores = softmax_backward(dattn, attn)            # [B,h,S,S]
401	        dscores = dscores * ATTN_SCALE
402	        # scores = qh @ kh^T
403	        dqh = dscores @ kh                                 # [B,h,S,dh]
404	        dkh = dscores.transpose(-2, -1) @ qh               # [B,h,S,dh]
405	        # un-split heads: [B,h,S,dh] -> [B,S,d]
406	        def mh(t):
407	            return t.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, S, D_MODEL)
408	        dq, dk, dv = mh(dqh), mh(dkh), mh(dvh)             # each [B,S,d]
409	        dqkv = torch.cat([dq, dk, dv], dim=-1)             # [B,S,3d]
410	        # qkv = x_in @ in_w^T + in_b
411	        x_in = lc["x_in"]
412	        grads[gp + "attn.in_proj_weight"] = (dqkv.reshape(-1, 3 * D_MODEL).t()
413	                                             @ x_in.reshape(-1, D_MODEL))
414	        grads[gp + "attn.in_proj_bias"] = dqkv.reshape(-1, 3 * D_MODEL).sum(dim=0)
415	        dx_in = dx_in + dqkv @ W.layers[li]["in_w"]        # add attention path
416	        # propagate to the previous layer's output (or the embedding).
417	        dh = dx_in
418	
419	    # ----- embedding backward: h0 = tok[tokens] + pos[pos_ids] -----
420	    # dh is grad wrt h0 [B,S,d]. tok grad scatter-adds per token id; pos grad
421	    # sums over batch per position.
422	    dtok = torch.zeros_like(W.tok)                         # [VOCAB,d]
423	    # index_add_ accumulates duplicate token ids deterministically enough for the
424	    # reference; the CUDA path uses a fixed-order accumulation (see report).
425	    dtok.index_add_(0, tokens.reshape(-1), dh.reshape(-1, D_MODEL))
426	    grads["tok.weight"] = dtok
427	    grads["pos.weight"] = dh.sum(dim=0)                    # [S,d]
428	    return grads
429	
430	
431	# ===========================================================================
432	#  Convenience: full step on a torch nn.Module's params (for the parity test).
433	# ===========================================================================
434	def oracle_loss_and_grads(named_params: Dict[str, torch.Tensor],
435	                          tokens: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor):
436	    """Run the manual fwd+bwd over a dict of named parameter tensors.
437	
438	    Returns (loss_float, grads_named). The named_params dict must contain the 30
439	    decoder tensors (same keys as named_parameters()). All compute is in the
440	    dtype of the params (use fp32 for the correctness baseline)."""
441	    W = DecoderWeights.from_named(named_params)
442	    loss, cache = decoder_forward(W, tokens, targets)
443	    grads = decoder_backward(W, cache)
444	    return loss.item(), grads

1	"""tests/hw/vit_oracle.py — runnable PyTorch ORACLE for the real ViT
2	forward+backward that the L3-REAL ViT megakernel transcribes.
3	
4	WHY THIS EXISTS (the rigor substitute for an un-compilable, un-runnable .cu):
5	  PHASE 2 adds the REAL Vision-Transformer fwd+bwd as in-kernel stages of the
6	  persistent megakernel (the ViT counterpart of PHASE 1's decoder). That CUDA
7	  backward is hand-derived and the implementing agent cannot compile or run it.
8	  So we first write the SAME fwd+bwd here in plain PyTorch using ONLY primitive
9	  ops — and a MANUAL backward (NO autograd) — then assert it matches
10	  torch.autograd's loss and every parameter .grad to ~1e-12 (fp64). The CUDA
11	  megakernel is then ported line-for-line from this verified reference,
12	  converting "is my hand-derived backward correct?" (unrunnable) into "does my
13	  manual Python match autograd?" (runnable now).
14	
15	  This module is ALSO the per-tensor expected-grad oracle the parity test
16	  (tests/hw/test_vit_megakernel.py) consumes: same init, same batch → expected
17	  loss + expected grads to compare the megakernel against.
18	
19	EXACT ARCHITECTURE TRANSCRIBED (grokking_race_v2.py, _raw_model → ViT):
20	  ViT(p=97, patch_dim=49, num_patches=16, d=128, h=4, nl=2)   # :389-404
21	    patch_proj = nn.Linear(49, 128)        # :392  per-patch embed (16 patches)
22	    cls_token  = nn.Parameter(1,1,128)*.02 # :393  prepended at position 0
23	    pos        = nn.Embedding(16+1, 128)   # :394  17 learned position embeds
24	    layers     = 2 × EncoderBlock:         # :379-387
25	      attn = MultiheadAttention(128, 4, dropout=0, batch_first=True)  # :382
26	             NO mask — FULL (bidirectional) attention (contrast: decoder causal)
27	      n1, n2 = LayerNorm(128)              # :383  (eps=1e-5 default)
28	      ff = Linear(128,512) → GELU → Linear(512,128)   # :384 (GELU = exact erf)
29	      forward: a,_ = attn(x,x,x)           # :386  (no attn_mask)
30	               x = n1(x + a)               # :387  POST-LN
31	               return n2(x + ff(x))        # :387  POST-LN
32	    norm = LayerNorm(128)                  # :396  final LN
33	    out  = nn.Linear(128, 97)              # :396  head → 97 logits (== p)
34	    forward: h = patch_proj(x)                          # :400  [B,16,d]
35	             h = cat([cls.expand(B,-1,-1), h], dim=1)   # :401  [B,17,d]
36	             h = h + pos(arange(17))                    # :402
37	             for l in layers: h = l(h)                  # :403
38	             return out(norm(h[:, 0, :]))               # :404  CLS token (pos 0)
39	  Loss: F.cross_entropy(m(tx), ty)  (mean over batch; grokking_race_v2.py:967…)
40	
41	  Input x is FLOAT image patches [B, 16, 49] (NOT integer tokens) — see
42	  make_mnist_addition_data (:287-317): a 28×14 stacked-digit image is unfolded
43	  into 16 patches of 49 (7×7) pixels. targets ty are int64 in [0, 97).
44	
45	  nn.MultiheadAttention internals (verified bit-identical to the manual form in
46	  this file, max|diff|==0): in_proj_weight [3d, d] packs [Wq; Wk; Wv] row-blocks,
47	  in_proj_bias [3d]; qkv = x @ W_in^T + b_in then split into q,k,v each [.,.,d];
48	  per-head dh = d/h = 32; scores = (qh @ kh^T)/sqrt(dh); NO causal mask; softmax
49	  over the key axis; ctx = attn @ vh; merge heads; out = ctx @ W_out^T + b_out
50	  (out_proj.weight [d,d], out_proj.bias [d]).
51	
52	NUMERICS (each verified against autograd here, and the values the CUDA must use):
53	  * GELU = EXACT erf: 0.5*x*(1+erf(x/sqrt2)); derivative
54	    0.5*(1+erf(x/sqrt2)) + x * (1/sqrt(2*pi)) * exp(-x^2/2).
55	  * LayerNorm eps = 1e-5 (torch default). Backward dx uses the two
56	    mean-correction terms (see _layernorm_backward).
57	  * Attention softmax subtracts the row max for stability (matches torch).
58	  * CrossEntropy is MEAN over B: dlogits = (softmax - onehot) / B.
59	
60	This file imports torch only; it needs NO GPU and NO built extension.
61	"""
62	
63	from __future__ import annotations
64	
65	import math
66	from dataclasses import dataclass
67	from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
68	
69	import torch
70	
71	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
72	# Architecture constants (single source — mirrored by the C++ layout header and
73	# the codegen). These are the ViT cell's fixed shapes in the grokking race
74	# (MODEL_SCALES["small"]; ViT defaults patch_dim=49, num_patches=16, p=97).
75	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
76	VOCAB = 97       # p (head Linear(d, p)); targets in [0, 97)
77	D_MODEL = 128    # dim_model (MODEL_SCALES["small"])
78	N_HEADS = 4      # num_heads
79	N_LAYERS = 2     # num_layers
80	PATCH_DIM = 49   # patch pixel count (7×7)
81	NUM_PATCHES = 16 # image patches
82	SEQ = NUM_PATCHES + 1  # 17 — CLS token at position 0, then 16 patch positions
83	D_FF = 4 * D_MODEL     # 512 — ff hidden (Linear(d, 4*d))
84	D_HEAD = D_MODEL // N_HEADS  # 32
85	LN_EPS = 1e-5    # torch.nn.LayerNorm default eps
86	ATTN_SCALE = 1.0 / math.sqrt(D_HEAD)  # 1/sqrt(32)
87	
88	
89	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
90	# Exact-erf GELU and its derivative (the REAL nn.GELU(), NOT the tanh approx).
91	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
92	_INV_SQRT2 = 1.0 / math.sqrt(2.0)
93	_INV_SQRT_2PI = 1.0 / math.sqrt(2.0 * math.pi)
94	
95	
96	def gelu(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
97	    return 0.5 * x * (1.0 + torch.erf(x * _INV_SQRT2))
98	
99	
100	def gelu_grad(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
101	    # d/dx [0.5 x (1+erf(x/sqrt2))] = 0.5(1+erf(x/sqrt2)) + x * phi(x),
102	    # phi(x) = (1/sqrt(2pi)) exp(-x^2/2)  (the normal pdf).
103	    cdf = 0.5 * (1.0 + torch.erf(x * _INV_SQRT2))
104	    pdf = _INV_SQRT_2PI * torch.exp(-0.5 * x * x)
105	    return cdf + x * pdf
106	
107	
108	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
109	# LayerNorm fwd/bwd (eps=1e-5), over the last dim (size d). Affine (gamma,beta).
110	# (Identical to the decoder oracle — shared math.)
111	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
112	def layernorm_forward(x, gamma, beta, eps=LN_EPS):
113	    """x: [..., d]. Returns (y, cache) where cache has the bwd intermediates."""
114	    mu = x.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
115	    xc = x - mu
116	    var = (xc * xc).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
117	    inv_std = 1.0 / torch.sqrt(var + eps)
118	    xhat = xc * inv_std
119	    y = xhat * gamma + beta
120	    return y, (xhat, inv_std, gamma)
121	
122	
123	def layernorm_backward(dy, cache):
124	    """Returns (dx, dgamma, dbeta). dgamma/dbeta summed over all but last dim."""
125	    xhat, inv_std, gamma = cache
126	    d = xhat.shape[-1]
127	    reduce_axes = tuple(range(dy.dim() - 1))
128	    dbeta = dy.sum(dim=reduce_axes)
129	    dgamma = (dy * xhat).sum(dim=reduce_axes)
130	    dxhat = dy * gamma
131	    sum_dxhat = dxhat.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
132	    sum_dxhat_xhat = (dxhat * xhat).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
133	    dx = inv_std * (dxhat - (sum_dxhat + xhat * sum_dxhat_xhat) / d)
134	    return dx, dgamma, dbeta
135	
136	
137	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
138	# Softmax over the last dim with row-max subtraction (matches torch), + bwd.
139	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
140	def softmax_lastdim(x):
141	    m = x.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
142	    e = torch.exp(x - m)
143	    s = e.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
144	    return e / s
145	
146	
147	def softmax_backward(dy, y):
148	    # dx = y * (dy - sum(dy*y))  (over the softmax axis).
149	    s = (dy * y).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
150	    return y * (dy - s)
151	
152	
153	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
154	# Parameter container — mirrors named_parameters() ORDER exactly (32 tensors).
155	# The CUDA flat-buffer offsets are generated from this same order (see
156	# vit_param_layout()).
157	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
158	# (name, shape) in the EXACT order torch's named_parameters() yields them. THE
159	# single source of truth for the flat weight layout; the C++ header
160	# (csrc/fused/sm_90/vit_layout.cuh) static-asserts the count + total.
161	#
162	# ORDER NOTE (verified against the live model's named_parameters): the module
163	# attributes are registered in __init__ order — patch_proj, cls_token, pos, ...
164	# — BUT cls_token is an nn.Parameter (a leaf) while patch_proj is a submodule,
165	# and PyTorch yields a module's OWN parameters (here cls_token) before recursing
166	# into child modules (patch_proj.*). So the head of the list is:
167	#   cls_token, patch_proj.weight, patch_proj.bias, pos.weight, <layers...>.
168	def vit_param_spec() -> List[Tuple[str, Tuple[int, ...]]]:
169	    spec: List[Tuple[str, Tuple[int, ...]]] = [
170	        ("cls_token", (1, 1, D_MODEL)),
171	        ("patch_proj.weight", (D_MODEL, PATCH_DIM)),
172	        ("patch_proj.bias", (D_MODEL,)),
173	        ("pos.weight", (SEQ, D_MODEL)),
174	    ]
175	    for li in range(N_LAYERS):
176	        p = f"layers.{li}."
177	        spec += [
178	            (p + "attn.in_proj_weight", (3 * D_MODEL, D_MODEL)),
179	            (p + "attn.in_proj_bias", (3 * D_MODEL,)),
180	            (p + "attn.out_proj.weight", (D_MODEL, D_MODEL)),
181	            (p + "attn.out_proj.bias", (D_MODEL,)),
182	            (p + "n1.weight", (D_MODEL,)),
183	            (p + "n1.bias", (D_MODEL,)),
184	            (p + "n2.weight", (D_MODEL,)),
185	            (p + "n2.bias", (D_MODEL,)),
186	            (p + "ff.0.weight", (D_FF, D_MODEL)),
187	            (p + "ff.0.bias", (D_FF,)),
188	            (p + "ff.2.weight", (D_MODEL, D_FF)),
189	            (p + "ff.2.bias", (D_MODEL,)),
190	        ]
191	    spec += [
192	        ("norm.weight", (D_MODEL,)),
193	        ("norm.bias", (D_MODEL,)),
194	        ("out.weight", (VOCAB, D_MODEL)),
195	        ("out.bias", (VOCAB,)),
196	    ]
197	    return spec
198	
199	
200	def vit_param_layout() -> Dict[str, object]:
201	    """Flat-buffer layout: offsets/sizes per tensor (the megakernel ABI view).
202	
203	    Returns dict with: names, offsets (elements into the flat buffer), sizes,
204	    total (== 418017), n_tensors (== 32). The offsets follow named_parameters()
205	    order so the flat blob == torch.cat([p.reshape(-1) for _, p in
206	    model.named_parameters()]).
207	    """
208	    spec = vit_param_spec()
209	    names, offsets, sizes = [], [], []
210	    off = 0
211	    for name, shape in spec:
212	        n = 1
213	        for s in shape:
214	            n *= s
215	        names.append(name)
216	        offsets.append(off)
217	        sizes.append(n)
218	        off += n
219	    return dict(names=names, offsets=offsets, sizes=sizes,
220	                shapes=[s for _, s in spec], total=off, n_tensors=len(spec))
221	
222	
223	@dataclass
224	class ViTWeights:
225	    """All 32 ViT weights as named tensors. Built either from a flat buffer
226	    (the megakernel view) or from a torch nn module's named_parameters()."""
227	    cls: torch.Tensor          # [1,1,d]  -> used as [d]
228	    patch_w: torch.Tensor      # [d, patch_dim]
229	    patch_b: torch.Tensor      # [d]
230	    pos: torch.Tensor          # [SEQ, d]
231	    layers: List[Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]
232	    norm_w: torch.Tensor
233	    norm_b: torch.Tensor
234	    out_w: torch.Tensor
235	    out_b: torch.Tensor
236	
237	    @staticmethod
238	    def from_named(named: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> "ViTWeights":
239	        layers = []
240	        for li in range(N_LAYERS):
241	            p = f"layers.{li}."
242	            layers.append(dict(
243	                in_w=named[p + "attn.in_proj_weight"],
244	                in_b=named[p + "attn.in_proj_bias"],
245	                out_w=named[p + "attn.out_proj.weight"],
246	                out_b=named[p + "attn.out_proj.bias"],
247	                n1_w=named[p + "n1.weight"], n1_b=named[p + "n1.bias"],
248	                n2_w=named[p + "n2.weight"], n2_b=named[p + "n2.bias"],
249	                ff0_w=named[p + "ff.0.weight"], ff0_b=named[p + "ff.0.bias"],
250	                ff2_w=named[p + "ff.2.weight"], ff2_b=named[p + "ff.2.bias"],
251	            ))
252	        return ViTWeights(
253	            cls=named["cls_token"], patch_w=named["patch_proj.weight"],
254	            patch_b=named["patch_proj.bias"], pos=named["pos.weight"],
255	            layers=layers,
256	            norm_w=named["norm.weight"], norm_b=named["norm.bias"],
257	            out_w=named["out.weight"], out_b=named["out.bias"])
258	
259	    @staticmethod
260	    def from_flat(flat: torch.Tensor) -> "ViTWeights":
261	        lay = vit_param_layout()
262	        named = {}
263	        for name, off, sz, shape in zip(lay["names"], lay["offsets"],
264	                                        lay["sizes"], lay["shapes"]):
265	            named[name] = flat[off:off + sz].reshape(shape)
266	        return ViTWeights.from_named(named)
267	
268	
269	# ===========================================================================
270	#  FORWARD (manual, primitive ops) — caches everything the manual backward needs.
271	# ===========================================================================
272	def vit_forward(W: ViTWeights, patches: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor):
273	    """patches: [B, NUM_PATCHES, PATCH_DIM] float. targets: [B] int64.
274	
275	    Returns (loss_scalar, cache). loss = mean-over-batch cross-entropy on the
276	    CLS-position (pos 0) logits. cache holds every fwd intermediate for the bwd.
277	    """
278	    B, P, _ = patches.shape
279	    device, dtype = W.patch_w.device, W.patch_w.dtype
280	    assert P == NUM_PATCHES
281	
282	    # Patch embed (positions 1..16) + CLS token (position 0); add pos embeds.
283	    proj = patches @ W.patch_w.t() + W.patch_b          # [B, 16, d]
284	    cls = W.cls.reshape(1, 1, D_MODEL).expand(B, 1, D_MODEL)  # [B,1,d]
285	    h = torch.cat([cls, proj], dim=1)                   # [B, 17, d]
286	    pos_ids = torch.arange(SEQ, device=device)
287	    h = h + W.pos[pos_ids].unsqueeze(0)                 # [B, 17, d]
288	
289	    layer_caches = []
290	    for li in range(N_LAYERS):
291	        L = W.layers[li]
292	        x_in = h  # residual base for the attention sublayer
293	        # ----- self-attention (MultiheadAttention semantics; NO causal mask) --
294	        qkv = x_in @ L["in_w"].t() + L["in_b"]          # [B,S,3d]
295	        q, k, v = qkv.split(D_MODEL, dim=-1)
296	
297	        def sh(t):
298	            return t.reshape(B, SEQ, N_HEADS, D_HEAD).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
299	        qh, kh, vh = sh(q), sh(k), sh(v)
300	        scores = (qh @ kh.transpose(-2, -1)) * ATTN_SCALE   # [B,h,S,S]
301	        attn = softmax_lastdim(scores)                      # [B,h,S,S] (full)
302	        ctxh = attn @ vh                                     # [B,h,S,dh]
303	        ctx = ctxh.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, SEQ, D_MODEL)  # merge heads
304	        a = ctx @ L["out_w"].t() + L["out_b"]               # [B,S,d]
305	        # ----- residual + n1 (POST-LN): x = n1(x_in + a) -----
306	        r1 = x_in + a
307	        x1, ln1_cache = layernorm_forward(r1, L["n1_w"], L["n1_b"])
308	        # ----- FFN: ff2(gelu(ff0(x1))) -----
309	        ff0 = x1 @ L["ff0_w"].t() + L["ff0_b"]              # [B,S,4d]
310	        g = gelu(ff0)                                        # [B,S,4d]
311	        ff2 = g @ L["ff2_w"].t() + L["ff2_b"]              # [B,S,d]
312	        # ----- residual + n2 (POST-LN): h = n2(x1 + ff2) -----
313	        r2 = x1 + ff2
314	        h2, ln2_cache = layernorm_forward(r2, L["n2_w"], L["n2_b"])
315	        layer_caches.append(dict(
316	            x_in=x_in, qkv=qkv, qh=qh, kh=kh, vh=vh, attn=attn, ctxh=ctxh,
317	            ctx=ctx, r1=r1, x1=x1, ln1_cache=ln1_cache, ff0=ff0, g=g, r2=r2,
318	            ln2_cache=ln2_cache))
319	        h = h2
320	
321	    # Final norm + head on the CLS position (pos 0) only.
322	    h_cls = h[:, 0, :]                                     # [B,d]
323	    hn, norm_cache = layernorm_forward(h_cls, W.norm_w, W.norm_b)
324	    logits = hn @ W.out_w.t() + W.out_b                    # [B,VOCAB]
325	    # Cross-entropy, mean over batch (numerically-stable log-softmax).
326	    m = logits.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
327	    logz = m.squeeze(-1) + torch.log(torch.exp(logits - m).sum(dim=-1))
328	    nll = logz - logits.gather(1, targets.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)
329	    loss = nll.mean()
330	    cache = dict(B=B, patches=patches, targets=targets,
331	                 layer_caches=layer_caches, h_cls=h_cls, hn=hn,
332	                 norm_cache=norm_cache, logits=logits)
333	    return loss, cache
334	
335	
336	# ===========================================================================
337	#  BACKWARD (manual, NO autograd) — returns grads for every named parameter.
338	# ===========================================================================
339	def vit_backward(W: ViTWeights, cache) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
340	    B = cache["B"]
341	    targets = cache["targets"]
342	    patches = cache["patches"]
343	    grads: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
344	
345	    # ----- CE backward: dlogits = (softmax - onehot) / B -----
346	    logits = cache["logits"]
347	    sm = softmax_lastdim(logits)                           # [B,VOCAB]
348	    onehot = torch.zeros_like(sm)
349	    onehot.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0)
350	    dlogits = (sm - onehot) / B                            # [B,VOCAB]
351	
352	    # ----- head (out): logits = hn @ out_w^T + out_b -----
353	    hn = cache["hn"]                                       # [B,d]
354	    grads["out.weight"] = dlogits.t() @ hn                 # [VOCAB,d]
355	    grads["out.bias"] = dlogits.sum(dim=0)                 # [VOCAB]
356	    dhn = dlogits @ W.out_w                                # [B,d]
357	
358	    # ----- final norm backward -----
359	    dh_cls, dnorm_w, dnorm_b = layernorm_backward(dhn, cache["norm_cache"])
360	    grads["norm.weight"] = dnorm_w
361	    grads["norm.bias"] = dnorm_b
362	
363	    # Upstream into the last layer's output: only the CLS position (0) has grad.
364	    dh = torch.zeros(B, SEQ, D_MODEL, device=hn.device, dtype=hn.dtype)
365	    dh[:, 0, :] = dh_cls
366	
367	    # ----- per-layer backward (reverse) -----
368	    for li in reversed(range(N_LAYERS)):
369	        L = W.layers[li]
370	        lc = cache["layer_caches"][li]
371	        gp = f"layers.{li}."
372	        # h2 = n2(r2);  dh is grad wrt h2.
373	        dr2, dn2_w, dn2_b = layernorm_backward(dh, lc["ln2_cache"])
374	        grads[gp + "n2.weight"] = dn2_w
375	        grads[gp + "n2.bias"] = dn2_b
376	        # r2 = x1 + ff2  -> grad flows to x1 (residual) AND ff2.
377	        dff2 = dr2
378	        dx1 = dr2.clone()
379	        # ff2 = g @ ff2_w^T + ff2_b
380	        g = lc["g"]                                        # [B,S,4d]
381	        grads[gp + "ff.2.weight"] = (dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t()
382	                                     @ g.reshape(-1, D_FF))   # [d,4d]
383	        grads[gp + "ff.2.bias"] = dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(dim=0)
384	        dg = dff2 @ W.layers[li]["ff2_w"]                  # [B,S,4d]
385	        # gelu backward
386	        dff0 = dg * gelu_grad(lc["ff0"])                   # [B,S,4d]
387	        # ff0 = x1 @ ff0_w^T + ff0_b
388	        x1 = lc["x1"]
389	        grads[gp + "ff.0.weight"] = (dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).t()
390	                                     @ x1.reshape(-1, D_MODEL))  # [4d,d]
391	        grads[gp + "ff.0.bias"] = dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).sum(dim=0)
392	        dx1 = dx1 + dff0 @ W.layers[li]["ff0_w"]           # add FFN path to x1
393	        # x1 = n1(r1) -> backward
394	        dr1, dn1_w, dn1_b = layernorm_backward(dx1, lc["ln1_cache"])
395	        grads[gp + "n1.weight"] = dn1_w
396	        grads[gp + "n1.bias"] = dn1_b
397	        # r1 = x_in + a -> grad to x_in (residual) AND a (attention out).
398	        da = dr1
399	        dx_in = dr1.clone()
400	        # a = ctx @ out_w^T + out_b
401	        ctx = lc["ctx"]                                    # [B,S,d]
402	        grads[gp + "attn.out_proj.weight"] = (da.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t()
403	                                              @ ctx.reshape(-1, D_MODEL))
404	        grads[gp + "attn.out_proj.bias"] = da.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(dim=0)
405	        dctx = da @ W.layers[li]["out_w"]                  # [B,S,d]
406	        # merge-heads backward: ctx[B,S,d] <- ctxh[B,h,S,dh]
407	        dctxh = dctx.reshape(B, SEQ, N_HEADS, D_HEAD).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
408	        # ctxh = attn @ vh
409	        attn = lc["attn"]; vh = lc["vh"]; qh = lc["qh"]; kh = lc["kh"]
410	        dattn = dctxh @ vh.transpose(-2, -1)               # [B,h,S,S]
411	        dvh = attn.transpose(-2, -1) @ dctxh               # [B,h,S,dh]
412	        # softmax backward (over key axis) — NO mask, full S.
413	        dscores = softmax_backward(dattn, attn)            # [B,h,S,S]
414	        dscores = dscores * ATTN_SCALE
415	        # scores = qh @ kh^T
416	        dqh = dscores @ kh                                 # [B,h,S,dh]
417	        dkh = dscores.transpose(-2, -1) @ qh               # [B,h,S,dh]
418	        # un-split heads: [B,h,S,dh] -> [B,S,d]
419	        def mh(t):
420	            return t.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, SEQ, D_MODEL)
421	        dq, dk, dv = mh(dqh), mh(dkh), mh(dvh)             # each [B,S,d]
422	        dqkv = torch.cat([dq, dk, dv], dim=-1)             # [B,S,3d]
423	        # qkv = x_in @ in_w^T + in_b
424	        x_in = lc["x_in"]
425	        grads[gp + "attn.in_proj_weight"] = (dqkv.reshape(-1, 3 * D_MODEL).t()
426	                                             @ x_in.reshape(-1, D_MODEL))
427	        grads[gp + "attn.in_proj_bias"] = dqkv.reshape(-1, 3 * D_MODEL).sum(dim=0)
428	        dx_in = dx_in + dqkv @ W.layers[li]["in_w"]        # add attention path
429	        # propagate to the previous layer's output (or the embedding).
430	        dh = dx_in
431	
432	    # ----- embedding backward -----
433	    # dh is grad wrt h0 [B,S,d] (post-cat, pre-pos-add input to layer 0).
434	    # h0 = cat([cls, patch_proj(patches)], 1) + pos.
435	    #   pos.weight[s] grad = sum over batch of dh[:, s, :]   (all 17 positions)
436	    #   cls_token grad     = sum over batch of dh[:, 0, :]   (position 0 only)
437	    #   patch_proj: positions 1..16 are patch_proj(patches[:, i, :]):
438	    #     dW += sum_b sum_i dh[b, 1+i, :]^T ⊗ patches[b, i, :]
439	    #     db += sum_b sum_i dh[b, 1+i, :]
440	    grads["pos.weight"] = dh.sum(dim=0)                    # [SEQ, d]
441	    grads["cls_token"] = dh[:, 0, :].sum(dim=0).reshape(1, 1, D_MODEL)
442	    dh_patches = dh[:, 1:, :]                              # [B, 16, d]
443	    # dW_patch [d, patch_dim] = sum over (B,patch) of dh_patches ⊗ patches
444	    grads["patch_proj.weight"] = (dh_patches.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t()
445	                                  @ patches.reshape(-1, PATCH_DIM))   # [d,patch]
446	    grads["patch_proj.bias"] = dh_patches.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(dim=0)  # [d]
447	    return grads
448	
449	
450	# ===========================================================================
451	#  Convenience: full step on a torch nn.Module's params (for the parity test).
452	# ===========================================================================
453	def oracle_loss_and_grads(named_params: Dict[str, torch.Tensor],
454	                          patches: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor):
455	    """Run the manual fwd+bwd over a dict of named parameter tensors.
456	
457	    Returns (loss_float, grads_named). The named_params dict must contain the 32
458	    ViT tensors (same keys as named_parameters()). All compute is in the dtype
459	    of the params (use fp32/fp64 for the correctness baseline)."""
460	    W = ViTWeights.from_named(named_params)
461	    loss, cache = vit_forward(W, patches, targets)
462	    grads = vit_backward(W, cache)
463	    return loss.item(), grads

1	"""tests/hw/decoder_kernel_mirror.py — single-threaded STRUCTURAL mirror of the
2	CUDA decoder megakernel (csrc/fused/sm_90/model_stages_decoder.cuh).
3	
4	WHY (the gate the math-oracle cannot provide): decoder_oracle.py proves the
5	decoder fwd/bwd MATH is correct (matched to autograd ~1e-15). It does NOT
6	exercise the CUDA kernel's *structure* — the smem buffer reuse/aliasing, the
7	recompute-in-backward, the head-split index arithmetic, the owner-thread grad
8	accumulation, the per-sample sequential reduction. That structure is exactly
9	where a hand-written, un-runnable backward hides missing terms / index bugs /
10	dead-buffer reads (e.g. an attention dv term computed from an already-overwritten
11	softmax weight).
12	
13	This module re-implements the kernel ALGORITHM in plain Python — same buffers
14	(as numpy/torch arrays), same aliasing decisions, same loop nests and index math,
15	same per-sample sequential weight-grad accumulation into a CTA-style partial — so
16	that asserting it against decoder_oracle's grads (~1e-6 on a tiny batch) catches
17	the STRUCTURAL bug class. It is single-threaded, so it does NOT catch
18	__syncthreads races (those are verified by reading each sync against the buffer it
19	guards — see the kernel header comments); it DOES catch everything else.
20	
21	The mirror follows the .cuh line-by-line: dec_forward_sample,
22	dec_recompute_layer, dec_backward_sample, dec_linear/_bwd, dec_layernorm_*,
23	and the three-pass attention backward (A: dv, B: dscores, C: dq/dk).
24	"""
25	
26	from __future__ import annotations
27	
28	import math
29	from typing import Dict
30	
31	import torch
32	
33	from tests.hw.decoder_oracle import (
34	    DecoderWeights, decoder_param_layout,
35	    VOCAB, D_MODEL, N_HEADS, N_LAYERS, SEQ, D_FF, D_HEAD, LN_EPS, ATTN_SCALE,
36	    gelu, gelu_grad,
37	)
38	
39	_F64 = torch.float64  # mirror in fp64 so the only diff vs oracle is structure
40	
41	
42	# --- primitive ops, mirroring the .cuh device functions exactly --------------
43	def _linear(x, W, b, in_dim, out_dim):
44	    # y[s,o] = sum_k x[s,k]*W[o,k] + b[o]   (W row-major [out,in])
45	    y = torch.zeros(SEQ, out_dim, dtype=_F64)
46	    for s in range(SEQ):
47	        for o in range(out_dim):
48	            acc = b[o].item() if b is not None else 0.0
49	            for k in range(in_dim):
50	                acc += x[s, k].item() * W[o, k].item()
51	            y[s, o] = acc
52	    return y
53	
54	
55	def _layernorm_fwd(x, gamma, beta):
56	    y = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
57	    xhat = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
58	    inv = torch.zeros(SEQ, dtype=_F64)
59	    for s in range(SEQ):
60	        mean = x[s].mean()
61	        var = ((x[s] - mean) ** 2).mean()
62	        i = 1.0 / math.sqrt(var.item() + LN_EPS)
63	        inv[s] = i
64	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
65	            xh = (x[s, j] - mean) * i
66	            xhat[s, j] = xh
67	            y[s, j] = xh * gamma[j] + beta[j]
68	    return y, xhat, inv
69	
70	
71	# --- the per-sample forward (mirrors dec_forward_sample) ----------------------
72	def _forward_sample(W: DecoderWeights, tokens_s, target):
73	    sm = {}
74	    # embedding + pos -> layer_in[0]
75	    h = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
76	    for s in range(SEQ):
77	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
78	            h[s, j] = W.tok[tokens_s[s], j] + W.pos[s, j]
79	    sm["layer_in"] = [h.clone(), None]
80	    for li in range(N_LAYERS):
81	        L = W.layers[li]
82	        hin = sm["layer_in"][li]
83	        qkv = _linear(hin, L["in_w"], L["in_b"], D_MODEL, 3 * D_MODEL)
84	        attn = torch.zeros(N_HEADS, SEQ, SEQ, dtype=_F64)
85	        ctx = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
86	        for hh in range(N_HEADS):
87	            qoff = hh * D_HEAD
88	            for qi in range(SEQ):
89	                sc = [(-math.inf) for _ in range(SEQ)]
90	                maxs = -math.inf
91	                for kj in range(SEQ):
92	                    if kj > qi:
93	                        continue
94	                    dot = 0.0
95	                    for t in range(D_HEAD):
96	                        dot += qkv[qi, qoff + t].item() * qkv[kj, D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
97	                    sc[kj] = dot * ATTN_SCALE
98	                    maxs = max(maxs, sc[kj])
99	                denom = 0.0
100	                for kj in range(SEQ):
101	                    e = math.exp(sc[kj] - maxs) if kj <= qi else 0.0
102	                    sc[kj] = e
103	                    denom += e
104	                for kj in range(SEQ):
105	                    attn[hh, qi, kj] = sc[kj] / denom
106	                for t in range(D_HEAD):
107	                    acc = 0.0
108	                    for kj in range(qi + 1):
109	                        acc += attn[hh, qi, kj].item() * qkv[kj, 2 * D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
110	                    ctx[qi, qoff + t] = acc
111	        a = _linear(ctx, L["out_w"], L["out_b"], D_MODEL, D_MODEL)
112	        r1 = hin + a
113	        x1, n1_xhat, n1_inv = _layernorm_fwd(r1, L["n1_w"], L["n1_b"])
114	        ff0 = _linear(x1, L["ff0_w"], L["ff0_b"], D_MODEL, D_FF)
115	        gact = gelu(ff0)
116	        ff2 = _linear(gact, L["ff2_w"], L["ff2_b"], D_FF, D_MODEL)
117	        r2 = x1 + ff2
118	        h2, n2_xhat, n2_inv = _layernorm_fwd(r2, L["n2_w"], L["n2_b"])
119	        sm[f"L{li}"] = dict(qkv=qkv, attn=attn, ctx=ctx, x1=x1, ff0=ff0,
120	                            gact=gact, n1_xhat=n1_xhat, n1_inv=n1_inv,
121	                            n2_xhat=n2_xhat, n2_inv=n2_inv)
122	        if li + 1 < N_LAYERS:
123	            sm["layer_in"][li + 1] = h2
124	        else:
125	            sm["final_in"] = h2
126	    # final norm (last pos) + head -> logits
127	    hlast = sm["final_in"][SEQ - 1]
128	    mean = hlast.mean()
129	    var = ((hlast - mean) ** 2).mean()
130	    inv = 1.0 / math.sqrt(var.item() + LN_EPS)
131	    fn_xhat = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
132	    hn = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
133	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
134	        xh = (hlast[j] - mean) * inv
135	        fn_xhat[j] = xh
136	        hn[j] = xh * W.norm_w[j] + W.norm_b[j]
137	    logits = torch.zeros(VOCAB, dtype=_F64)
138	    for o in range(VOCAB):
139	        acc = W.out_b[o].item()
140	        for k in range(D_MODEL):
141	            acc += hn[k].item() * W.out_w[o, k].item()
142	        logits[o] = acc
143	    sm["fn_xhat"] = fn_xhat
144	    sm["fn_inv"] = inv
145	    sm["logits"] = logits
146	    return sm
147	
148	
149	# --- recompute one layer's fwd intermediates (mirrors dec_recompute_layer) ----
150	def _recompute_layer(W, li, sm):
151	    """RE-RUN the layer forward from the cached layer INPUT (sm['layer_in'][li]),
152	    exactly as the CUDA dec_recompute_layer does (it does NOT reuse a per-layer
153	    cache — only layer_in survives). This exercises the recompute path's index
154	    math + that it reproduces the forward values; we assert it equals the original
155	    forward cache to catch a recompute divergence (e.g. a wrong residual or a
156	    clobbered input)."""
157	    L = W.layers[li]
158	    hin = sm["layer_in"][li]
159	    qkv = _linear(hin, L["in_w"], L["in_b"], D_MODEL, 3 * D_MODEL)
160	    attn = torch.zeros(N_HEADS, SEQ, SEQ, dtype=_F64)
161	    ctx = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
162	    for hh in range(N_HEADS):
163	        qoff = hh * D_HEAD
164	        for qi in range(SEQ):
165	            sc = [(-math.inf) for _ in range(SEQ)]
166	            maxs = -math.inf
167	            for kj in range(SEQ):
168	                if kj > qi:
169	                    continue
170	                dot = 0.0
171	                for t in range(D_HEAD):
172	                    dot += qkv[qi, qoff + t].item() * qkv[kj, D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
173	                sc[kj] = dot * ATTN_SCALE
174	                maxs = max(maxs, sc[kj])
175	            denom = 0.0
176	            for kj in range(SEQ):
177	                e = math.exp(sc[kj] - maxs) if kj <= qi else 0.0
178	                sc[kj] = e
179	                denom += e
180	            for kj in range(SEQ):
181	                attn[hh, qi, kj] = sc[kj] / denom
182	            for t in range(D_HEAD):
183	                acc = 0.0
184	                for kj in range(qi + 1):
185	                    acc += attn[hh, qi, kj].item() * qkv[kj, 2 * D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
186	                ctx[qi, qoff + t] = acc
187	    a = _linear(ctx, L["out_w"], L["out_b"], D_MODEL, D_MODEL)
188	    r1 = hin + a
189	    x1, n1_xhat, n1_inv = _layernorm_fwd(r1, L["n1_w"], L["n1_b"])
190	    ff0 = _linear(x1, L["ff0_w"], L["ff0_b"], D_MODEL, D_FF)
191	    gact = gelu(ff0)
192	    # n2 caches (xhat/inv) require r2; the CUDA recompute computes r2 into ctx and
193	    # runs LN fwd for the caches (output discarded).
194	    ff2 = _linear(gact, L["ff2_w"], L["ff2_b"], D_FF, D_MODEL)
195	    r2 = x1 + ff2
196	    _, n2_xhat, n2_inv = _layernorm_fwd(r2, L["n2_w"], L["n2_b"])
197	    rc = dict(qkv=qkv, attn=attn, ctx=ctx, x1=x1, ff0=ff0, gact=gact,
198	              n1_xhat=n1_xhat, n1_inv=n1_inv, n2_xhat=n2_xhat, n2_inv=n2_inv)
199	    # Recompute MUST reproduce the original forward exactly (same inputs/ops).
200	    orig = sm[f"L{li}"]
201	    for k in ("qkv", "ctx", "x1", "ff0", "gact", "n1_xhat", "n2_xhat"):
202	        d = (rc[k] - orig[k]).abs().max().item()
203	        assert d < 1e-9, f"recompute layer {li} field {k} diverged by {d:.2e}"
204	    return rc
205	
206	
207	# --- the per-sample backward (mirrors dec_backward_sample) --------------------
208	def _backward_sample(W: DecoderWeights, g: Dict[str, torch.Tensor],
209	                     tokens_s, target, B, sm):
210	    # CE backward: dlogits = (softmax - onehot)/B
211	    logits = sm["logits"]
212	    mx = logits.max().item()
213	    es = sum(math.exp(logits[o].item() - mx) for o in range(VOCAB))
214	    dlogits = torch.zeros(VOCAB, dtype=_F64)
215	    for o in range(VOCAB):
216	        smo = math.exp(logits[o].item() - mx) / es
217	        dlogits[o] = (smo - (1.0 if o == target else 0.0)) / B
218	    # head bwd: dW_out += dlogits ⊗ hn ; db_out += dlogits ; dhn = dlogits @ out_w
219	    fn_xhat = sm["fn_xhat"]
220	    hn = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
221	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
222	        hn[j] = fn_xhat[j] * W.norm_w[j] + W.norm_b[j]
223	    for o in range(VOCAB):
224	        g["out.bias"][o] += dlogits[o]
225	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
226	            g["out.weight"][o, j] += dlogits[o] * hn[j]
227	    dhn = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
228	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
229	        acc = 0.0
230	        for o in range(VOCAB):
231	            acc += dlogits[o].item() * W.out_w[o, j].item()
232	        dhn[j] = acc
233	    # final-norm bwd (single row = last position).
234	    dy = dhn
235	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
236	        g["norm.bias"][j] += dy[j]
237	        g["norm.weight"][j] += dy[j] * fn_xhat[j]
238	    sda = sum((dy[j] * W.norm_w[j]).item() for j in range(D_MODEL))
239	    sdax = sum((dy[j] * W.norm_w[j] * fn_xhat[j]).item() for j in range(D_MODEL))
240	    inv_s = sm["fn_inv"]
241	    dh = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
242	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
243	        dxhat = dy[j] * W.norm_w[j]
244	        dh[SEQ - 1, j] = inv_s * (dxhat - (sda + fn_xhat[j] * sdax) / D_MODEL)
245	    # per-layer backward (reverse)
246	    for li in reversed(range(N_LAYERS)):
247	        L = W.layers[li]
248	        gp = f"layers.{li}."
249	        c = _recompute_layer(W, li, sm)
250	        qkv, attn, ctx_fwd = c["qkv"], c["attn"], c["ctx"]
251	        x1, ff0, gact = c["x1"], c["ff0"], c["gact"]
252	        n1_xhat, n1_inv = c["n1_xhat"], c["n1_inv"]
253	        n2_xhat, n2_inv = c["n2_xhat"], c["n2_inv"]
254	        # n2 bwd: dh -> dr2 ; accumulate n2 gamma/beta.
255	        dr2 = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
256	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
257	            for s in range(SEQ):
258	                d = dh[s, j]
259	                g[gp + "n2.bias"][j] += d
260	                g[gp + "n2.weight"][j] += d * n2_xhat[s, j]
261	        for s in range(SEQ):
262	            sda = sum((dh[s, j] * L["n2_w"][j]).item() for j in range(D_MODEL))
263	            sdax = sum((dh[s, j] * L["n2_w"][j] * n2_xhat[s, j]).item()
264	                       for j in range(D_MODEL))
265	            for j in range(D_MODEL):
266	                dxhat = dh[s, j] * L["n2_w"][j]
267	                dr2[s, j] = n2_inv[s] * (dxhat - (sda + n2_xhat[s, j] * sdax) / D_MODEL)
268	        # dx1 := dr2 (residual). dff2 = dr2.
269	        dx1 = dr2.clone()
270	        # ff.2 bwd: dW += dr2^T @ gact ; db += sum dr2 ; dff0 = (dr2 @ ff2_w)*gelu'(ff0)
271	        for o in range(D_MODEL):
272	            for i in range(D_FF):
273	                acc = 0.0
274	                for s in range(SEQ):
275	                    acc += dr2[s, o].item() * gact[s, i].item()
276	                g[gp + "ff.2.weight"][o, i] += acc
277	            acc = 0.0
278	            for s in range(SEQ):
279	                acc += dr2[s, o].item()
280	            g[gp + "ff.2.bias"][o] += acc
281	        dff0 = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_FF, dtype=_F64)
282	        ggrad = gelu_grad(ff0)
283	        for s in range(SEQ):
284	            for i in range(D_FF):
285	                dg = 0.0
286	                for o in range(D_MODEL):
287	                    dg += dr2[s, o].item() * L["ff2_w"][o, i].item()
288	                dff0[s, i] = dg * ggrad[s, i]
289	        # ff.0 bwd: dW += dff0^T @ x1 ; db += sum dff0 ; dx1 += dff0 @ ff0_w
290	        for o in range(D_FF):
291	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
292	                acc = 0.0
293	                for s in range(SEQ):
294	                    acc += dff0[s, o].item() * x1[s, i].item()
295	                g[gp + "ff.0.weight"][o, i] += acc
296	            acc = 0.0
297	            for s in range(SEQ):
298	                acc += dff0[s, o].item()
299	            g[gp + "ff.0.bias"][o] += acc
300	        for s in range(SEQ):
301	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
302	                acc = 0.0
303	                for o in range(D_FF):
304	                    acc += dff0[s, o].item() * L["ff0_w"][o, i].item()
305	                dx1[s, i] += acc
306	        # n1 bwd: dx1 -> dr1 ; accumulate n1 gamma/beta.
307	        dr1 = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
308	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
309	            for s in range(SEQ):
310	                d = dx1[s, j]
311	                g[gp + "n1.bias"][j] += d
312	                g[gp + "n1.weight"][j] += d * n1_xhat[s, j]
313	        for s in range(SEQ):
314	            sda = sum((dx1[s, j] * L["n1_w"][j]).item() for j in range(D_MODEL))
315	            sdax = sum((dx1[s, j] * L["n1_w"][j] * n1_xhat[s, j]).item()
316	                       for j in range(D_MODEL))
317	            for j in range(D_MODEL):
318	                dxhat = dx1[s, j] * L["n1_w"][j]
319	                dr1[s, j] = n1_inv[s] * (dxhat - (sda + n1_xhat[s, j] * sdax) / D_MODEL)
320	        # r1 = x_in + a -> da = dr1 ; dx_in := dr1 (residual).
321	        da = dr1
322	        dx_in = dr1.clone()
323	        # out_proj bwd: dW += da^T @ ctx_fwd ; db += sum da ; dctx = da @ out_w
324	        for o in range(D_MODEL):
325	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
326	                acc = 0.0
327	                for s in range(SEQ):
328	                    acc += da[s, o].item() * ctx_fwd[s, i].item()
329	                g[gp + "attn.out_proj.weight"][o, i] += acc
330	            acc = 0.0
331	            for s in range(SEQ):
332	                acc += da[s, o].item()
333	            g[gp + "attn.out_proj.bias"][o] += acc
334	        dctx = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
335	        for s in range(SEQ):
336	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
337	                acc = 0.0
338	                for o in range(D_MODEL):
339	                    acc += da[s, o].item() * L["out_w"][o, i].item()
340	                dctx[s, i] = acc
341	        # --- attention backward (3 passes: A dv, B dscores, C dq/dk) ---
342	        dqkv = torch.zeros(SEQ, 3 * D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
343	        # A: dv[kj,qoff+t] = sum_{qi>=kj} attn[hh,qi,kj]*dctx[qi,qoff+t]
344	        for kj in range(SEQ):
345	            for hh in range(N_HEADS):
346	                qoff = hh * D_HEAD
347	                for t in range(D_HEAD):
348	                    acc = 0.0
349	                    for qi in range(kj, SEQ):
350	                        acc += attn[hh, qi, kj].item() * dctx[qi, qoff + t].item()
351	                    dqkv[kj, 2 * D_MODEL + qoff + t] = acc
352	        # B: dsc[hh,qi,kj] = attn*(datt - sum_k datt*attn)*scale
353	        dsc = torch.zeros(N_HEADS, SEQ, SEQ, dtype=_F64)
354	        for hh in range(N_HEADS):
355	            qoff = hh * D_HEAD
356	            for qi in range(SEQ):
357	                datt = [0.0] * SEQ
358	                for kj in range(qi + 1):
359	                    acc = 0.0
360	                    for t in range(D_HEAD):
361	                        acc += dctx[qi, qoff + t].item() * qkv[kj, 2 * D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
362	                    datt[kj] = acc
363	                dot = 0.0
364	                for kj in range(qi + 1):
365	                    dot += datt[kj] * attn[hh, qi, kj].item()
366	                for kj in range(SEQ):
367	                    a = attn[hh, qi, kj].item()
368	                    dsc[hh, qi, kj] = (a * (datt[kj] - dot) * ATTN_SCALE) if kj <= qi else 0.0
369	        # C: dq[pos,qoff+t]=sum_kj dsc[hh,pos,kj]*k[kj]; dk[pos]=sum_qi dsc[hh,qi,pos]*q[qi]
370	        for pos in range(SEQ):
371	            for hh in range(N_HEADS):
372	                qoff = hh * D_HEAD
373	                for t in range(D_HEAD):
374	                    dq = 0.0
375	                    dk = 0.0
376	                    for kj in range(SEQ):
377	                        dq += dsc[hh, pos, kj].item() * qkv[kj, D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
378	                        dk += dsc[hh, kj, pos].item() * qkv[kj, qoff + t].item()
379	                    dqkv[pos, qoff + t] = dq
380	                    dqkv[pos, D_MODEL + qoff + t] = dk
381	        # in_proj bwd: dW += dqkv^T @ x_in ; db += sum dqkv ; dx_in += dqkv @ in_w
382	        x_in = sm["layer_in"][li]
383	        for o in range(3 * D_MODEL):
384	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
385	                acc = 0.0
386	                for s in range(SEQ):
387	                    acc += dqkv[s, o].item() * x_in[s, i].item()
388	                g[gp + "attn.in_proj_weight"][o, i] += acc
389	            acc = 0.0
390	            for s in range(SEQ):
391	                acc += dqkv[s, o].item()
392	            g[gp + "attn.in_proj_bias"][o] += acc
393	        for s in range(SEQ):
394	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
395	                acc = 0.0
396	                for o in range(3 * D_MODEL):
397	                    acc += dqkv[s, o].item() * L["in_w"][o, i].item()
398	                dx_in[s, i] += acc
399	        dh = dx_in
400	    # embedding bwd: tok scatter-add per id (sequential positions), pos sum.
401	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
402	        for s in range(SEQ):
403	            d = dh[s, j]
404	            g["tok.weight"][tokens_s[s], j] += d
405	            g["pos.weight"][s, j] += d
406	
407	
408	def mirror_loss_and_grads(named_params: Dict[str, torch.Tensor],
409	                          tokens: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor):
410	    """Run the STRUCTURAL kernel mirror over the whole (small) batch.
411	
412	    Mirrors the CTA loop: per sample, forward then immediately backward,
413	    accumulating weight grads into one partial (here a single CTA == whole batch,
414	    which is what determinism requires per element). Returns (loss, grads)."""
415	    named = {k: v.to(_F64) for k, v in named_params.items()}
416	    W = DecoderWeights.from_named(named)
417	    lay = decoder_param_layout()
418	    g = {name: torch.zeros(shape, dtype=_F64)
419	         for name, shape in zip(lay["names"], lay["shapes"])}
420	    B = tokens.shape[0]
421	    nll_sum = 0.0
422	    for b in range(B):
423	        tok_s = [int(tokens[b, s]) for s in range(SEQ)]
424	        tgt = int(targets[b])
425	        sm = _forward_sample(W, tok_s, tgt)
426	        logits = sm["logits"]
427	        mx = logits.max().item()
428	        es = sum(math.exp(logits[o].item() - mx) for o in range(VOCAB))
429	        nll_sum += (mx + math.log(es)) - logits[tgt].item()
430	        _backward_sample(W, g, tok_s, tgt, B, sm)
431	    return nll_sum / B, g

1	"""tests/hw/vit_kernel_mirror.py — single-threaded STRUCTURAL mirror of the
2	CUDA ViT megakernel (csrc/fused/sm_90/model_stage_vit.cuh).
3	
4	WHY (the gate the math-oracle cannot provide): vit_oracle.py proves the ViT
5	fwd/bwd MATH is correct (matched to autograd ~1e-15). It does NOT exercise the
6	CUDA kernel's *structure* — the smem buffer reuse/aliasing, the recompute-in-
7	backward, the head-split index arithmetic, the owner-thread grad accumulation,
8	the per-sample sequential reduction, the cls/patch embedding-grad scatter. That
9	structure is exactly where a hand-written, un-runnable backward hides missing
10	terms / index bugs (e.g. summing dv over the causal triangle when ViT attention
11	is FULL, a wrong head-split offset, a dropped residual path, a recompute that
12	diverges from the forward).
13	
14	This module re-implements the kernel ALGORITHM in plain Python — same loop nests
15	and index math, same recompute-in-backward, same per-sample sequential weight-grad
16	accumulation into a CTA-style partial — so that asserting it against vit_oracle's
17	grads (~1e-12 on a tiny batch) catches that STRUCTURAL bug class.
18	
19	VALIDATION BOUNDARY — read before trusting a green run (the directive's three
20	distinct checks, kept honestly separate):
21	  * vit_oracle.py        : the MATH is correct (manual fwd+bwd == autograd ~1e-15).
22	  * THIS mirror          : the kernel's INDEX ARITHMETIC + RECOMPUTE STRUCTURE are
23	                           correct (== the oracle ~1e-12). The `_recompute_layer`
24	                           assertion (recompute reproduces the forward) is a real,
25	                           load-bearing check.
26	  * MANUAL INSPECTION ONLY (NOT covered by this mirror):
27	      - __syncthreads / grid-barrier placement (this mirror is single-threaded);
28	      - BUFFER OVERWRITE-ORDERING, i.e. the smem ALIASING SCHEDULE. This mirror
29	        holds each backward intermediate (dr2, dx1, dctx, dqkv, dsc, …) in its OWN
30	        fresh array, whereas model_stage_vit.cuh ALIASES them onto shared buffers
31	        (dr2→ctx, dx1→fn_xhat, dctx→ff0, dqkv→gact, …). So a DEAD-BUFFER READ in
32	        the .cu's actual aliasing order (reading a buffer after a later store has
33	        clobbered it) would NOT be caught here — the mirror's grads match the
34	        oracle regardless of overwrite order. That schedule is verified by reading
35	        each store/read against the kernel header's documented alias map. (The
36	        decoder mirror has the same boundary; an alias-faithful arena variant — one
37	        flat buffer with views at the .cu's relative offsets — is the way to close
38	        it on CPU and is noted as a follow-up in the report.)
39	  These three together are what "oracle/mirror agreement" means in the report —
40	  NOT "the kernel is validated end-to-end."
41	
42	The mirror follows the .cuh line-by-line: vit_forward_sample,
43	vit_recompute_layer, vit_backward_sample, vit_linear/_bwd, vit_layernorm_*, and
44	the three-pass FULL-attention backward (A: dv, B: dscores, C: dq/dk).
45	
46	STRUCTURAL DECISIONS MIRRORED (must match model_stage_vit.cuh exactly):
47	  * ONE layer live at a time; the backward RECOMPUTES each layer's forward from
48	    the cached layer INPUT (layer_in[li]) — only layer_in (+ the per-sample patch
49	    pixels) survive across layers.
50	  * Both ff0 (pre-GELU, for gelu') and gact (post-GELU g, for dW_ff2) are kept
51	    live within the layer being processed (dynamic smem, ~184 KB total budget —
52	    see the .cuh smem note). (NOTE: which array holds which intermediate is the
53	    aliasing schedule the mirror does NOT enforce — see the boundary above.)
54	  * FULL attention (no causal mask): dv sums over ALL qi; dq/dk over ALL kj/qi.
55	  * Embedding backward: pos.weight over all 17 positions; cls_token from pos 0;
56	    patch_proj.{weight,bias} from positions 1..16 against the live patch pixels.
57	"""
58	
59	from __future__ import annotations
60	
61	import math
62	from typing import Dict
63	
64	import torch
65	
66	from tests.hw.vit_oracle import (
67	    ViTWeights, vit_param_layout,
68	    VOCAB, D_MODEL, N_HEADS, N_LAYERS, PATCH_DIM, NUM_PATCHES, SEQ, D_FF,
69	    D_HEAD, LN_EPS, ATTN_SCALE, gelu, gelu_grad,
70	)
71	
72	_F64 = torch.float64  # mirror in fp64 so the only diff vs oracle is structure
73	
74	
75	# --- primitive ops, mirroring the .cuh device functions exactly --------------
76	def _linear(x, W, b, in_dim, out_dim, n_rows=SEQ):
77	    # y[s,o] = sum_k x[s,k]*W[o,k] + b[o]   (W row-major [out,in])
78	    y = torch.zeros(n_rows, out_dim, dtype=_F64)
79	    for s in range(n_rows):
80	        for o in range(out_dim):
81	            acc = b[o].item() if b is not None else 0.0
82	            for k in range(in_dim):
83	                acc += x[s, k].item() * W[o, k].item()
84	            y[s, o] = acc
85	    return y
86	
87	
88	def _layernorm_fwd(x, gamma, beta):
89	    y = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
90	    xhat = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
91	    inv = torch.zeros(SEQ, dtype=_F64)
92	    for s in range(SEQ):
93	        mean = x[s].mean()
94	        var = ((x[s] - mean) ** 2).mean()
95	        i = 1.0 / math.sqrt(var.item() + LN_EPS)
96	        inv[s] = i
97	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
98	            xh = (x[s, j] - mean) * i
99	            xhat[s, j] = xh
100	            y[s, j] = xh * gamma[j] + beta[j]
101	    return y, xhat, inv

104	# --- the per-sample forward (mirrors vit_forward_sample) ----------------------
105	def _forward_sample(W: ViTWeights, patch_s, target):
106	    """patch_s: [NUM_PATCHES, PATCH_DIM] float (this sample's image patches)."""
107	    sm = {}
108	    # Embedding: pos 0 = cls + pos[0]; pos 1..16 = patch_proj(patch_i) + pos[1+i].
109	    h = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
110	    cls = W.cls.reshape(D_MODEL)
111	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
112	        h[0, j] = cls[j] + W.pos[0, j]
113	    # patch_proj applied to the 16 patches -> rows 1..16.
114	    proj = _linear(patch_s, W.patch_w, W.patch_b, PATCH_DIM, D_MODEL,
115	                   n_rows=NUM_PATCHES)   # [16, d]
116	    for i in range(NUM_PATCHES):
117	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
118	            h[1 + i, j] = proj[i, j] + W.pos[1 + i, j]
119	    sm["layer_in"] = [h.clone(), None]
120	    for li in range(N_LAYERS):
121	        L = W.layers[li]
122	        hin = sm["layer_in"][li]
123	        qkv = _linear(hin, L["in_w"], L["in_b"], D_MODEL, 3 * D_MODEL)
124	        attn = torch.zeros(N_HEADS, SEQ, SEQ, dtype=_F64)
125	        ctx = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
126	        for hh in range(N_HEADS):
127	            qoff = hh * D_HEAD
128	            for qi in range(SEQ):
129	                sc = [0.0 for _ in range(SEQ)]
130	                maxs = -math.inf
131	                for kj in range(SEQ):  # FULL attention: every kj
132	                    dot = 0.0
133	                    for t in range(D_HEAD):
134	                        dot += qkv[qi, qoff + t].item() * qkv[kj, D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
135	                    sc[kj] = dot * ATTN_SCALE
136	                    maxs = max(maxs, sc[kj])
137	                denom = 0.0
138	                for kj in range(SEQ):
139	                    e = math.exp(sc[kj] - maxs)
140	                    sc[kj] = e
141	                    denom += e
142	                for kj in range(SEQ):
143	                    attn[hh, qi, kj] = sc[kj] / denom
144	                for t in range(D_HEAD):
145	                    acc = 0.0
146	                    for kj in range(SEQ):  # FULL: all kj contribute to ctx
147	                        acc += attn[hh, qi, kj].item() * qkv[kj, 2 * D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
148	                    ctx[qi, qoff + t] = acc
149	        a = _linear(ctx, L["out_w"], L["out_b"], D_MODEL, D_MODEL)
150	        r1 = hin + a
151	        x1, n1_xhat, n1_inv = _layernorm_fwd(r1, L["n1_w"], L["n1_b"])
152	        ff0 = _linear(x1, L["ff0_w"], L["ff0_b"], D_MODEL, D_FF)
153	        gact = gelu(ff0)
154	        ff2 = _linear(gact, L["ff2_w"], L["ff2_b"], D_FF, D_MODEL)
155	        r2 = x1 + ff2
156	        h2, n2_xhat, n2_inv = _layernorm_fwd(r2, L["n2_w"], L["n2_b"])
157	        sm[f"L{li}"] = dict(qkv=qkv, attn=attn, ctx=ctx, x1=x1, ff0=ff0,
158	                            gact=gact, n1_xhat=n1_xhat, n1_inv=n1_inv,
159	                            n2_xhat=n2_xhat, n2_inv=n2_inv)
160	        if li + 1 < N_LAYERS:
161	            sm["layer_in"][li + 1] = h2
162	        else:
163	            sm["final_in"] = h2
164	    # final norm (CLS pos 0) + head -> logits
165	    hcls = sm["final_in"][0]
166	    mean = hcls.mean()
167	    var = ((hcls - mean) ** 2).mean()
168	    inv = 1.0 / math.sqrt(var.item() + LN_EPS)
169	    fn_xhat = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
170	    hn = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
171	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
172	        xh = (hcls[j] - mean) * inv
173	        fn_xhat[j] = xh
174	        hn[j] = xh * W.norm_w[j] + W.norm_b[j]
175	    logits = torch.zeros(VOCAB, dtype=_F64)
176	    for o in range(VOCAB):
177	        acc = W.out_b[o].item()
178	        for k in range(D_MODEL):
179	            acc += hn[k].item() * W.out_w[o, k].item()
180	        logits[o] = acc
181	    sm["fn_xhat"] = fn_xhat
182	    sm["fn_inv"] = inv
183	    sm["logits"] = logits
184	    return sm
185

187	# --- recompute one layer's fwd intermediates (mirrors vit_recompute_layer) ----
188	def _recompute_layer(W, li, sm):
189	    """RE-RUN the layer forward from the cached layer INPUT (sm['layer_in'][li]),
190	    exactly as the CUDA vit_recompute_layer does (it does NOT reuse a per-layer
191	    cache — only layer_in survives). Exercises the recompute path's index math +
192	    that it reproduces the forward values; we assert it equals the original
193	    forward cache to catch a recompute divergence (a wrong residual or a clobbered
194	    input)."""
195	    L = W.layers[li]
196	    hin = sm["layer_in"][li]
197	    qkv = _linear(hin, L["in_w"], L["in_b"], D_MODEL, 3 * D_MODEL)
198	    attn = torch.zeros(N_HEADS, SEQ, SEQ, dtype=_F64)
199	    ctx = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
200	    for hh in range(N_HEADS):
201	        qoff = hh * D_HEAD
202	        for qi in range(SEQ):
203	            sc = [0.0 for _ in range(SEQ)]
204	            maxs = -math.inf
205	            for kj in range(SEQ):
206	                dot = 0.0
207	                for t in range(D_HEAD):
208	                    dot += qkv[qi, qoff + t].item() * qkv[kj, D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
209	                sc[kj] = dot * ATTN_SCALE
210	                maxs = max(maxs, sc[kj])
211	            denom = 0.0
212	            for kj in range(SEQ):
213	                e = math.exp(sc[kj] - maxs)
214	                sc[kj] = e
215	                denom += e
216	            for kj in range(SEQ):
217	                attn[hh, qi, kj] = sc[kj] / denom
218	            for t in range(D_HEAD):
219	                acc = 0.0
220	                for kj in range(SEQ):
221	                    acc += attn[hh, qi, kj].item() * qkv[kj, 2 * D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
222	                ctx[qi, qoff + t] = acc
223	    a = _linear(ctx, L["out_w"], L["out_b"], D_MODEL, D_MODEL)
224	    r1 = hin + a
225	    x1, n1_xhat, n1_inv = _layernorm_fwd(r1, L["n1_w"], L["n1_b"])
226	    ff0 = _linear(x1, L["ff0_w"], L["ff0_b"], D_MODEL, D_FF)
227	    gact = gelu(ff0)
228	    ff2 = _linear(gact, L["ff2_w"], L["ff2_b"], D_FF, D_MODEL)
229	    r2 = x1 + ff2
230	    _, n2_xhat, n2_inv = _layernorm_fwd(r2, L["n2_w"], L["n2_b"])
231	    rc = dict(qkv=qkv, attn=attn, ctx=ctx, x1=x1, ff0=ff0, gact=gact,
232	              n1_xhat=n1_xhat, n1_inv=n1_inv, n2_xhat=n2_xhat, n2_inv=n2_inv)
233	    # Recompute MUST reproduce the original forward exactly (same inputs/ops).
234	    orig = sm[f"L{li}"]
235	    for k in ("qkv", "ctx", "x1", "ff0", "gact", "n1_xhat", "n2_xhat"):
236	        d = (rc[k] - orig[k]).abs().max().item()
237	        assert d < 1e-9, f"recompute layer {li} field {k} diverged by {d:.2e}"
238	    return rc
