241	# --- the per-sample backward (mirrors vit_backward_sample) --------------------
242	def _backward_sample(W: ViTWeights, g: Dict[str, torch.Tensor],
243	                     patch_s, target, B, sm):
244	    # CE backward: dlogits = (softmax - onehot)/B
245	    logits = sm["logits"]
246	    mx = logits.max().item()
247	    es = sum(math.exp(logits[o].item() - mx) for o in range(VOCAB))
248	    dlogits = torch.zeros(VOCAB, dtype=_F64)
249	    for o in range(VOCAB):
250	        smo = math.exp(logits[o].item() - mx) / es
251	        dlogits[o] = (smo - (1.0 if o == target else 0.0)) / B
252	    # head bwd: dW_out += dlogits ⊗ hn ; db_out += dlogits ; dhn = dlogits @ out_w
253	    fn_xhat = sm["fn_xhat"]
254	    hn = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
255	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
256	        hn[j] = fn_xhat[j] * W.norm_w[j] + W.norm_b[j]
257	    for o in range(VOCAB):
258	        g["out.bias"][o] += dlogits[o]
259	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
260	            g["out.weight"][o, j] += dlogits[o] * hn[j]
261	    dhn = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
262	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
263	        acc = 0.0
264	        for o in range(VOCAB):
265	            acc += dlogits[o].item() * W.out_w[o, j].item()
266	        dhn[j] = acc
267	    # final-norm bwd (single row = CLS position 0).
268	    dy = dhn
269	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
270	        g["norm.bias"][j] += dy[j]
271	        g["norm.weight"][j] += dy[j] * fn_xhat[j]
272	    sda = sum((dy[j] * W.norm_w[j]).item() for j in range(D_MODEL))
273	    sdax = sum((dy[j] * W.norm_w[j] * fn_xhat[j]).item() for j in range(D_MODEL))
274	    inv_s = sm["fn_inv"]
275	    dh = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
276	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
277	        dxhat = dy[j] * W.norm_w[j]
278	        dh[0, j] = inv_s * (dxhat - (sda + fn_xhat[j] * sdax) / D_MODEL)
279	    # dh now = grad wrt the last layer's OUTPUT [SEQ,d] (only pos 0 nonzero).
280	    # per-layer backward (reverse)
281	    for li in reversed(range(N_LAYERS)):
282	        L = W.layers[li]
283	        gp = f"layers.{li}."
284	        c = _recompute_layer(W, li, sm)
285	        qkv, attn, ctx_fwd = c["qkv"], c["attn"], c["ctx"]
286	        x1, ff0, gact = c["x1"], c["ff0"], c["gact"]
287	        n1_xhat, n1_inv = c["n1_xhat"], c["n1_inv"]
288	        n2_xhat, n2_inv = c["n2_xhat"], c["n2_inv"]
289	        # n2 bwd: dh -> dr2 ; accumulate n2 gamma/beta.
290	        dr2 = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
291	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
292	            for s in range(SEQ):
293	                d = dh[s, j]
294	                g[gp + "n2.bias"][j] += d
295	                g[gp + "n2.weight"][j] += d * n2_xhat[s, j]
296	        for s in range(SEQ):
297	            sda = sum((dh[s, j] * L["n2_w"][j]).item() for j in range(D_MODEL))
298	            sdax = sum((dh[s, j] * L["n2_w"][j] * n2_xhat[s, j]).item()
299	                       for j in range(D_MODEL))
300	            for j in range(D_MODEL):
301	                dxhat = dh[s, j] * L["n2_w"][j]
302	                dr2[s, j] = n2_inv[s] * (dxhat - (sda + n2_xhat[s, j] * sdax) / D_MODEL)
303	        # dx1 := dr2 (residual). dff2 = dr2.
304	        dx1 = dr2.clone()
305	        # ff.2 bwd: dW += dr2^T @ gact ; db += sum dr2 ; dff0 = (dr2 @ ff2_w)*gelu'(ff0)
306	        for o in range(D_MODEL):
307	            for i in range(D_FF):
308	                acc = 0.0
309	                for s in range(SEQ):
310	                    acc += dr2[s, o].item() * gact[s, i].item()
311	                g[gp + "ff.2.weight"][o, i] += acc
312	            acc = 0.0
313	            for s in range(SEQ):
314	                acc += dr2[s, o].item()
315	            g[gp + "ff.2.bias"][o] += acc
316	        dff0 = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_FF, dtype=_F64)
317	        ggrad = gelu_grad(ff0)
318	        for s in range(SEQ):
319	            for i in range(D_FF):
320	                dg = 0.0
321	                for o in range(D_MODEL):
322	                    dg += dr2[s, o].item() * L["ff2_w"][o, i].item()
323	                dff0[s, i] = dg * ggrad[s, i]
324	        # ff.0 bwd: dW += dff0^T @ x1 ; db += sum dff0 ; dx1 += dff0 @ ff0_w
325	        for o in range(D_FF):
326	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
327	                acc = 0.0
328	                for s in range(SEQ):
329	                    acc += dff0[s, o].item() * x1[s, i].item()
330	                g[gp + "ff.0.weight"][o, i] += acc
331	            acc = 0.0
332	            for s in range(SEQ):
333	                acc += dff0[s, o].item()
334	            g[gp + "ff.0.bias"][o] += acc
335	        for s in range(SEQ):
336	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
337	                acc = 0.0
338	                for o in range(D_FF):
339	                    acc += dff0[s, o].item() * L["ff0_w"][o, i].item()
340	                dx1[s, i] += acc
341	        # n1 bwd: dx1 -> dr1 ; accumulate n1 gamma/beta.
342	        dr1 = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
343	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
344	            for s in range(SEQ):
345	                d = dx1[s, j]
346	                g[gp + "n1.bias"][j] += d
347	                g[gp + "n1.weight"][j] += d * n1_xhat[s, j]
348	        for s in range(SEQ):
349	            sda = sum((dx1[s, j] * L["n1_w"][j]).item() for j in range(D_MODEL))
350	            sdax = sum((dx1[s, j] * L["n1_w"][j] * n1_xhat[s, j]).item()
351	                       for j in range(D_MODEL))
352	            for j in range(D_MODEL):
353	                dxhat = dx1[s, j] * L["n1_w"][j]
354	                dr1[s, j] = n1_inv[s] * (dxhat - (sda + n1_xhat[s, j] * sdax) / D_MODEL)
355	        # r1 = x_in + a -> da = dr1 ; dx_in := dr1 (residual).
356	        da = dr1
357	        dx_in = dr1.clone()
358	        # out_proj bwd: dW += da^T @ ctx_fwd ; db += sum da ; dctx = da @ out_w
359	        for o in range(D_MODEL):
360	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
361	                acc = 0.0
362	                for s in range(SEQ):
363	                    acc += da[s, o].item() * ctx_fwd[s, i].item()
364	                g[gp + "attn.out_proj.weight"][o, i] += acc
365	            acc = 0.0
366	            for s in range(SEQ):
367	                acc += da[s, o].item()
368	            g[gp + "attn.out_proj.bias"][o] += acc
369	        dctx = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
370	        for s in range(SEQ):
371	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
372	                acc = 0.0
373	                for o in range(D_MODEL):
374	                    acc += da[s, o].item() * L["out_w"][o, i].item()
375	                dctx[s, i] = acc
376	        # --- attention backward (3 passes: A dv, B dscores, C dq/dk); FULL ---
377	        dqkv = torch.zeros(SEQ, 3 * D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
378	        # A: dv[kj,qoff+t] = sum_{qi} attn[hh,qi,kj]*dctx[qi,qoff+t]  (ALL qi)
379	        for kj in range(SEQ):
380	            for hh in range(N_HEADS):
381	                qoff = hh * D_HEAD
382	                for t in range(D_HEAD):
383	                    acc = 0.0
384	                    for qi in range(SEQ):
385	                        acc += attn[hh, qi, kj].item() * dctx[qi, qoff + t].item()
386	                    dqkv[kj, 2 * D_MODEL + qoff + t] = acc
387	        # B: dsc[hh,qi,kj] = attn*(datt - sum_k datt*attn)*scale   (FULL, all kj)
388	        dsc = torch.zeros(N_HEADS, SEQ, SEQ, dtype=_F64)
389	        for hh in range(N_HEADS):
390	            qoff = hh * D_HEAD
391	            for qi in range(SEQ):
392	                datt = [0.0] * SEQ
393	                for kj in range(SEQ):
394	                    acc = 0.0
395	                    for t in range(D_HEAD):
396	                        acc += dctx[qi, qoff + t].item() * qkv[kj, 2 * D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
397	                    datt[kj] = acc
398	                dot = 0.0
399	                for kj in range(SEQ):
400	                    dot += datt[kj] * attn[hh, qi, kj].item()
401	                for kj in range(SEQ):
402	                    a = attn[hh, qi, kj].item()
403	                    dsc[hh, qi, kj] = a * (datt[kj] - dot) * ATTN_SCALE
404	        # C: dq[pos,qoff+t]=sum_kj dsc[hh,pos,kj]*k[kj]; dk[pos]=sum_qi dsc[hh,qi,pos]*q[qi]
405	        for pos in range(SEQ):
406	            for hh in range(N_HEADS):
407	                qoff = hh * D_HEAD
408	                for t in range(D_HEAD):
409	                    dq = 0.0
410	                    dk = 0.0
411	                    for kj in range(SEQ):
412	                        dq += dsc[hh, pos, kj].item() * qkv[kj, D_MODEL + qoff + t].item()
413	                        dk += dsc[hh, kj, pos].item() * qkv[kj, qoff + t].item()
414	                    dqkv[pos, qoff + t] = dq
415	                    dqkv[pos, D_MODEL + qoff + t] = dk
416	        # in_proj bwd: dW += dqkv^T @ x_in ; db += sum dqkv ; dx_in += dqkv @ in_w
417	        x_in = sm["layer_in"][li]
418	        for o in range(3 * D_MODEL):
419	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
420	                acc = 0.0
421	                for s in range(SEQ):
422	                    acc += dqkv[s, o].item() * x_in[s, i].item()
423	                g[gp + "attn.in_proj_weight"][o, i] += acc
424	            acc = 0.0
425	            for s in range(SEQ):
426	                acc += dqkv[s, o].item()
427	            g[gp + "attn.in_proj_bias"][o] += acc
428	        for s in range(SEQ):
429	            for i in range(D_MODEL):
430	                acc = 0.0
431	                for o in range(3 * D_MODEL):
432	                    acc += dqkv[s, o].item() * L["in_w"][o, i].item()
433	                dx_in[s, i] += acc
434	        dh = dx_in
435	    # embedding bwd.  dh = grad wrt h0 [SEQ,d] (post-cat, pre-pos-add input to L0).
436	    #   pos.weight[s] += dh[s]   (ALL 17 positions; owner: thread per (s,j) col)
437	    #   cls_token     += dh[0]   (position 0 only)
438	    #   patch_proj: rows 1..16 are patch_proj(patch_i):
439	    #     dW_patch[o,i] += sum_{p=0..15} dh[1+p, o] * patch_s[p, i]
440	    #     db_patch[o]   += sum_{p=0..15} dh[1+p, o]
441	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
442	        for s in range(SEQ):
443	            g["pos.weight"][s, j] += dh[s, j]
444	        g["cls_token"][0, 0, j] += dh[0, j]
445	    # patch_proj weight/bias: owner thread per (o,i) output / per o bias; sum over
446	    # the 16 patch positions (sequential), reading the live patch pixels.
447	    for o in range(D_MODEL):
448	        for i in range(PATCH_DIM):
449	            acc = 0.0
450	            for p in range(NUM_PATCHES):
451	                acc += dh[1 + p, o].item() * patch_s[p, i].item()
452	            g["patch_proj.weight"][o, i] += acc
453	        acc = 0.0
454	        for p in range(NUM_PATCHES):
455	            acc += dh[1 + p, o].item()
456	        g["patch_proj.bias"][o] += acc
457	
458	
459	def mirror_loss_and_grads(named_params: Dict[str, torch.Tensor],
460	                          patches: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor):
461	    """Run the STRUCTURAL kernel mirror over the whole (small) batch.
462	
463	    Mirrors the CTA loop: per sample, forward then immediately backward,
464	    accumulating weight grads into one partial (here a single CTA == whole batch,
465	    which is what determinism requires per element). Returns (loss, grads)."""
466	    named = {k: v.to(_F64) for k, v in named_params.items()}
467	    W = ViTWeights.from_named(named)
468	    lay = vit_param_layout()
469	    g = {name: torch.zeros(shape, dtype=_F64)
470	         for name, shape in zip(lay["names"], lay["shapes"])}
471	    B = patches.shape[0]
472	    nll_sum = 0.0
473	    for b in range(B):
474	        patch_s = patches[b]                      # [16, 49] float
475	        tgt = int(targets[b])
476	        sm = _forward_sample(W, patch_s, tgt)
477	        logits = sm["logits"]
478	        mx = logits.max().item()
479	        es = sum(math.exp(logits[o].item() - mx) for o in range(VOCAB))
480	        nll_sum += (mx + math.log(es)) - logits[tgt].item()
481	        _backward_sample(W, g, patch_s, tgt, B, sm)
482	    return nll_sum / B, g

1	"""tests/hw/mamba_kernel_mirror.py — single-threaded STRUCTURAL mirror of the
2	CUDA Mamba megakernel (csrc/fused/sm_90/model_stage_mamba3.cuh).
3	
4	WHY (the gate the math-oracle cannot provide): mamba_oracle.py proves the Mamba
5	fwd/bwd MATH is correct (matched to autograd ~1e-15). It does NOT exercise the
6	CUDA kernel's *structure* — the per-channel REGISTER scan recurrence (h[STATE]
7	unrolled over seq=8), the scan BACKWARD's forward-recompute + reverse-scan, the
8	NON-causal conv1d transpose index math, the THREE-path dx_main accumulation
9	(D-skip + scan + x_proj), the softplus'-folded-in-scan, the per-(t,s) dB/dC
10	REDUCTION over channels, and the owner-thread weight-grad accumulation. That
11	structure is exactly where a hand-written, un-runnable backward hides missing
12	terms / index bugs / dead-buffer reads (e.g. a conv future-peek transposed the
13	wrong way, or a dx_main path dropped).
14	
15	This module re-implements the kernel ALGORITHM in plain Python — same per-channel
16	scan loops, same forward-recompute-in-scan-backward, same conv transpose, same
17	3-path dx_main sum, same per-sample sequential weight-grad accumulation into a
18	CTA-style partial — so that asserting it against mamba_oracle's grads (~1e-12 on
19	a tiny batch) catches the STRUCTURAL bug class. It is single-threaded, so it does
20	NOT catch __syncthreads races (those are verified by reading each sync against
21	the buffer it guards — see the kernel header comments); it DOES catch everything
22	else.
23	
24	The mirror follows the .cuh line-by-line: mb_forward_sample, mb_scan_fwd,
25	mb_conv1d_fwd, the gate/skip/out_proj, and mb_backward_sample's order 1..13
26	(LN bwd, out_proj bwd, gate+skip bwd, scan bwd, dt_proj bwd, x_proj bwd, conv
27	bwd, in_proj bwd, embedding bwd).
28	"""
29	
30	from __future__ import annotations
31	
32	import math
33	from typing import Dict
34	
35	import torch
36	
37	from tests.hw.mamba_oracle import (
38	    MambaWeights, mamba_param_layout,
39	    VOCAB, P_HEAD, D_MODEL, N_LAYERS, SEQ, D_INNER, STATE, DT_RANK, DBC, CONV_K,
40	    LN_EPS,
41	)
42	
43	_F64 = torch.float64  # mirror in fp64 so the only diff vs oracle is structure
44	
45	
46	# --- elementwise (mirror the .cuh device fns) --------------------------------
47	def _sigmoid(x):
48	    return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-x))
49	
50	
51	def _silu(x):
52	    return x * _sigmoid(x)
53	
54	
55	def _silu_grad(x):
56	    s = _sigmoid(x)
57	    return s * (1.0 + x * (1.0 - s))
58	
59	
60	def _softplus(x):
61	    return x if x > 20.0 else math.log1p(math.exp(x))
62	
63	
64	def _softplus_grad(x):
65	    return _sigmoid(x)
66	
67	
68	# --- primitive linear (mirror mb_linear) -------------------------------------
69	def _linear(x, W, b, in_dim, out_dim):
70	    # y[s,o] = sum_k x[s,k]*W[o,k] + b[o]
71	    y = torch.zeros(SEQ, out_dim, dtype=_F64)
72	    for s in range(SEQ):
73	        for o in range(out_dim):
74	            acc = b[o].item() if b is not None else 0.0
75	            for k in range(in_dim):
76	                acc += x[s, k].item() * W[o, k].item()
77	            y[s, o] = acc
78	    return y
79	
80	
81	def _layernorm_fwd(x, gamma, beta):
82	    y = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
83	    xhat = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
84	    inv = torch.zeros(SEQ, dtype=_F64)
85	    for s in range(SEQ):
86	        mean = x[s].mean()
87	        var = ((x[s] - mean) ** 2).mean()
88	        i = 1.0 / math.sqrt(var.item() + LN_EPS)
89	        inv[s] = i
90	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
91	            xh = (x[s, j] - mean) * i
92	            xhat[s, j] = xh
93	            y[s, j] = xh * gamma[j] + beta[j]
94	    return y, xhat, inv
95	
96	
97	# --- NON-causal depthwise conv1d (mirror mb_conv1d_fwd) ----------------------
98	def _conv1d_fwd(inp, W, b):
99	    # out[t,c] = b[c] + sum_k W[c,0,k]*in[t+k-1,c]   (zero-pad outside [0,SEQ))
100	    out = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_INNER, dtype=_F64)
101	    for t in range(SEQ):
102	        for c in range(D_INNER):
103	            acc = b[c].item()
104	            for k in range(CONV_K):
105	                tt = t + k - 1
106	                if 0 <= tt < SEQ:
107	                    acc += W[c, 0, k].item() * inp[tt, c].item()
108	            out[t, c] = acc
109	    return out
110	
111	
112	# --- per-channel register scan forward (mirror mb_scan_fwd) ------------------
113	def _scan_fwd(A_log, x_main, dt_pre, Bmat, Cmat):
114	    """Per channel j: h[STATE] in 'registers', unroll t. dt_pre is PRE-softplus.
115	    Returns y_scan [SEQ, D_INNER]."""
116	    y = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_INNER, dtype=_F64)
117	    for j in range(D_INNER):
118	        A = [-math.exp(A_log[j, s].item()) for s in range(STATE)]
119	        h = [0.0] * STATE
120	        for t in range(SEQ):
121	            xv = x_main[t, j].item()
122	            dt_t = _softplus(dt_pre[t, j].item())
123	            yacc = 0.0
124	            for s in range(STATE):
125	                adec = math.exp(dt_t * A[s])
126	                h[s] = adec * h[s] + dt_t * Bmat[t, s].item() * xv
127	                yacc += Cmat[t, s].item() * h[s]
128	            y[t, j] = yacc
129	    return y
130	
131	
132	# --- per-channel scan backward (mirror mb_scan_bwd) --------------------------
133	def _scan_bwd(A_log, x_main, dt_pre, Bmat, Cmat, dy_scan):
134	    """Per channel j: recompute fwd (h_hist in 'registers'), reverse-scan.
135	    Returns (dx_main_scan [SEQ,D_INNER], ddt_pre [SEQ,D_INNER],
136	             dBmat [SEQ,STATE], dCmat [SEQ,STATE], dA_log [D_INNER,STATE]).
137	    dBmat/dCmat are SUMMED over channels (reduced); dA_log is per-channel."""
138	    dx_main_scan = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_INNER, dtype=_F64)
139	    ddt_pre = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_INNER, dtype=_F64)
140	    dBmat = torch.zeros(SEQ, STATE, dtype=_F64)
141	    dCmat = torch.zeros(SEQ, STATE, dtype=_F64)
142	    dA_log = torch.zeros(D_INNER, STATE, dtype=_F64)
143	    for j in range(D_INNER):
144	        A = [-math.exp(A_log[j, s].item()) for s in range(STATE)]
145	        # forward recompute -> hh[t+1] = h_t (hh[0] = h_{-1} = 0)
146	        hh = [[0.0] * STATE for _ in range(SEQ + 1)]
147	        dt_save = [0.0] * SEQ
148	        a_save = [[0.0] * STATE for _ in range(SEQ)]
149	        for t in range(SEQ):
150	            xv = x_main[t, j].item()
151	            dt_t = _softplus(dt_pre[t, j].item())
152	            dt_save[t] = dt_t
153	            for s in range(STATE):
154	                adec = math.exp(dt_t * A[s])
155	                a_save[t][s] = adec
156	                hh[t + 1][s] = adec * hh[t][s] + dt_t * Bmat[t, s].item() * xv
157	        # reverse scan
158	        gh = [0.0] * STATE
159	        dA = [0.0] * STATE
160	        for t in reversed(range(SEQ)):
161	            xv = x_main[t, j].item()
162	            dt_t = dt_save[t]
163	            dyv = dy_scan[t, j].item()
164	            dx_acc = 0.0
165	            ddt_acc = 0.0
166	            for s in range(STATE):
167	                h_t = hh[t + 1][s]
168	                h_tm1 = hh[t][s]
169	                adec = a_save[t][s]
170	                cc = Cmat[t, s].item()
171	                bb = Bmat[t, s].item()
172	                dCmat[t, s] += h_t * dyv         # reduced over channels
173	                gh[s] += cc * dyv
174	                dBmat[t, s] += dt_t * xv * gh[s] # reduced over channels
175	                dx_acc += bb * dt_t * gh[s]
176	                ddt_acc += (A[s] * adec * h_tm1 + bb * xv) * gh[s]
177	                dA[s] += dt_t * adec * h_tm1 * gh[s]
178	                gh[s] = adec * gh[s]
179	            dx_main_scan[t, j] = dx_acc
180	            ddt_pre[t, j] = ddt_acc * _softplus_grad(dt_pre[t, j].item())
181	        for s in range(STATE):
182	            dA_log[j, s] = dA[s] * A[s]
183	    return dx_main_scan, ddt_pre, dBmat, dCmat, dA_log
184	
185	
186	# --- per-sample forward (mirror mb_forward_sample) ---------------------------
187	def _forward_sample(W: MambaWeights, tokens_s):
188	    sm = {}
189	    h = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
190	    for s in range(SEQ):
191	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
192	            h[s, j] = W.tok[tokens_s[s], j] + W.pos[s, j]
193	    sm["layer_in"] = [h.clone(), None]
194	    for li in range(N_LAYERS):
195	        L = W.layers[li]
196	        hin = sm["layer_in"][li]
197	        # in_proj -> x_main_raw | z
198	        xz = _linear(hin, L["in_w"], None, D_MODEL, 2 * D_INNER)
199	        x_main_raw = xz[:, :D_INNER].clone()
200	        z = xz[:, D_INNER:].clone()
201	        # conv1d (non-causal) -> conv (pre-silu); x_main = silu(conv)
202	        conv = _conv1d_fwd(x_main_raw, L["conv_w"], L["conv_b"])
203	        x_main = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_INNER, dtype=_F64)
204	        for t in range(SEQ):
205	            for c in range(D_INNER):
206	                x_main[t, c] = _silu(conv[t, c].item())
207	        # x_proj -> dt_raw, Bmat, Cmat
208	        x_dbc = _linear(x_main, L["x_proj_w"], None, D_INNER, DBC)
209	        dt_raw = x_dbc[:, :DT_RANK].clone()
210	        Bmat = x_dbc[:, DT_RANK:DT_RANK + STATE].clone()
211	        Cmat = x_dbc[:, DT_RANK + STATE:].clone()
212	        # dt_pre = dt_proj(dt_raw)+bias
213	        dt_pre = _linear(dt_raw, L["dt_proj_w"], L["dt_proj_b"], DT_RANK, D_INNER)
214	        # selective scan
215	        y_scan = _scan_fwd(L["A_log"], x_main, dt_pre, Bmat, Cmat)
216	        # gate+skip+out_proj
217	        y_gated = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_INNER, dtype=_F64)
218	        for t in range(SEQ):
219	            for c in range(D_INNER):
220	                yskip = y_scan[t, c].item() + x_main[t, c].item() * L["D"][c].item()
221	                y_gated[t, c] = yskip * _silu(z[t, c].item())
222	        y_out = _linear(y_gated, L["out_w"], None, D_INNER, D_MODEL)
223	        r = y_out + hin
224	        h2, ln_xhat, ln_inv = _layernorm_fwd(r, L["n_w"], L["n_b"])
225	        sm[f"L{li}"] = dict(x_main_raw=x_main_raw, z=z, conv=conv, x_main=x_main,
226	                            dt_pre=dt_pre, Bmat=Bmat, Cmat=Cmat, y_scan=y_scan,
227	                            y_gated=y_gated, ln_xhat=ln_xhat, ln_inv=ln_inv)
228	        if li + 1 < N_LAYERS:
229	            sm["layer_in"][li + 1] = h2
230	        else:
231	            sm["final_in"] = h2
232	    # final norm (last pos) + head
233	    hlast = sm["final_in"][SEQ - 1]
234	    mean = hlast.mean()
235	    var = ((hlast - mean) ** 2).mean()
236	    inv = 1.0 / math.sqrt(var.item() + LN_EPS)
237	    fn_xhat = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
238	    hn = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
239	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
240	        xh = (hlast[j] - mean) * inv
241	        fn_xhat[j] = xh
242	        hn[j] = xh * W.norm_w[j] + W.norm_b[j]
243	    logits = torch.zeros(P_HEAD, dtype=_F64)
244	    for o in range(P_HEAD):
245	        acc = W.out_b[o].item()
246	        for k in range(D_MODEL):
247	            acc += hn[k].item() * W.out_w[o, k].item()
248	        logits[o] = acc
249	    sm["fn_xhat"] = fn_xhat
250	    sm["fn_inv"] = inv
251	    sm["logits"] = logits
252	    return sm
253	
254	
255	# --- per-sample backward (mirror mb_backward_sample, order 1..13) ------------
256	def _backward_sample(W: MambaWeights, g: Dict[str, torch.Tensor], tokens_s,
257	                     target, B, sm):
258	    # CE backward
259	    logits = sm["logits"]
260	    mx = logits.max().item()
261	    es = sum(math.exp(logits[o].item() - mx) for o in range(P_HEAD))
262	    dlogits = torch.zeros(P_HEAD, dtype=_F64)
263	    for o in range(P_HEAD):
264	        smo = math.exp(logits[o].item() - mx) / es
265	        dlogits[o] = (smo - (1.0 if o == target else 0.0)) / B
266	    # head bwd
267	    fn_xhat = sm["fn_xhat"]
268	    hn = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
269	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
270	        hn[j] = fn_xhat[j] * W.norm_w[j] + W.norm_b[j]
271	    for o in range(P_HEAD):
272	        g["out.bias"][o] += dlogits[o]
273	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
274	            g["out.weight"][o, j] += dlogits[o] * hn[j]
275	    dhn = torch.zeros(D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
276	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
277	        acc = 0.0
278	        for o in range(P_HEAD):
279	            acc += dlogits[o].item() * W.out_w[o, j].item()
280	        dhn[j] = acc
281	    # final-norm bwd (single row last)
282	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
283	        g["norm.bias"][j] += dhn[j]
284	        g["norm.weight"][j] += dhn[j] * fn_xhat[j]
285	    sda = sum((dhn[j] * W.norm_w[j]).item() for j in range(D_MODEL))
286	    sdax = sum((dhn[j] * W.norm_w[j] * fn_xhat[j]).item() for j in range(D_MODEL))
287	    inv_s = sm["fn_inv"]
288	    dh = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
289	    for j in range(D_MODEL):
290	        dxhat = dhn[j] * W.norm_w[j]
291	        dh[SEQ - 1, j] = inv_s * (dxhat - (sda + fn_xhat[j] * sdax) / D_MODEL)
292	    # per-layer backward (reverse)
293	    for li in reversed(range(N_LAYERS)):
294	        L = W.layers[li]
295	        gp = f"layers.{li}."
296	        c = sm[f"L{li}"]
297	        hin = sm["layer_in"][li]
298	        x_main_raw, z, conv = c["x_main_raw"], c["z"], c["conv"]
299	        x_main, dt_pre = c["x_main"], c["dt_pre"]
300	        Bmat, Cmat, y_scan, y_gated = c["Bmat"], c["Cmat"], c["y_scan"], c["y_gated"]
301	        ln_xhat, ln_inv = c["ln_xhat"], c["ln_inv"]
302	        # (1) LN bwd: dh -> dr ; accumulate norm g/b
303	        dr = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_MODEL, dtype=_F64)
304	        for j in range(D_MODEL):
305	            for s in range(SEQ):
306	                d = dh[s, j]
307	                g[gp + "norm.bias"][j] += d
308	                g[gp + "norm.weight"][j] += d * ln_xhat[s, j]
309	        for s in range(SEQ):
310	            sda = sum((dh[s, j] * L["n_w"][j]).item() for j in range(D_MODEL))
311	            sdax = sum((dh[s, j] * L["n_w"][j] * ln_xhat[s, j]).item()
312	                       for j in range(D_MODEL))
313	            for j in range(D_MODEL):
314	                dxhat = dh[s, j] * L["n_w"][j]
315	                dr[s, j] = ln_inv[s] * (dxhat - (sda + ln_xhat[s, j] * sdax) / D_MODEL)
316	        # (2) r = y_out + residual: dy_out = dr ; dx_residual = dr
317	        dy_out = dr
318	        dx_residual = dr.clone()
319	        # (3) out_proj bwd: dW_out += dy_out^T @ y_gated ; dy_gated = dy_out @ out_w
320	        for o in range(D_MODEL):
321	            for cc in range(D_INNER):
322	                acc = 0.0
323	                for s in range(SEQ):
324	                    acc += dy_out[s, o].item() * y_gated[s, cc].item()
325	                g[gp + "out_proj.weight"][o, cc] += acc
326	        dy_gated = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_INNER, dtype=_F64)
327	        for s in range(SEQ):
328	            for cc in range(D_INNER):
329	                acc = 0.0
330	                for o in range(D_MODEL):
331	                    acc += dy_out[s, o].item() * L["out_w"][o, cc].item()
332	                dy_gated[s, cc] = acc
333	        # (4-6) gate+skip bwd: dz, dy_scan, dx_main(D-path), dD
334	        dz = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_INNER, dtype=_F64)
335	        dy_scan = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_INNER, dtype=_F64)
336	        dx_main = torch.zeros(SEQ, D_INNER, dtype=_F64)   # accumulator (3 paths)
337	        for cc in range(D_INNER):
338	            dDc = 0.0
339	            for s in range(SEQ):
340	                sz = _silu(z[s, cc].item())
341	                xm = x_main[s, cc].item()
342	                yskip = y_scan[s, cc].item() + xm * L["D"][cc].item()
343	                dyg = dy_gated[s, cc].item()
344	                dyskip = dyg * sz
345	                dsz = dyg * yskip
346	                dz[s, cc] = dsz * _silu_grad(z[s, cc].item())
347	                dDc += dyskip * xm
348	                dy_scan[s, cc] = dyskip
349	                dx_main[s, cc] += dyskip * L["D"][cc].item()   # D-path
350	            g[gp + "D"][cc] += dDc
351	        # (7) scan bwd -> dx_main(scan path), ddt_pre, dB, dC, dA_log
352	        dx_scan, ddt_pre, dBmat, dCmat, dA_log = _scan_bwd(
353	            L["A_log"], x_main, dt_pre, Bmat, Cmat, dy_scan)
354	        for j in range(D_INNER):
355	            for s in range(STATE):
356	                g[gp + "A_log"][j, s] += dA_log[j, s]
357	        for s in range(SEQ):
358	            for cc in range(D_INNER):
359	                dx_main[s, cc] += dx_scan[s, cc]               # scan path
360	        # (8) dt_proj bwd: recompute dt_raw = (x_proj(x_main))[:, :dt_rank]
361	        dt_raw = torch.zeros(SEQ, DT_RANK, dtype=_F64)
362	        for s in range(SEQ):
363	            for o in range(DT_RANK):
364	                acc = 0.0
365	                for k in range(D_INNER):
366	                    acc += x_main[s, k].item() * L["x_proj_w"][o, k].item()
367	                dt_raw[s, o] = acc
368	        for o in range(D_INNER):
369	            for i in range(DT_RANK):
370	                acc = 0.0
371	                for s in range(SEQ):
372	                    acc += ddt_pre[s, o].item() * dt_raw[s, i].item()
373	                g[gp + "dt_proj.weight"][o, i] += acc
374	            acc = 0.0
375	            for s in range(SEQ):
376	                acc += ddt_pre[s, o].item()
377	            g[gp + "dt_proj.bias"][o] += acc
378	        ddt_raw = torch.zeros(SEQ, DT_RANK, dtype=_F64)
379	        for s in range(SEQ):
380	            for i in range(DT_RANK):
381	                acc = 0.0
382	                for o in range(D_INNER):

455	def mirror_loss_and_grads(named_params: Dict[str, torch.Tensor],
456	                          tokens: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor):
457	    """Run the STRUCTURAL kernel mirror over the whole (small) batch.
458	
459	    Mirrors the CTA loop: per sample, forward then immediately backward,
460	    accumulating weight grads into one partial (single CTA == whole batch, which
461	    is what determinism requires per element). Returns (loss, grads)."""
462	    named = {k: v.to(_F64) for k, v in named_params.items()}
463	    W = MambaWeights.from_named(named)
464	    lay = mamba_param_layout()
465	    g = {name: torch.zeros(shape, dtype=_F64)
466	         for name, shape in zip(lay["names"], lay["shapes"])}
467	    B = tokens.shape[0]
468	    nll_sum = 0.0
469	    for b in range(B):
470	        tok_s = [int(tokens[b, s]) for s in range(SEQ)]
471	        tgt = int(targets[b])
472	        sm = _forward_sample(W, tok_s)
473	        logits = sm["logits"]
474	        mx = logits.max().item()
475	        es = sum(math.exp(logits[o].item() - mx) for o in range(P_HEAD))
476	        nll_sum += (mx + math.log(es)) - logits[tgt].item()
477	        _backward_sample(W, g, tok_s, tgt, B, sm)
478	    return nll_sum / B, g

307	                                 torch.triu(torch.ones(seq_len, seq_len, dtype=torch.bool), 1))
308	
309	        def forward(self, x):
310	            a, _ = self.attn(x, x, x, attn_mask=self.causal_mask)
311	            x = self.n1(x + a); return self.n2(x + self.ff(x))
312	
313	    class Transformer(nn.Module):
314	        def __init__(self, nl=2, d=128, h=4, ntok=99, seq=4):
315	            super().__init__()
316	            self.tok = nn.Embedding(ntok, d); self.pos = nn.Embedding(seq, d)
317	            self.layers = nn.ModuleList([DecoderBlock(d, h, seq_len=seq) for _ in range(nl)])
318	            self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d); self.out = nn.Linear(d, ntok)
319	            self.register_buffer('pos_ids', torch.arange(seq).unsqueeze(0))
320	
321	        def forward(self, x):
322	            h = self.tok(x) + self.pos(self.pos_ids)
323	            for l in self.layers:
324	                h = l(h)
325	            return self.out(self.norm(h)[:, -1, :])
326	
327	    torch.manual_seed(seed)
328	    return Transformer(N_LAYERS, D_MODEL, N_HEADS, VOCAB, SEQ).to(device)

376	def _eager_bf16_loss_grads(m, tokens, targets):
377	    """One fwd+bwd of the eager decoder under autocast(bf16) — the bf16-matmul/
378	    fp32-accumulate oracle the TC kernel emulates. Returns (loss float, grads
379	    dict name→tensor)."""
380	    import torch.nn.functional as F
381	    m.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
382	    with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
383	        logits = m(tokens)

390	def _bf16_faithful_oracle(named, tokens, targets):
391	    """The R2.3 NAMED reference (DESIGN §5.2): the decoder fwd+bwd computed in
392	    fp64 but with EVERY value the TC kernel STORES rounded to bf16 at the SAME
393	    points (DecActs X_in/X_ctx/X_x1/X_gact, qkv, ff0pre, X_hn, every dY_*, dh0;
394	    weights bf16-on-read). Math is fp64; bf16 ONLY at the kernel's storage points.
395	
396	    Unlike autocast-bf16 (which keeps adjoints fp32 through the backward and casts
397	    only at matmul inputs), this rounds at the kernel's exact storage boundary, so
398	    a real kernel bug shows rel~1 while the intended bf16-storage shows ~bf16-floor.
399	    This is the faithful instrument that separates a bug from bf16 noise. Runs on
400	    CPU (fp64, tiny) so it never competes with the kernel for GPU memory.
401	    Transcribed from tests/hw/decoder_oracle.py with the storage rounds inserted."""
402	    import math
403	    from tests.hw.decoder_oracle import (
404	        VOCAB, D_MODEL, N_HEADS, N_LAYERS, SEQ, D_FF, D_HEAD, ATTN_SCALE,
405	        gelu, gelu_grad, layernorm_forward, layernorm_backward,
406	        softmax_lastdim, softmax_backward, _causal_mask, DecoderWeights)
407	    B16 = torch.bfloat16
408	
409	    def bf(x):
410	        return x.to(B16).to(torch.float64)
411	
412	    W = DecoderWeights.from_named({k: v.double() for k, v in named.items()})
413	    Bn, S = tokens.shape
414	    dev = tokens.device
415	    add_mask = _causal_mask(S, dev, torch.float64)
416	    pos_ids = torch.arange(S, device=dev)
417	    h = bf(bf(W.tok)[tokens] + bf(W.pos)[pos_ids].unsqueeze(0))   # X_in[0] bf16
418	    caches = []
419	    for li in range(N_LAYERS):
420	        L = W.layers[li]
421	        x_in = h
422	        qkv = bf(x_in @ bf(L["in_w"]).t() + L["in_b"].double())   # qkv bf16
423	        q, k, v = qkv.split(D_MODEL, dim=-1)
424	        def sh(t): return t.reshape(Bn, S, N_HEADS, D_HEAD).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
425	        qh, kh, vh = sh(q), sh(k), sh(v)
426	        scores = (qh @ kh.transpose(-2, -1)) * ATTN_SCALE + add_mask   # fp64 attn
427	        attn = softmax_lastdim(scores)
428	        ctx = (attn @ vh).permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(Bn, S, D_MODEL)
429	        ctx_b = bf(ctx)                                            # X_ctx bf16
430	        a = (ctx_b @ bf(L["out_w"]).t() + L["out_b"].double())     # fp32 work (NOT stored bf16)
431	        r1 = x_in + a
432	        x1, ln1 = layernorm_forward(r1, L["n1_w"].double(), L["n1_b"].double())
433	        x1_b = bf(x1)                                              # X_x1 bf16
434	        ff0 = x1_b @ bf(L["ff0_w"]).t() + L["ff0_b"].double()
435	        ff0_b = bf(ff0)                                            # ff0pre bf16
436	        g = bf(gelu(ff0))                                         # X_gact bf16
437	        ff2 = g @ bf(L["ff2_w"]).t() + L["ff2_b"].double()
438	        r2 = x1 + ff2
439	        h2, ln2 = layernorm_forward(r2, L["n2_w"].double(), L["n2_b"].double())
440	        h = bf(h2) if li + 1 < N_LAYERS else h2                    # X_in[li+1] bf16 / finalin fp32
441	        caches.append(dict(x_in=x_in, attn=attn, vh=vh, qh=qh, kh=kh, ctx=ctx_b,
442	                           x1=x1, x1_b=x1_b, ln1=ln1, ff0_b=ff0_b, g=g, ln2=ln2))
443	    h_last = h[:, -1, :]
444	    hn, nc = layernorm_forward(h_last, W.norm_w.double(), W.norm_b.double())
445	    hn_b = bf(hn)                                                 # X_hn bf16
446	    logits = hn_b @ W.out_w.double().t() + W.out_b.double()
447	    mx = logits.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
448	    logz = mx.squeeze(-1) + torch.log(torch.exp(logits - mx).sum(dim=-1))
449	    loss = (logz - logits.gather(1, targets.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)).mean()
450	    grads = {}

450	    grads = {}
451	    sm = softmax_lastdim(logits); oh = torch.zeros_like(sm)
452	    oh.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0)
453	    dlogits = bf((sm - oh) / Bn)                                  # dY_logits bf16
454	    grads["out.weight"] = dlogits.t() @ hn_b
455	    grads["out.bias"] = dlogits.sum(0)
456	    dhn = dlogits @ W.out_w.double()
457	    dh_last, dnw, dnb = layernorm_backward(dhn, nc)
458	    grads["norm.weight"] = dnw; grads["norm.bias"] = dnb
459	    dh = torch.zeros(Bn, S, D_MODEL, device=dev, dtype=torch.float64); dh[:, -1, :] = dh_last
460	    for li in reversed(range(N_LAYERS)):
461	        L = W.layers[li]; lc = caches[li]
462	        dr2, d2w, d2b = layernorm_backward(dh, lc["ln2"])
463	        grads[f"layers.{li}.n2.weight"] = d2w; grads[f"layers.{li}.n2.bias"] = d2b
464	        dff2 = bf(dr2)                                            # dY_ff2 bf16
465	        dx1 = dr2.clone()
466	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.2.weight"] = dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t() @ lc["g"].reshape(-1, D_FF)
467	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.2.bias"] = dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(0)
468	        dg = dff2 @ bf(L["ff2_w"])
469	        dff0 = bf(dg * gelu_grad(lc["ff0_b"]))                    # dY_ff0 bf16; gelu' reads ff0pre(bf16)
470	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.0.weight"] = dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).t() @ lc["x1_b"].reshape(-1, D_MODEL)
471	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.0.bias"] = dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).sum(0)
472	        dx1 = dx1 + dff0 @ bf(L["ff0_w"])
473	        dr1, d1w, d1b = layernorm_backward(dx1, lc["ln1"])
474	        grads[f"layers.{li}.n1.weight"] = d1w; grads[f"layers.{li}.n1.bias"] = d1b
475	        da = bf(dr1)                                              # dY_a bf16
476	        dx_in = dr1.clone()
477	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.out_proj.weight"] = da.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t() @ lc["ctx"].reshape(-1, D_MODEL)
478	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.out_proj.bias"] = da.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(0)
479	        dctx = da @ bf(L["out_w"])
480	        dctxh = dctx.reshape(Bn, S, N_HEADS, D_HEAD).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
481	        attn = lc["attn"]; vh = lc["vh"]; qh = lc["qh"]; kh = lc["kh"]
482	        dattn = dctxh @ vh.transpose(-2, -1); dvh = attn.transpose(-2, -1) @ dctxh
483	        dsc = softmax_backward(dattn, attn) * ATTN_SCALE
484	        dqh = dsc @ kh; dkh = dsc.transpose(-2, -1) @ qh
485	        def mh(t): return t.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(Bn, S, D_MODEL)
486	        dqkv = bf(torch.cat([mh(dqh), mh(dkh), mh(dvh)], dim=-1))  # dY_qkv bf16
487	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.in_proj_weight"] = dqkv.reshape(-1, 3 * D_MODEL).t() @ lc["x_in"].reshape(-1, D_MODEL)
488	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.in_proj_bias"] = dqkv.reshape(-1, 3 * D_MODEL).sum(0)
489	        dx_in = dx_in + dqkv @ bf(L["in_w"])
490	        dh = dx_in
491	    dh_b = bf(dh)                                                 # dh0 bf16
492	    dtok = torch.zeros_like(W.tok.double())
493	    dtok.index_add_(0, tokens.reshape(-1), dh_b.reshape(-1, D_MODEL))
494	    grads["tok.weight"] = dtok
495	    grads["pos.weight"] = dh_b.sum(0)
496	    return loss.item(), grads

508	def _run_tc_step(mod, params, tokens, targets, state, lr, betas, wd, eps, step):
509	    beta1, beta2 = betas
510	    bc1 = 1.0 - beta1 ** step
511	    bc2 = 1.0 - beta2 ** step
512	    return mod.tc_train_step(params, tokens.to(torch.int32), targets.to(torch.int32),

518	# Grad tolerances (DESIGN §5.2, CALIBRATED — not loosened). The dW = Σ_T dY·X
519	# contraction over T terms with sign cancellation has an irreducible bf16-INPUT
520	# noise floor of several % even against the bf16-faithful oracle (both sides
521	# round the SAME operands, but the SUMMATION ORDER + the bf16 round of each
522	# operand still differ from a single-shot torch matmul). Biases (Σ dY, less
523	# cancellation) stay tighter. The structural witness is layer-0 ≈ layer-1 (a
524	# real bug makes early layers ≫ late); the absolute floor is calibrated below.
525	_TC_GRAD_REL_WEIGHTS = 0.15   # weight matrices (dW, T-contraction bf16 floor)
526	_TC_GRAD_REL_BIASES = 0.08    # biases / LN vectors / embeddings (less cancellation)
527	# loss (logsumexp fp32) — bf16-floor CALIBRATED, ViT-equivalent (the same discipline:
528	# gate to the measured bf16 floor, NOT a loose 5e-3). With all four linear biases
529	# folded (in/out/ff0/ff2 — matching the scalar path + the bf16-faithful oracle) the
530	# fixed kernel loss-rel is 2.85e-5; the bias-omission bug rode at 2.52e-4. 1e-4 threads
531	# the measured (2.85e-5, 2.52e-4) window (geometric-mean-centered, ~3x margin each side):
532	# it PASSES the faithful kernel (3.5x headroom) and CATCHES the bias bug (2.5x), per the
533	# no-suppression discipline — a 50x tightening over the old 5e-3 that never saw the bug.
534	_TC_LOSS_REL = 1e-4

245	def _build_eager_vit(device="cuda", seed=0):
246	    """The exact race ViT (== tests/hw/test_vit_megakernel.py's builder), fp32
247	    params. Autocast supplies the bf16 matmul boundary in the trajectory gate."""
248	    import torch.nn as nn
249	    from tests.hw.vit_oracle import (VOCAB, D_MODEL, N_HEADS, N_LAYERS,
250	                                     PATCH_DIM, NUM_PATCHES)
251	
252	    class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):
253	        def __init__(self, d, h):
254	            super().__init__()
255	            self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(d, h, dropout=0., batch_first=True)
256	            self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d); self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
257	            self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, 4 * d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(4 * d, d))
258	
259	        def forward(self, x):
260	            a, _ = self.attn(x, x, x)   # NO mask — full attention
261	            x = self.n1(x + a); return self.n2(x + self.ff(x))
262	
263	    class ViT(nn.Module):
264	        def __init__(self, p=VOCAB, patch_dim=PATCH_DIM, num_patches=NUM_PATCHES,
265	                     d=D_MODEL, h=N_HEADS, nl=N_LAYERS):
266	            super().__init__()
267	            self.patch_proj = nn.Linear(patch_dim, d)
268	            self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, d) * 0.02)
269	            self.pos = nn.Embedding(num_patches + 1, d)
270	            self.layers = nn.ModuleList([EncoderBlock(d, h) for _ in range(nl)])
271	            self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d); self.out = nn.Linear(d, p)
272	            self.register_buffer('pos_ids', torch.arange(num_patches + 1).unsqueeze(0))
273	
274	        def forward(self, x):
275	            B = x.size(0); h = self.patch_proj(x)
276	            h = torch.cat([self.cls_token.expand(B, -1, -1), h], dim=1)
277	            h = h + self.pos(self.pos_ids)
278	            for l in self.layers:
279	                h = l(h)
280	            return self.out(self.norm(h[:, 0, :]))
281	
282	    torch.manual_seed(seed)
283	    return ViT().to(device)

290	def _bf16_faithful_oracle(named, patches, targets):
291	    """The NAMED reference (DESIGN §5.2): the ViT fwd+bwd computed in fp64 but
292	    with EVERY value the TC kernel STORES rounded to bf16 at the SAME points
293	    (VitActs X_patch/X_in/X_ctx/X_x1/X_gact, qkv, ff0pre, X_hn, every dY_*, dh0;
294	    weights bf16-on-read). Math is fp64; bf16 ONLY at the kernel's storage points.
295	
296	    Unlike autocast-bf16 (adjoints fp32 through the backward), this rounds at the
297	    kernel's exact storage boundary, so a real kernel bug shows rel~1 while the
298	    intended bf16-storage shows ~bf16-floor. Runs on CPU (fp64, tiny) so it never
299	    competes with the kernel for GPU memory. Transcribed from tests/hw/
300	    vit_oracle.py with the storage rounds inserted (the ViT twin of the decoder
301	    bf16-faithful oracle).
302	
303	    DELTAS vs the decoder oracle: patch_proj embedding (K=49→bf16 patches @ bf16
304	    patch_w), FULL attention (no causal mask), CLS at pos 0, cls_token grad.
305	    """
306	    from tests.hw.vit_oracle import (
307	        VOCAB, D_MODEL, N_HEADS, N_LAYERS, SEQ, D_FF, D_HEAD, ATTN_SCALE,
308	        NUM_PATCHES, PATCH_DIM, gelu, gelu_grad, layernorm_forward,
309	        layernorm_backward, softmax_lastdim, softmax_backward, ViTWeights)
310	    B16 = torch.bfloat16
311	
312	    def bf(x):
313	        return x.to(B16).to(torch.float64)
314	
315	    W = ViTWeights.from_named({k: v.double() for k, v in named.items()})
316	    patches = patches.double()
317	    Bn = patches.shape[0]
318	    dev = patches.device
319	    # ── embedding: patch_proj (bf16 patches @ bf16 patch_w) + cls + pos ──
320	    px = bf(patches)                                          # X_patch bf16 [B,16,49]
321	    proj = px @ bf(W.patch_w).t() + W.patch_b.double()        # fp32 (bias not stored bf16)
322	    cls = W.cls.double().reshape(1, 1, D_MODEL).expand(Bn, 1, D_MODEL)
323	    h0 = torch.cat([cls, proj], dim=1)                        # [B,17,d]
324	    pos_ids = torch.arange(SEQ, device=dev)
325	    h0 = h0 + W.pos.double()[pos_ids].unsqueeze(0)
326	    h = bf(h0)                                                # X_in[0] bf16
327	    caches = []
328	    for li in range(N_LAYERS):
329	        L = W.layers[li]
330	        x_in = h
331	        qkv = bf(x_in @ bf(L["in_w"]).t() + L["in_b"].double())   # qkv bf16
332	        q, k, v = qkv.split(D_MODEL, dim=-1)
333	        def sh(t): return t.reshape(Bn, SEQ, N_HEADS, D_HEAD).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
334	        qh, kh, vh = sh(q), sh(k), sh(v)
335	        scores = (qh @ kh.transpose(-2, -1)) * ATTN_SCALE         # fp64 attn, NO mask
336	        attn = softmax_lastdim(scores)
337	        ctx = (attn @ vh).permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(Bn, SEQ, D_MODEL)
338	        ctx_b = bf(ctx)                                           # X_ctx bf16
339	        a = (ctx_b @ bf(L["out_w"]).t() + L["out_b"].double())     # fp32 work
340	        r1 = x_in + a
341	        x1, ln1 = layernorm_forward(r1, L["n1_w"].double(), L["n1_b"].double())
342	        x1_b = bf(x1)                                             # X_x1 bf16
343	        ff0 = x1_b @ bf(L["ff0_w"]).t() + L["ff0_b"].double()
344	        ff0_b = bf(ff0)                                           # ff0pre bf16
345	        g = bf(gelu(ff0))                                         # X_gact bf16
346	        ff2 = g @ bf(L["ff2_w"]).t() + L["ff2_b"].double()
347	        r2 = x1 + ff2
348	        h2, ln2 = layernorm_forward(r2, L["n2_w"].double(), L["n2_b"].double())
349	        h = bf(h2) if li + 1 < N_LAYERS else h2                   # X_in[li+1] bf16 / finalin fp32
350	        caches.append(dict(x_in=x_in, attn=attn, vh=vh, qh=qh, kh=kh, ctx=ctx_b,
351	                           x1=x1, x1_b=x1_b, ln1=ln1, ff0_b=ff0_b, g=g, ln2=ln2))
352	    h_cls = h[:, 0, :]                                            # CLS pos 0
353	    hn, nc = layernorm_forward(h_cls, W.norm_w.double(), W.norm_b.double())
354	    hn_b = bf(hn)                                                # X_hn bf16
355	    logits = hn_b @ W.out_w.double().t() + W.out_b.double()
356	    mx = logits.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
357	    logz = mx.squeeze(-1) + torch.log(torch.exp(logits - mx).sum(dim=-1))
358	    loss = (logz - logits.gather(1, targets.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)).mean()
359	    grads = {}
360	    sm = softmax_lastdim(logits); oh = torch.zeros_like(sm)
361	    oh.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0)
362	    dlogits = bf((sm - oh) / Bn)                                  # dY_logits bf16
363	    grads["out.weight"] = dlogits.t() @ hn_b
364	    grads["out.bias"] = dlogits.sum(0)
365	    dhn = dlogits @ W.out_w.double()
366	    dh_cls, dnw, dnb = layernorm_backward(dhn, nc)
367	    grads["norm.weight"] = dnw; grads["norm.bias"] = dnb
368	    dh = torch.zeros(Bn, SEQ, D_MODEL, device=dev, dtype=torch.float64)
369	    dh[:, 0, :] = dh_cls                                          # CLS pos 0
370	    for li in reversed(range(N_LAYERS)):
371	        L = W.layers[li]; lc = caches[li]
372	        dr2, d2w, d2b = layernorm_backward(dh, lc["ln2"])
373	        grads[f"layers.{li}.n2.weight"] = d2w; grads[f"layers.{li}.n2.bias"] = d2b
374	        dff2 = bf(dr2)                                            # dY_ff2 bf16
375	        dx1 = dr2.clone()
376	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.2.weight"] = dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t() @ lc["g"].reshape(-1, D_FF)
377	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.2.bias"] = dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(0)
378	        dg = dff2 @ bf(L["ff2_w"])
379	        dff0 = bf(dg * gelu_grad(lc["ff0_b"]))                    # dY_ff0 bf16; gelu' reads ff0pre(bf16)
380	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.0.weight"] = dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).t() @ lc["x1_b"].reshape(-1, D_MODEL)
381	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.0.bias"] = dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).sum(0)
382	        dx1 = dx1 + dff0 @ bf(L["ff0_w"])
383	        dr1, d1w, d1b = layernorm_backward(dx1, lc["ln1"])
384	        grads[f"layers.{li}.n1.weight"] = d1w; grads[f"layers.{li}.n1.bias"] = d1b
385	        da = bf(dr1)                                              # dY_a bf16
386	        dx_in = dr1.clone()
387	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.out_proj.weight"] = da.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t() @ lc["ctx"].reshape(-1, D_MODEL)
388	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.out_proj.bias"] = da.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(0)
389	        dctx = da @ bf(L["out_w"])
390	        dctxh = dctx.reshape(Bn, SEQ, N_HEADS, D_HEAD).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
391	        attn = lc["attn"]; vh = lc["vh"]; qh = lc["qh"]; kh = lc["kh"]
392	        dattn = dctxh @ vh.transpose(-2, -1); dvh = attn.transpose(-2, -1) @ dctxh
393	        dsc = softmax_backward(dattn, attn) * ATTN_SCALE
394	        dqh = dsc @ kh; dkh = dsc.transpose(-2, -1) @ qh
395	        def mh(t): return t.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(Bn, SEQ, D_MODEL)
396	        dqkv = bf(torch.cat([mh(dqh), mh(dkh), mh(dvh)], dim=-1))  # dY_qkv bf16
397	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.in_proj_weight"] = dqkv.reshape(-1, 3 * D_MODEL).t() @ lc["x_in"].reshape(-1, D_MODEL)
398	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.in_proj_bias"] = dqkv.reshape(-1, 3 * D_MODEL).sum(0)
399	        dx_in = dx_in + dqkv @ bf(L["in_w"])
400	        dh = dx_in
401	    dh_b = bf(dh)                                                 # dh0 bf16
402	    # ── embedding bwd: cls_token (pos 0), pos (all 17), patch_proj (rows 1..16). ──
403	    grads["cls_token"] = dh_b[:, 0, :].sum(0).reshape(1, 1, D_MODEL)
404	    grads["pos.weight"] = dh_b.sum(0)
405	    dh_patch = dh_b[:, 1:, :]                                     # [B,16,d]
406	    grads["patch_proj.weight"] = dh_patch.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t() @ px.reshape(-1, PATCH_DIM)
407	    grads["patch_proj.bias"] = dh_patch.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(0)
408	    return loss.item(), grads

105	def _build_m3(named, dtype):

140	#  oracle's fwd+bwd PRIMITIVES (mamba3_oracle.*) re-run in fp64 with EVERY value
141	#  the Mamba-3 TC kernel STORES rounded to bf16 at the SAME points. The PRECISION

189	    caches = []

194	        pre = f"layers.{li}."

214	        A_arg = A_mod + base_rate.view(1, 1, -1)

219	        Bin, Bicache = rmsnorm_forward(Bi, P[pre + "mixer.Bhat_norm.weight"], eps)
220	        Crn, Ccache = rmsnorm_forward(Cr, P[pre + "mixer.C_norm.weight"], eps)
221	        Cin, Cicache = rmsnorm_forward(Ci, P[pre + "mixer.Chat_norm.weight"], eps)
222	        Br2 = Brn + P[pre + "mixer.B_bias"]

226	        Bbar = torch.stack((Br2, Bi2), dim=-1)
227	        Cbar = torch.stack((Cr2, -Ci2), dim=-1)
228	        # complex exponential-trapezoidal scan (FP32 — NOT rounded)
229	        x_h = x_in.view(Bn, S, H, Pp)
230	        y_h, scan_cache = scan_forward(x_h, dt, A_real, theta, lam, Bbar, Cbar, H, Pp, Nc)
231	        y = y_h.reshape(Bn, S, di)
232	        # D-skip + gated output (FP32)
233	        y_skip = y + x_in * P[pre + "mixer.D"].view(1, 1, di)
234	        sz = silu(z)
235	        y_gated = y_skip * sz
236	        # out_proj (bf16 GEMM)
237	        y_gated_b = bf(y_gated)                                  # out_proj A-operand bf16
238	        mix_out = y_gated_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.out_proj.weight"]).t()
239	        h1 = x_block_in + mix_out                               # block residual (bf16 stream + fp64 out)
240	
241	        # ============ SwiGLU MLP sub-block (pre-norm + residual) ===============
242	        h1n, mlpn_cache = rmsnorm_forward(h1, P[pre + "mlp_norm.weight"], eps)
243	        h1n_b = bf(h1n)                                          # gate_proj/up_proj A-operand bf16
244	        g_pre = h1n_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.gate_proj.weight"]).t()
245	        u = h1n_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.up_proj.weight"]).t()
246	        s = silu(g_pre)
247	        prod = s * u
248	        prod_b = bf(prod)                                       # down_proj A-operand bf16
249	        mlp_out = prod_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.down_proj.weight"]).t()
250	        h2 = h1 + mlp_out
251	
252	        # next block's input stream is bf16 (its in_proj A-operand + residual);
253	        # the FINAL block's output stays fp32 into the head norm (kernel's last layer).
254	        h = bf(h2) if li + 1 < nl else h2
255	        caches.append(dict(
256	            x_block_in=x_block_in, mixn_cache=mixn_cache, xn_mix_b=xn_mix_b,
257	            x_in=x_in, x_in_b=x_in_b, z=z, dt_lr=dt_lr, dt_lr_b=dt_lr_b,
258	            dt_pre=dt_pre, A_arg=A_arg, base_rate=base_rate, lam=lam,
259	            Bcache=Bcache, Bicache=Bicache, Ccache=Ccache, Cicache=Cicache,
260	            scan_cache=scan_cache, y_skip=y_skip, sz=sz, y_gated=y_gated,
261	            y_gated_b=y_gated_b, h1=h1, mlpn_cache=mlpn_cache, h1n_b=h1n_b,
262	            g_pre=g_pre, u=u, s=s, prod=prod, prod_b=prod_b,
263	            H=H, Pp=Pp, Nc=Nc, di=di, dt_rank=dt_rank, pre=pre))
264	
265	    # ---- final RMSNorm (last token) + scalar head + cross-entropy (fp32) ----
266	    h_last = h[:, -1, :]
267	    hn, nc = rmsnorm_forward(h_last, P["norm.weight"], eps)
268	    logits = hn @ P["out.weight"].t() + P["out.bias"]           # scalar head fp32
269	    loss = cross_entropy_forward(logits, targets)
270	
271	    # ============================ BACKWARD ===================================
272	    grads = {}
273	    dlogits = cross_entropy_backward(logits, targets)           # fp32 (NO bf16)
274	    grads["out.weight"] = dlogits.t() @ hn
275	    grads["out.bias"] = dlogits.sum(0)
276	    dhn = dlogits @ P["out.weight"]
277	    dh_last, grads["norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dhn, nc)
278	
279	    d = P["tok.weight"].shape[1]
280	    dh = torch.zeros(Bn, S, d, device=dev, dtype=torch.float64)
281	    dh[:, -1, :] = dh_last
282	    for li in reversed(range(nl)):
283	        lc = caches[li]
284	        pre = lc["pre"]
285	        H, Pp, Nc, di = lc["H"], lc["Pp"], lc["Nc"], lc["di"]
286	
287	        # ---- SwiGLU MLP backward (h2 = h1 + mlp(mlp_norm(h1))) ----
288	        d_ff = lc["prod_b"].shape[-1]
289	        dh1 = dh.clone()                                        # residual path
290	        dmlp_out = dh                                          # [B,S,d]
291	        # down_proj [d,d_ff]: dW = dY^T @ prod_b ; dX = dY @ W   (dY adjoint bf16)
292	        dmlp_out_b = bf(dmlp_out)                               # down_proj dY bf16
293	        grads[pre + "mlp.down_proj.weight"] = (
294	            dmlp_out_b.reshape(-1, d).t() @ lc["prod_b"].reshape(-1, d_ff))
295	        dprod = dmlp_out_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.down_proj.weight"])  # fp32 [B,S,d_ff]
296	        ds = dprod * lc["u"]
297	        du = dprod * lc["s"]
298	        dg_pre = ds * silu_grad(lc["g_pre"])
299	        # gate_proj / up_proj: dY adjoints bf16, dW vs h1n_b, dX vs W (bf16)
300	        dg_pre_b = bf(dg_pre); du_b = bf(du)
301	        grads[pre + "mlp.gate_proj.weight"] = dg_pre_b.reshape(-1, dg_pre_b.shape[-1]).t() @ lc["h1n_b"].reshape(-1, d)
302	        grads[pre + "mlp.up_proj.weight"] = du_b.reshape(-1, du_b.shape[-1]).t() @ lc["h1n_b"].reshape(-1, d)
303	        dh1n = dg_pre_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.gate_proj.weight"]) + du_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.up_proj.weight"])
304	        dh1_mlpnorm, grads[pre + "mlp_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dh1n, lc["mlpn_cache"])
305	        dh1 = dh1 + dh1_mlpnorm
306	
307	        # ---- Mamba-3 mixer backward (h1 = x + mixer(mixer_norm(x))) ----
308	        dx_block = dh1.clone()                                  # residual path
309	        dmix_out = dh1                                         # [B,S,d]
310	        # out_proj [d,di]: dW = dY^T @ y_gated_b ; dX = dY @ W   (dY adjoint bf16)
311	        dmix_out_b = bf(dmix_out)                               # out_proj dY bf16
312	        grads[pre + "mixer.out_proj.weight"] = dmix_out_b.reshape(-1, d).t() @ lc["y_gated_b"].reshape(-1, di)
313	        dy_gated = dmix_out_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.out_proj.weight"])  # fp32 [B,S,di]
314	        # gate + D-skip backward (FP32)
315	        dy_skip = dy_gated * lc["sz"]
316	        dsz = dy_gated * lc["y_skip"]
317	        dz = dsz * silu_grad(lc["z"])
318	        grads[pre + "mixer.D"] = (dy_skip * lc["x_in"]).sum(dim=(0, 1))
319	        dx_in = dy_skip * P[pre + "mixer.D"].view(1, 1, di)
320	        # scan backward (FP32) — dy [B,L,di] -> [B,L,H,P]
321	        sg = scan_backward(dy_skip.view(Bn, S, H, Pp), lc["scan_cache"])
322	        dx_in = dx_in + sg["dx_h"].reshape(Bn, S, di)
323	        # Cbar = (Cr2,-Ci2), Bbar = (Br2,Bi2)
324	        dBr2 = sg["dBbar"][..., 0]; dBi2 = sg["dBbar"][..., 1]
325	        dCr2 = sg["dCbar"][..., 0]; dCi2 = -sg["dCbar"][..., 1]
326	        grads[pre + "mixer.B_bias"] = dBr2.sum(dim=(0, 1))
327	        grads[pre + "mixer.Bhat_bias"] = dBi2.sum(dim=(0, 1))
328	        grads[pre + "mixer.C_bias"] = dCr2.sum(dim=(0, 1))
329	        grads[pre + "mixer.Chat_bias"] = dCi2.sum(dim=(0, 1))
330	        dBr, grads[pre + "mixer.B_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dBr2, lc["Bcache"])
331	        dBi, grads[pre + "mixer.Bhat_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dBi2, lc["Bicache"])
332	        dCr, grads[pre + "mixer.C_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dCr2, lc["Ccache"])
333	        dCi, grads[pre + "mixer.Chat_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dCi2, lc["Cicache"])
334	        # dt: ddt(post-softplus) -> dt_pre via softplus' -> dt_proj bwd (dY bf16)
335	        ddt_pre = sg["ddt"] * softplus_grad(lc["dt_pre"])
336	        ddt_pre_b = bf(ddt_pre)                                 # dt_proj dY bf16
337	        grads[pre + "mixer.dt_proj.weight"] = ddt_pre_b.reshape(-1, H).t() @ lc["dt_lr_b"].reshape(-1, lc["dt_rank"])
338	        grads[pre + "mixer.dt_proj.bias"] = ddt_pre_b.reshape(-1, H).sum(0)
339	        ddt_lr = ddt_pre_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.dt_proj.weight"])  # fp32 [.,dt_rank]
340	        # A_real = -softplus(A_arg); A_arg = A_mod + exp(A_log)
341	        dA_arg = sg["dA_real"] * (-softplus_grad(lc["A_arg"]))
342	        dA_mod = dA_arg
343	        grads[pre + "mixer.A_log"] = (dA_arg * lc["base_rate"].view(1, 1, -1)).sum(dim=(0, 1))
344	        # lambda = sigmoid(u_lam)
345	        du_lam = sg["dlam"] * (lc["lam"] * (1.0 - lc["lam"]))
346	        dtheta = sg["dtheta"]
347	        # reassemble x_proj output adjoint, round to bf16, x_proj bwd
348	        dproj = torch.cat([ddt_lr, dA_mod, dtheta, du_lam, dBr, dBi, dCr, dCi], dim=-1)
349	        dproj_b = bf(dproj)                                     # x_proj dY bf16
350	        grads[pre + "mixer.x_proj.weight"] = dproj_b.reshape(-1, dproj_b.shape[-1]).t() @ lc["x_in_b"].reshape(-1, di)
351	        dx_in3 = dproj_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.x_proj.weight"])    # fp32
352	        dx_in = dx_in + dx_in3
353	        # x_in = x_main (no SiLU) ; xz = [x_main | z] = in_proj(xn_mix). dY bf16.
354	        dxz = torch.cat([dx_in, dz], dim=-1)
355	        dxz_b = bf(dxz)                                         # in_proj dY bf16
356	        grads[pre + "mixer.in_proj.weight"] = dxz_b.reshape(-1, 2 * di).t() @ lc["xn_mix_b"].reshape(-1, d)
357	        dxn_mix = dxz_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.in_proj.weight"])   # fp32
358	        dx_mixnorm, grads[pre + "mixer_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dxn_mix, lc["mixn_cache"])
359	        dh = dx_block + dx_mixnorm                              # x fans to block residual + mixer_norm
360	
361	    # ---- embeddings (h0 = tok[tokens] + pos[pos_ids]); dh0 bf16 ----
362	    dh_b = bf(dh)
363	    dtok = torch.zeros_like(P["tok.weight"])
364	    dtok.index_add_(0, tokens.reshape(-1), dh_b.reshape(-1, d))
365	    grads["tok.weight"] = dtok
366	    grads["pos.weight"] = dh_b.sum(dim=0)                       # [S,d]
367	    return loss.item(), grads

413	def _eager_mamba3_named(seed=123):
414	    """Init the 45 Mamba-3 toy params with a sane, valid init on CPU
415	    (deterministic). Used only by the standalone test_mamba_tc.py GPU tests (the
416	    L3-TC tail gate builds the LIVE model instead), so the exact values only need
417	    to be a valid fixed point — parity is structural, not value-specific.
418	
419	    Init mirrors mamba3_block.py's module defaults:
420	      A_log        = log(arange(1..n_heads))         (= log of 1,2,3,4 -> A=-exp<0 stable)
421	      D            = ones(d_inner)
422	      *_bias (B/C) = ones(complex_dim)               (Appendix F all-ones)
423	      *norm.weight = ones                            (RMSNorm init)
424	      dt_proj.bias = zeros ; out.bias = zeros
425	      everything else (projection weights, embeddings) = 0.05*randn
426	    """
427	    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
428	    named = {}
429	    for name, shape in mamba3_param_spec():
430	        if name.endswith("A_log"):
431	            n_heads = shape[0]
432	            named[name] = torch.log(torch.arange(1, n_heads + 1, dtype=torch.float32)).contiguous()
433	        elif name.endswith(".D"):
434	            named[name] = torch.ones(shape)
435	        elif name.endswith("_bias"):                       # B_bias/Bhat_bias/C_bias/Chat_bias
436	            named[name] = torch.ones(shape)
437	        elif name.endswith("norm.weight"):                 # all RMSNorm weights (mixer/mlp/BC/final)
438	            named[name] = torch.ones(shape)
439	        elif name.endswith(".bias"):                       # dt_proj.bias, out.bias
440	            named[name] = torch.zeros(shape)
441	        else:                                              # projection weights + embeddings
442	            named[name] = 0.05 * torch.randn(shape, generator=g)
443	    return named

456	    beta1, beta2 = betas
457	    bc1 = 1.0 - beta1 ** step
458	    bc2 = 1.0 - beta2 ** step
459	    return mod.tc_train_step(params, tokens.to(torch.int32), targets.to(torch.int32),
460	                             state, float(lr), float(beta1), float(beta2), float(eps),

466	# decoder needed 0.15 for its T-contraction projection dWs, but Mamba's projections
467	# are smaller / better-conditioned — the worst observed k-vs-bf16-faithful is the

469	# (~1.6e-2), the signature of a correct kernel rather than a bug). So 0.08 is kept
470	# for all tensors — NO relaxation of the contract number. The structural witness
471	# (layer-0 ≈ layer-1) confirms no early-layer error compounding.
472	_TC_GRAD_REL = 0.08
473	_TC_LOSS_REL = 5e-3

69	def _run_pair(N, seed):
70	    """Run mirror_step and oracle_step from IDENTICAL state; return max abs diff
71	    over the returned activations + all mutated state buffers."""
72	    w = make_weights(seed=seed)
73	    rng = np.random.default_rng(1000 + seed)
74	    grad = (rng.standard_normal(N) * 0.5).astype(np.float64)
75	    sharp = (rng.standard_normal(N) * 0.3).astype(np.float64)
76	    perm, unsort = make_sorted_perm(grad)
77	    sc = make_scalars()
78	
79	    s0 = _init_state(N, seed)
80	    sm = {k: v.copy() for k, v in s0.items()}
81	    so = {k: v.copy() for k, v in s0.items()}
82	
83	    rm = mirror_step(w, grad, sharp, perm, unsort, sm["gru_state"], sm["exp_avg"],
84	                     sm["exp_avg_sq"], sm["mu"], sm["slow"], sm["param"], sc)
85	    ro = oracle_step(w, grad, sharp, perm, unsort, so["gru_state"], so["exp_avg"],
86	                     so["exp_avg_sq"], so["mu"], so["slow"], so["param"], sc)

88	    diffs = {}

91	    for k in ("gru_state", "exp_avg", "exp_avg_sq", "mu", "slow", "param"):
92	        diffs[k] = float(np.abs(sm[k] - so[k]).max())

137	#  (A') EXTERNAL GROUND-TRUTH ANCHOR — the eager CSAHCAMetaNet (CPU, fp64).
138	#
139	#  (A) proves mirror == my_oracle, but I wrote BOTH from one reading of
140	#  csa_hca_step_one, so a SHARED misreading (expert W1/W2 layout, the *pk_dim
141	#  Cartesian indexing, a GRU/indexer transpose) would be invisible. This anchors
142	#  the oracle to code I did NOT write: the eager net CSAHCAMetaNet.forward.
143	#
144	#  WHY this is valid despite the eager indexer being FULL-RANK (the kernel path
145	#  is LOW-RANK only): CSA's selection is top-k = min(csa_topk, Nc) with
146	#  csa_topk=16 and Nc=ceil(N/csa_compress)=ceil(N/4). For N <= 64, Nc <= 16, so
147	#  top-k = Nc — EVERY compressed entry is selected and the indexer ORDERING is
148	#  irrelevant to the attention output. So for N <= 64 the eager net and the
149	#  kernel path compute the IDENTICAL full pipeline (indexer and all). We compare
150	#  the eager net's total_expert_out + new_gru against the oracle's — a tight
151	#  (1e-12) external check on the layout/index transcription.
152	# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
153	def _eager_weights_into_oracle_dict(m):
154	    """Extract the eager CSAHCAMetaNet's parameters into the fp64 `w` layout the
155	    oracle/mirror consume (SG2Weights row-major). Mappings:
156	      nn.Linear.weight is [out,in] → matches oracle's `@ W.T` convention directly.
157	      expert_W1 [E,H,1] → [E,H] (squeeze); expert_W2 [E,1,H] → [E,H] (squeeze)."""
158	    import torch
159	    sd = dict(m.named_parameters())
160	
161	    def f(name):
162	        return sd[name].detach().double().cpu().numpy()
163	
164	    w = dict(
165	        input_proj_W=f("input_proj.weight"), input_proj_b=f("input_proj.bias"),
166	        csa_q_W=f("csa_layer.q_W.weight"), csa_k_W=f("csa_layer.k_W.weight"),
167	        csa_v_W=f("csa_layer.v_W.weight"), csa_out_W=f("csa_layer.out_W.weight"),
168	        csa_compress_w=f("csa_layer.compress_w"),
169	        csa_idx_DQ=f("csa_layer.idx_DQ"), csa_idx_K=f("csa_layer.idx_K"),
170	        hca_q_W=f("hca_layer.q_W.weight"), hca_k_W=f("hca_layer.k_W.weight"),
171	        hca_v_W=f("hca_layer.v_W.weight"), hca_out_W=f("hca_layer.out_W.weight"),
172	        gru_Wz=f("gru.W_z.weight"), gru_bz=f("gru.W_z.bias"),
173	        gru_Wr=f("gru.W_r.weight"), gru_br=f("gru.W_r.bias"),
174	        gru_Wh=f("gru.W_h.weight"), gru_bh=f("gru.W_h.bias"),
175	        peer_query_Ws=np.stack([f(f"peer_queries.{h}.weight") for h in range(4)]),
176	        prod_keys_A=np.stack([f(f"product_keys_A.{h}") for h in range(4)]),
177	        prod_keys_B=np.stack([f(f"product_keys_B.{h}") for h in range(4)]),
178	        expert_W1=f("expert_W1").reshape(144, 16),
179	        expert_b1=f("expert_b1"),
180	        expert_W2=f("expert_W2").reshape(144, 16),
181	        expert_b2=f("expert_b2").reshape(144),
182	    )
183	    return w

382	def _scalars(P, seed=0):
383	    # Per-tensor scalars mirroring the per-op layer-scaled betas/alphas. gru_decay
384	    # == beta1 (csa_hca_step_one: `gru_decay = beta1s[i]`). bc1/bc2 = 1-beta^t at
385	    # a fixed t so the single-step compare exercises bias correction.
386	    rng = np.random.default_rng(500 + seed)
387	    beta1 = (0.88 + 0.04 * rng.random(P)).tolist()
388	    alpha = (0.95 + 0.03 * rng.random(P)).tolist()
389	    beta2 = 0.999
390	    t = 5
391	    bc1 = [1.0 - b ** t for b in beta1]
392	    bc2 = [1.0 - beta2 ** t] * P
393	    return dict(alpha=alpha, gru_decay=list(beta1), lamb_eff=[2.0] * P,
394	                beta1=list(beta1), bc1=bc1, bc2=bc2,
395	                rescale=0.1, beta2=beta2, lr=1e-3, wd=0.01, eps=1e-8)

107	# ── reference + tolerance ────────────────────────────────────────────────
108	#
109	# The wgmma computes  D[m,n] = sum_k A[m,k] * B[n,k]  with bf16 inputs and an
110	# fp32 accumulator (B is stored N×K row-major and read transposed → D = A @ B^T
111	# over the stored tiles). The faithful reference is the SAME contraction done in
112	# fp32 on the bf16-ROUNDED inputs: cast A,B to bf16 (both sides), then upcast to
113	# fp32 and matmul. bf16 inputs are then exact on both sides and bf16×bf16
114	# products are exact in fp32; the ONLY residual is fp32 ACCUMULATION ORDER
115	# (hardware k-order vs torch). The reference is computed on CPU in fp64 (and in
116	# fp32 on-GPU with TF32 DISABLED) so the reference itself carries no tensor-core
117	# imprecision.
118	#
119	# Tolerance derivation (stated, not guessed): with K total accumulation steps,
120	# the fp32 accumulation round-off is bounded ≈ K · ε_fp32 · max|partial|, with
121	# ε_fp32 = 2^-24 ≈ 6e-8. For K ≤ 512 and unit-scale operands the absolute error
122	# bound is ≈ 512 · 6e-8 · O(K) ≈ a few e-3 worst case; in practice (random
123	# ±1 operands, well-conditioned) max-abs-err is ≤ ~1e-3. We therefore gate at
124	# atol=2e-3, rtol=2e-3. A max-err at the ~1e-2 level would indicate a BUG
125	# (fragment-layout / transpose / leaked TF32), not bf16 noise — we do NOT loosen
126	# the tolerance to absorb that.
127	_ATOL = 2e-3
128	_RTOL = 2e-3
129

131	def _disable_tf32():
132	    # The on-GPU fp32 reference must NOT run on TF32 tensor cores or it loses
133	    # ~10 mantissa bits and the tolerance becomes meaningless.
134	    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
135	    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False

138	def _make_AB(N, k_steps, seed):
139	    """A: [k_steps,64,16] bf16, B: [k_steps,N,16] bf16. Returns (A,B, A_flat,B_flat)."""
140	    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
141	    A = (torch.randn(k_steps, 64, 16, generator=g, device="cuda",
142	                     dtype=torch.float32)).to(torch.bfloat16)
143	    B = (torch.randn(k_steps, N, 16, generator=g, device="cuda",
144	                     dtype=torch.float32)).to(torch.bfloat16)

148	def _reference(A, B):
149	    """fp64 CPU reference: D[m,n] = sum_{k_step,k} A[k_step,m,k]·B[k_step,n,k]."""
150	    Ad = A.double().cpu()   # [ks,64,16]
151	    Bd = B.double().cpu()   # [ks,N,16]
152	    # contract over (k_step, 16): einsum gives D[m,n] = Σ_{s,k} A[s,m,k] B[s,n,k]
153	    D = torch.einsum("smk,snk->mn", Ad, Bd)
154	    return D   # [64, N] fp64 on CPU

10	      mirror of the kernel (per-channel register scan, scan-bwd recompute+reverse,

27	from __future__ import annotations

29	import pytest
30	import torch

33	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
34	# Build the eager MambaModel (the ground-truth module the oracle transcribes).

36	def _build_eager_mamba(dtype=torch.float32, seed=42):
37	    import grokking_race_v2 as g
38	    torch.manual_seed(seed)
39	    m = g.MambaModel(p=97, ntok=99, seq_len=8, d=128, nl=2, grad_checkpoint=False)

43	# ===========================================================================
44	#  A (CPU) ORACLE vs AUTOGRAD

46	def test_mamba_oracle_matches_autograd():
47	    """The Mamba oracle (manual fwd+bwd, NO autograd) == torch.autograd, fp64.
48	
49	    This is the math the L3-REAL CUDA megakernel transcribes line-for-line —
50	    INCLUDING the selective-scan reverse-time backward. It must match autograd's
51	    loss + EVERY parameter grad to machine precision or the kernel is being
52	    validated against a wrong reference."""
53	    import torch.nn.functional as F
54	    from tests.hw.mamba_oracle import (MambaWeights, mamba_forward,
55	                                        mamba_backward, mamba_param_layout,
56	                                        VOCAB, P_HEAD, SEQ)
57	    m = _build_eager_mamba(dtype=torch.float64, seed=42)
58	    B = 11
59	    tokens = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (B, SEQ))
60	    targets = torch.randint(0, P_HEAD, (B,))
61	    m.zero_grad()
62	    loss = F.cross_entropy(m(tokens), targets)
63	    loss.backward()
64	    eager = {n: p.grad.detach().clone() for n, p in m.named_parameters()}
65	    named = {n: p.detach().clone() for n, p in m.named_parameters()}
66	    W = MambaWeights.from_named(named)
67	    oloss, cache = mamba_forward(W, tokens, targets)
68	    ograds = mamba_backward(W, cache)
69	    assert abs(oloss.item() - loss.item()) < 1e-9, "oracle loss != autograd"
70	    for n in mamba_param_layout()["names"]:
71	        a = (eager[n] - ograds[n]).abs().max().item()
72	        denom = eager[n].abs().max().item() + 1e-30
73	        assert a / denom < 1e-8, f"oracle grad {n} rel {a/denom:.2e} > 1e-8"

77	#  A2 (CPU) STRUCTURAL MIRROR vs ORACLE
78	# ===========================================================================
79	def test_mamba_kernel_mirror_matches_oracle():
80	    """The structural kernel mirror == the oracle, including a within-sample
81	    token-id collision in the embedding scatter, the per-channel register scan,
82	    the scan backward (recompute + reverse), the NON-causal conv transpose, and
83	    the 3-path dx_main accumulation. Catches the missing-term/index/alias bug
84	    class the un-runnable .cu would hide."""

86	                                        mamba_backward, mamba_param_layout,
87	                                        VOCAB, P_HEAD, SEQ)
88	    from tests.hw.mamba_kernel_mirror import mirror_loss_and_grads
89	    m = _build_eager_mamba(dtype=torch.float32, seed=7)
90	    named = {n: p.detach().clone() for n, p in m.named_parameters()}
91	    B = 2
92	    tokens = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (B, SEQ))
93	    tokens[0, 1] = tokens[0, 0]   # force a within-sample token-id collision
94	    targets = torch.randint(0, P_HEAD, (B,))
95	    W = MambaWeights.from_named({k: v.double() for k, v in named.items()})
96	    oloss, cache = mamba_forward(W, tokens, targets)

60	    return t.detach().to(torch.float32)

63	def _block_tree_sum_fp32(vals: torch.Tensor, block: int = 256) -> float:
64	    """Mirror primitives.cuh::block_reduce_sum_f32 accumulation SHAPE.
65	
66	    The device reduces with a warp-butterfly + smem tree over a fixed thread
67	    count, all in fp32. Exact bit-matching that tree on CPU is not the point;
68	    what matters is that the reduction is fp32 and pairwise-ish (NOT a naive
69	    left-fold over millions of elements), so we accumulate in fp32 with a
70	    block-strided partial layout that matches the kernel's grid-stride loop:
71	    `block` threads each fold their strided slice, then the partials are summed.
72	    This is the same numerical regime as the device tree (fp32, partitioned).
73	    """
74	    v = _f32(vals).flatten()
75	    n = v.numel()
76	    if n == 0:
77	        return 0.0
78	    # Per-thread partials (thread j folds indices j, j+block, j+2*block, ...).
79	    partials = torch.zeros(block, dtype=torch.float32)
80	    for j in range(min(block, n)):
81	        partials[j] = v[j::block].sum(dtype=torch.float32)
82	    # Tree-sum the partials in fixed order (the warp+smem tree).
83	    return float(partials.sum(dtype=torch.float32))

86	def _owner_sum_slots_fp32(slots) -> float:
87	    """Mirror opt_stages_precompute.cuh::owner_sum_slots — ascending fixed-order
88	    fp32 sum of the per-CTA partial slots (the deterministic owner-computes
89	    tree that REPLACES the live path's atomicAdd)."""
90	    acc = torch.zeros((), dtype=torch.float32)
91	    for s in slots:
92	        acc = acc + torch.as_tensor(s, dtype=torch.float32)
93	    return float(acc)

100	def _prodigy_stage_mirror(params, param_inits, grads, *, d_prev, n_ctas):
101	    """Mirror prodigy_precompute_reduce_phaseA + phaseB.
102	
103	    Per CTA: accumulate (r,s) over the tensors that CTA is assigned (we model a
104	    round-robin tensor→CTA assignment, the work-stealing queue's effect on the
105	    PARTITION; the FINAL sum is partition-independent because the reducer sums
106	    every slot). Each CTA's (r,s) is a fp32 block-tree over its elements; the
107	    per-CTA slots are then owner-summed in fixed order. Returns d.
108	    """
109	    # Per-CTA (r,s) slots, fp32 (matches ws.prodigy_partials[2*n_ctas]).
110	    r_slots = [torch.zeros((), dtype=torch.float32) for _ in range(n_ctas)]
111	    s_slots = [torch.zeros((), dtype=torch.float32) for _ in range(n_ctas)]
112	    for t, (p, pi, g) in enumerate(zip(params, param_inits, grads)):
113	        cta = t % n_ctas
114	        pf, pif, gf = map(_f32, (p, pi, g))
115	        # Per-element prodigy partials in fp32 (prodigy.h:48,52 body):
116	        #   r += g*(pi-p)*d^2 ;  s += d^2*|g|
117	        r_elt = gf * (pif - pf) * (d_prev * d_prev)
118	        s_elt = (d_prev * d_prev) * gf.abs()
119	        r_slots[cta] = r_slots[cta] + torch.as_tensor(
120	            _block_tree_sum_fp32(r_elt), dtype=torch.float32)
121	        s_slots[cta] = s_slots[cta] + torch.as_tensor(
122	            _block_tree_sum_fp32(s_elt), dtype=torch.float32)
123	    # Owner-computes fixed-order reduction across CTAs.
124	    r_sum = _owner_sum_slots_fp32(r_slots)
125	    s_sum = _owner_sum_slots_fp32(s_slots)
126	    # Canonical d update (prodigy.h:56-65) — mirrored in fp32.
127	    denom = abs(s_sum)
128	    if denom < 1e-12:

221	    m == the start-of-step MOMENTUM (exp_avg) — the canonical cos(grad,momentum)
222	    SIGNAL (supergrok11.h:29,64), NOT the co-wrong cos(grad,mu)."""
223	    g = _f64(grad).flatten()
224	    m = _f64(momentum).flatten()
225	    num = float((g * m).sum())
226	    den_g = float((g * g).sum())
227	    den_m = float((m * m).sum())
228	    denom = math.sqrt(den_g * den_m + 1e-12)
229	    cos = (num / denom) if denom > 0.0 else 0.0

251	    clamp. Two teeth: (a) the gate equals sigmoid(gate_temp*cos) (vs the raw
252	    clamped cosine it used to be), and (b) raising gate_temp moves the gate toward
253	    1 for a positive cosine (a bare clamp would be temperature-invariant)."""
254	    torch.manual_seed(3)

369	def _muon_orth_stage_mirror_fp32(grad, buf, *, momentum, ns_steps):
370	    """Mirror the muon precompute STAGE chain in fp32:
371	        buf = momentum*buf + grad                         (muon.h:43, phaseA)
372	        inv_norm = 1/(||buf||_F + 1e-7)                   (bindings.cpp:962-963)
373	        X = buf*inv_norm                                  (muon_scale_X)
374	        repeat ns_steps:
375	            A   = X Xᵀ ; AX = A X ; AAX = A AX            (muon_matmul, fp32)
376	            X   = a*X + b*AX + c*AAX                       (muon_ns_combine_phase)
377	        orth = X
378	    The matmuls are accumulated in fp32 (the device owner-computes inner product
379	    sums the contraction in fp32). Returns (orth, buf_new).
380	    """
381	    a, b, c = 3.4445, -4.7750, 2.0315
382	    g = _f32(grad)
383	    bf = _f32(buf)
384	    buf_new = momentum * bf + g
385	    inv_norm = 1.0 / (torch.linalg.norm(buf_new).item() + 1e-7)
386	    X = (buf_new * inv_norm).to(torch.float32)
387	    for _ in range(ns_steps):
388	        # fp32 matmuls (mirror the device fp32 contraction).
389	        A = (X @ X.t()).to(torch.float32)
390	        AX = (A @ X).to(torch.float32)
391	        AAX = (A @ AX).to(torch.float32)
392	        X = (a * X + b * AX + c * AAX).to(torch.float32)
393	    return X, buf_new
